armaak.name: Archangel
armaak.gloss: tier-2 anti-air bot, missiles at 1200 and 880; air only, walks under water; keep it behind the army
armaak.prose: The Archangel is the tier-2 mobile anti-air: 520 metal, 2200 health, speed 47, a long-range missile at 1200 and a second at 880 that do full damage to aircraft and nothing to anything else. It covers an army against gunships and bombers from the back and can walk under water, though not fire from there. It is worth its cost only when the enemy has air; against a ground push it is 520 metal that does not shoot.

armaap.name: Advanced Aircraft Plant
armaap.gloss: tier-2 aircraft plant, 2900 metal, 600 build power; makes the Highwind, Hornet, Blizzard, Liche, Stiletto and the rest
armaap.prose: The Advanced Aircraft Plant is the tier-2 air factory: 2900 metal and 29000 energy, 3750 health, 600 build power, 1000 radar, making the Advanced Construction Aircraft (armaca), Roughneck, Blizzard, Cormorant, Highwind, Oracle, Abductor, Hornet, Stiletto and Liche. It is the most energy-expensive factory to build and its units are the most energy-expensive to make; it pays when the enemy has no anti-air or when a commander or a fusion cluster is the target. It makes the Blink's tier-2 successor the Oracle (armawac) as well, whose radar finds targets for everything the plant makes.

armaas.name: Dragonslayer
armaas.gloss: tier-2 anti-air ship, flak and missiles at 840; one clears a wave of light aircraft; nothing against ships
armaas.prose: The Dragonslayer is the fleet's anti-air: 1000 metal, 3900 health, speed 63, flak at range 790 and missile turrets at 840, both for aircraft only. One neutralises a wave of light aircraft and two kill a Dragon (corcrwh); it does nothing against ships, so it sails inside the fleet. Every fleet needs one once the enemy has air.

armaca.name: Advanced Construction Aircraft
armaca.gloss: tier-2 constructor aircraft, 120 build power at speed 192; upgrades far extractors, builds fusion; fragile
armaca.prose: The Advanced Construction Aircraft is the flying tier-2 builder: 340 metal, 200 health, speed 192, 120 build power, no weapon. It reaches any extractor on the map to upgrade it and builds fusion, advanced converters, the heavy turrets and the gantry; its build power is lower than the land constructors', so use a pack. Fighters and any anti-air kill it.

armack.name: Advanced Construction Bot
armack.gloss: tier-2 constructor bot, 210 build power; the only builder of advanced extractors, fusion and tier-2 buildings
armack.prose: The Advanced Construction Bot is the builder that tier 2 exists for: 430 metal, 930 health, speed 33, 210 build power, no weapon. Advanced extractors (armmoho), fusion reactors (armfus), the advanced converter, the advanced radar, the heavy turrets and the gantry are on its list and on no tier-1 builder's; the chain is constructor, advanced lab, this, then upgrades. Its first job is upgrading the safest extractors, about 70 seconds each with metal in the bank and minutes each without, so give it helpers or a bank. It dies to any raider that reaches it, and it costs the same as three Pawns to replace.

armacsub.name: Advanced Construction Sub
armacsub.gloss: tier-2 constructor submarine, 350 build power; upgrades underwater extractors, builds fusion and the underwater gantry
armacsub.prose: The Advanced Construction Sub is the submerged tier-2 builder: 700 metal, 1110 health, speed 72, 350 build power, no weapon, and it makes 30 energy. It upgrades underwater extractors, builds naval fusion, advanced converters, advanced torpedo launchers, sonar and the underwater Experimental Gantry (armshltxuw). Guard it with the fleet and assist it with tier-1 constructors.

armacv.name: Advanced Construction Vehicle
armacv.gloss: tier-2 constructor vehicle, 290 build power; builds advanced extractors, fusion and tier-2 buildings; unarmed
armacv.prose: The Advanced Construction Vehicle is the vehicle line's tier-2 builder: 550 metal, 2050 health, speed 52.5, 290 build power, no weapon. Advanced extractors (armmoho), fusion (armfus), advanced converters, heavy turrets and the gantry are on its list and on no tier-1 builder's; it has more build power and health than the advanced bot (armack) but climbs poorly. Its first job is upgrading the safest extractors; it dies to any raider that reaches it.

armadvsol.name: Advanced Solar Collector
armadvsol.gloss: 80 energy a second for 350 metal, no weather; four solars in one footprint, as metal-efficient as fusion
armadvsol.prose: The Advanced Solar Collector makes a steady 80 energy a second for 350 metal and 5000 energy, 1130 health, 100 energy storage. At 4.4 metal per energy a second it is as cheap as a fusion reactor per unit of energy and needs no tier-2 builder, so it is the tier-1 way to a big, steady income where wind is poor; it is much dearer up front than solar or wind. The energy to build it is the cost that bites at tier 1.

armafus.name: Advanced Fusion Reactor
armafus.gloss: 3000 energy a second for 9700 metal; the late-game energy for long-range guns and gantries; huge explosion
armafus.prose: The Advanced Fusion Reactor makes 3000 energy a second for 9700 metal and 69000 energy, with 8300 health and 9000 energy storage. It is what powers a Pulsar (armanni), a long-range cannon or a gantry army late in a game, and it is the bomber's favourite target; its explosion levels everything near it, so it stands alone under anti-air. Only the tier-2 constructors build it.

armageo.name: Advanced Geothermal Powerplant
armageo.gloss: tier-2 geothermal, 1250 energy a second on a vent for 1600 metal; low health, devastating when it explodes
armageo.prose: The Advanced Geothermal Powerplant makes 1250 energy a second for 1600 metal and 27000 energy on a steam vent, with 3600 health and 12000 energy storage. It is the most metal-efficient energy in the game, and its explosion can take most of a base with it, so it goes on a vent the enemy cannot reach and away from everything else. Only the tier-2 constructors build it.

armah.name: Sweeper
armah.gloss: tier-1 anti-air hovercraft, missiles at 700; covers a hover force or a fleet against light aircraft; expensive
armah.prose: The Sweeper is a 230-metal anti-air hovercraft: 1070 health, speed 88.5, missile salvos at range 700 for aircraft only, 350 sonar, immune to torpedoes. It covers a hovercraft force or a fleet against light aircraft, especially the Shuriken (corbw); against ground it does nothing and for its role it is expensive, so build only what the enemy's air warrants. Against ships and ground it does nothing, so it sails with Crocodiles (armanac) that do.

armalab.name: Advanced Bot Lab
armalab.gloss: tier-2 bot factory, 2600 metal, 600 build power; the gate to tier 2 through bots; makes the tier-2 bots
armalab.prose: The Advanced Bot Lab is the tier-2 bot factory: 2600 metal and 15000 energy, 4250 health, 600 build power, four times the tier-1 lab's, making the Advanced Construction Bot (armack), Butler, Sprinter, Hound, Welder, Gunslinger, Sharpshooter, Fatboy, Archangel, Platypus, Recluse, Webber, Ghost, Smuggler, Compass, Tumbleweed, Umbrella and the Decoy Commander. A tier-1 constructor builds it, not the commander; with the first advanced constructor the entry costs about 3000 metal before any return, and building it at 25000 build time takes one constructor five minutes or the commander with two helpers under a minute. The rule of thumb is to start it at +30 metal and +500 energy a second, or +20 with 1000 to 1500 banked; earlier it idles the tier-1 army and loses to a tier-1 push. The opponent's medium setting has one by minute 20 in most games, never before 15.

armamb.name: Rattlesnake
armamb.gloss: 2500-metal cloakable pop-up artillery, 350 damage at 1380; kills the enemy's artillery and turrets from hiding
armamb.prose: The Rattlesnake is the tier-2 pop-up plasma artillery: 2500 metal and 17000 energy, 4000 health, a 350-damage shell every 1.8 seconds at range 1380, with a slower high-arc mode that splashes wider. Cloaked (24 energy a second) it surprises attackers and out-ranges the enemy's artillery and towers except the long-range cannons, protecting a front line from bombardment. It sees nothing of what it shoots at, so it needs radar and a Pinpointer (armtarg).

armamd.name: Citadel
armamd.gloss: 1500-metal anti-nuke, stockpiled interceptors cover a 2000 radius; the only answer to a nuclear silo
armamd.prose: The Citadel is the fixed anti-nuke: 1500 metal and 38000 energy, 3300 health, intercepting nuclear missiles aimed within 2000 of it with stockpiled interceptors, each 150 metal and 7500 energy and 90 seconds, up to 20. It is the only answer to an Armageddon (armsilo) or Apocalypse (corsilo), and it must have a missile ready when the nuke comes; lower the stockpile limit so it stops eating resources once a few are stored. A cloaked spy's EMP burst disables it for twenty seconds, so a Tracer (armsd) stands near it.

armamex.name: Twilight
armamex.gloss: stealthy cloakable extractor for dangerous spots, 200 metal; the same yield, an EMP burst when it dies
armamex.prose: The Twilight is a metal extractor for the front line: 200 metal and 1500 energy, 1610 health, the same yield as a Metal Extractor (armmex), invisible to radar and cloakable for 12 energy a second. When it dies it lets off an EMP burst (4450 damage, 400 wide, 15 seconds of stun) that catches the raiders that killed it, friend and foe. It is the choice for a contested spot the enemy raids and you cannot guard.

armamph.name: Platypus
armamph.air: 63 dps against aircraft (58% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
armamph.gloss: fast amphibious bot with a laser and an anti-air missile; raids from the sea, expensive for what it kills
armamph.prose: The Platypus is a 260-metal amphibious bot (1170 health, speed 90) with a light laser at range 275 and an anti-air missile at 600. It swims on the surface rather than walking the sea floor, so it can cross water to raid naval buildings and light aircraft and arrive from a side the enemy does not watch. It is expensive for a raider and loses a straight fight to any line unit; in the simulated tier-2 study it never beat the tier-1 line. Build a few for sea-side raids, not as an army.

armamsub.name: Amphibious Complex
armamsub.gloss: tier-1 amphibious factory built under water, 1200 metal; makes the Beaver, Pincer, Turtle, Crossbow, Archangel
armamsub.prose: The Amphibious Complex is a factory built on the sea floor: 1200 metal and 5500 energy, 2650 health, 300 build power, making the Beaver (armbeaver), Pincer, Turtle, Crossbow and Archangel, units that walk under water and arrive from the sea. It is offered only where the builder reaches deep water; it is a sea-map choice and expensive for a tier-1 factory. Its units are the ones that come out of the water behind an enemy's shore defences, which is what it is for.

armanac.name: Crocodile
armanac.air: 21 dps against aircraft (30% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
armanac.gloss: tier-1 hovertank, plasma at 370, 1530 health; crosses water to reinforce a fleet or a landing; hates bombers
armanac.prose: The Crocodile is a 270-metal hovertank: 1530 health, speed 70, a 98-damage plasma shot every 1.4 seconds at range 370. It moves over land and sea equally, so it fights beside ships or lands with a raid, and it is the line unit of a hovercraft force. Bombers and gunships kill it as they kill any tank, so bring anti-air; it is cheaper than the Cayman (corsnap) with less health.

armanni.name: Pulsar
armanni.gloss: 3500-metal tachyon tower, 10800 damage at 1400 for 1500 energy a shot; kills heavy units and tier-3
armanni.prose: The Pulsar is the tachyon accelerator tower: 3500 metal and 74000 energy, 6100 health, a 10800-damage beam every 10 seconds at range 1400 for 1500 energy, halving at full range. It is built to kill the heaviest units in the field, tier-3 included, and it fires over other defences; it is a precision weapon that struggles with radar dots, so Pinpointers (armtarg) matter, and it needs an Advanced Fusion Reactor's (armafus) worth of energy behind it. Switched off it retracts into a shell with nearly four times the health.

armantiship.name: Haven
armantiship.gloss: tier-2 support ship: mobile anti-nuke, 300 energy, 2950 radar and sonar; a fleet's only nuke cover
armantiship.prose: The Haven is the fleet's support ship: 1400 metal, 5000 health, speed 63, an anti-nuke stockpile (20 missiles, 90 seconds each), 300 energy a second, 2950 radar, 760 sonar and 1000 build power for assisting and repair. It is the only nuke protection a fleet can carry and makes a third of a fusion's energy for a third of the cost; keep one in every naval force. It has no gun.

armap.name: Aircraft Plant
armap.gloss: tier-1 aircraft plant, 650 metal; makes the air constructor, Blink, Falcon, Stormbringer, Banshee, Stork, Osprey; carries 510 radar
armap.prose: The Aircraft Plant is the tier-1 air factory: 650 metal and 1100 energy, 2050 health, 150 build power, with its own 510 radar, making the Construction Aircraft (armca), Blink scout, Falcon fighter, Stormbringer bomber, Banshee gunship and the Stork and Osprey transports. It is the way to a scout that sees the whole map and to fighters when the enemy flies; its combat aircraft are fragile and die to the first anti-air, so it is a second factory, not a first. Its 150 build power makes an aircraft at the rate of a bot lab, and every unit it makes needs a lot of energy.

armarad.name: Advanced Radar Tower
armarad.gloss: 400-metal tier-2 radar tower, 3500 radar; sees most of a map
armarad.prose: The Advanced Radar Tower shows everything within 3500 as radar dots, for 400 metal and 14000 energy, 500 health. One covers most of a small map's approaches and feeds every long-range weapon; hills block it, jammers hide units from it and cloaked units do not show. Only the tier-2 constructors and the Consul (armconsul) build it.

armart.name: Shellshocker
armart.gloss: tier-1 artillery, 710 range outranges every tier-1 tower; 620 health, blind past 364, needs a spotter and a screen
armart.prose: The Shellshocker is the tier-1 artillery: 135 metal, 620 health, speed 54, a 182-damage shell every 4.3 seconds at range 710, more than any tier-1 tower including the heavy laser (620). That is what it is for, killing turrets from where they cannot answer; it fires only over a 180-degree front, it is inaccurate against anything that moves, and it sees only 364, so on its own it walks into a turret's range before it sees it, and in equal-metal duels it lost to a Sentry (armllt) and a Guard (corllt), most likely for that reason. It needs a Rover (armfav) or radar to spot and Stouts (armstump) or Blitzes (armflash) in front. Never send it against units.

armaser.name: Smuggler
armaser.gloss: radar jammer bot, hides units within 450 from enemy radar for 80 energy a second; unarmed
armaser.prose: The Smuggler is a 78-metal jammer bot: everything within 450 of it is hidden from enemy radar, for 80 energy a second. It walks with a group so the enemy sees nothing coming on radar, or beside a Sharpshooter (armsnipe) to hide its position; a Tracer (armsd) or Nemesis (corsd) sees through it. It has 340 health and no weapon, so it lives behind the line.

armason.name: Advanced Sonar Station
armason.gloss: 170-metal tier-2 sonar station under water, 1600 sonar; finds submarines and submerged commanders
armason.prose: The Advanced Sonar Station is built on the sea floor: 170 metal and 2600 energy, 2350 health, 1600 sonar. It finds submarines, amphibious units and a commander walking under water, which no radar sees; the Advanced Construction Sub (armacsub) builds it. It is cheap, and without it a fleet is blind to what swims beneath it.

armasy.name: Advanced Shipyard
armasy.gloss: tier-2 shipyard on water, 2900 metal; makes the advanced construction sub, Paladin, Barracuda, Serpent, Dragonslayer, Longbow, Dreadnought, Epoch
armasy.prose: The Advanced Shipyard is the tier-2 naval factory, built only on water: 2900 metal and 9700 energy, 6000 health, 600 build power, making the Advanced Construction Sub (armacsub), Voyager, Paladin, Barracuda, Serpent, Dragonslayer, Bermuda, Haven, Dreadnought, Longbow, Maelstrom and Epoch. It is offered only where the builder reaches deep water. Its 600 build power keeps up with a tier-2 sea economy; a Construction Ship (armcs) assisting doubles its output.

armatl.name: Moray
armatl.gloss: 1000-metal tier-2 torpedo launcher, 780-damage homing torpedoes at 915; kills ships and subs; nothing against land or air
armatl.prose: The Moray is the tier-2 torpedo launcher on water: 1000 metal and 8500 energy, 2800 health, a 780-damage homing torpedo every 2.2 seconds at range 915 with 400 sonar. It out-ranges tier-1 ships and kills submarines and raiders like the Maelstrom (armlship); it cannot hit land or air. The Advanced Construction Sub (armacsub) builds it.

armatlas.name: Stork
armatlas.gloss: tier-1 light air transport; carries one tier-1 or light tier-2 land unit, not the commander; dies to anti-air
armatlas.prose: The Stork is the light transport: 68 metal, 265 health, speed 207, carries one land unit of tier 1 or light tier 2, not the commander and not heavies like the Fatboy (armfboy). It drops units past a defensive line, moves a constructor to a far spot, and lifts a Construction Turret (armnanotc) to wherever build power is needed. Scout for anti-air before a drop; anything that shoots air kills it and its cargo.

armavp.name: Advanced Vehicle Plant
armavp.gloss: tier-2 vehicle plant, 2600 metal, 600 build power; makes the advanced constructor vehicle, Bull, Starlight, Mauser and the rest
armavp.prose: The Advanced Vehicle Plant is the tier-2 vehicle factory: 2600 metal and 14000 energy, 4750 health, 600 build power, making the Advanced Construction Vehicle (armacv), Consul, Turtle, Jaguar, Bull, Gremlin, Mauser, Ambassador, Starlight, Shredder, Prophet and Umbra. A tier-1 constructor builds it; the entry costs and timing are the same as the advanced bot lab's (about 3000 metal, +30 metal and +500 energy a second), and it is the choice on flat open ground where heavy tanks and artillery pay. Its 600 build power and the heavy units it makes need an economy of +30 metal and +500 energy a second to keep it busy.

armawac.name: Oracle
armawac.gloss: tier-2 radar and sonar plane, 2500 radar and 1200 sonar at speed 317; finds targets for bombers; unarmed
armawac.prose: The Oracle is the flying radar: 175 metal, 890 health, speed 317, 2500 radar and 1200 sonar, no weapon. Flown ahead of a bombing run or over the sea it shows everything in the air, on the ground and under water within its range, and radar sees a cloaked commander. Fighters kill it.

armbanth.name: Titan
armbanth.air: 1052 dps against aircraft (72% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
armbanth.gloss: 13500-metal walking fortress; blasters, tachyon beam at 800; loses to air, EMP and being D-gunned
armbanth.prose: The Titan is Armada's heaviest land unit: 13500 metal, 69000 health, speed 46, close-range blasters and rockets plus a 6000-damage tachyon beam at range 800 that costs 1300 energy a shot. It walks through tier-1 and tier-2 armies and crosses water on the sea floor. It has almost no anti-air, so bombers and gunships kill it, EMP stuns it, and a cloaked commander's D-gun kills it in one shot; it also needs the energy to fire. It comes from the Experimental Gantry (armshltx) and is a decision to spend a whole tier-2 economy on one unit.

armbats.name: Dreadnought
armbats.gloss: 3300-metal battleship, plasma at 880; kills ships and bombards inland; shredded by battle submarines
armbats.prose: The Dreadnought is the tier-2 battleship: 3300 metal, 9800 health, speed 58, heavy plasma cannons doing 600 damage a second at range 880. It wins ship-to-ship fights and bombards a shore far inland. It has nothing against submarines, and a Kraken (corssub) shreds it, so it sails with Barracudas (armsubk) and a Dragonslayer (armaas).

armbeamer.name: Beamer
armbeamer.air: 20 dps against aircraft (8% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
armbeamer.gloss: 190-metal beam turret, 266 dps at 490; out-ranges rocket bots, fires over walls; 60 energy a second firing
armbeamer.prose: The Beamer is a continuous-beam laser tower: 190 metal and 1500 energy, 1430 health, 266 damage a second at range 490 with the damage halving at full range, 6 energy a tenth of a second while firing. Its range beats the rocket bots (475), which makes it the tower that a rocket group cannot kill for free, and it is tall enough to fire over walls; it is the anti-swarm choice between the Sentry (armllt) and the Overwatch (armhlt). It stops firing in an energy stall.

armbeaver.name: Beaver
armbeaver.gloss: amphibious tier-1 constructor, 80 build power; builds on land and the sea floor, including naval buildings; unarmed
armbeaver.prose: The Beaver is a 150-metal amphibious constructor (1030 health, speed 42, 80 build power) that builds on land and under water and has the naval buildings on its list: shipyard, torpedo launcher, tidal generator, hovercraft platform, as well as the land base. It is the builder for a map with water in it and the one that expands between islands. It is unarmed and slow, and dies to any raider.

armblade.name: Hornet
armblade.gloss: 1250-metal fast assault gunship, sabot rockets at 420 that pass shields; kills commanders and key units under light AA
armblade.prose: The Hornet is the heavy assault gunship: 1250 metal, 3000 health, speed 204, twin sabot rockets doing 168 damage a second at range 420 that pass through plasma shields. It is fast enough and tough enough to reach a commander or a key unit under moderate anti-air and kill it, which is its whole use; it lacks a bomber's area damage, and enemy fighters kill it without a fighter screen. Too expensive to mass before a late economy.

armbrawl.name: Roughneck
armbrawl.gloss: tier-2 gunship, 107 dps at 380, 1780 health; defends your own air space, dies to flak and fighters
armbrawl.prose: The Roughneck is a rapid-fire gunship: 310 metal, 1780 health, speed 161, plasma doing 107 damage a second at range 380. It kills skirmishers and artillery caught in the open and a group of them threatens tier-3 units, but it is for defending inside your own air cover, not for assaulting a base: flak, fighters and heavy anti-air kill it and it is too slow to escape them. It has more armour and less punch than the Wasp (corape).

armbrtha.name: Basilica
armbrtha.gloss: 4500-metal long-range cannon, 1625 damage at 4650 for 5000 energy a shot; shells across the map; a priority target
armbrtha.prose: The Basilica is the long-range plasma cannon: 4500 metal and 64000 energy, 4450 health, a 1625-damage shell every 13 seconds at range 4650 for 5000 energy. It reaches across most maps, out-ranges any ship or amphibious unit, and it is the anti-naval battery of a coast; it fires faster than the Basilisk (corint) with less punch and splash. A Keeper (armgate) shield stops its shells at a large energy cost to the shielder. Once built it is the enemy's first target.

armbull.name: Bull
armbull.gloss: tier-2 heavy tank, 4650 health, 270-damage plasma at 460; wins mid-range fights, needs a tank-killer beside it
armbull.prose: The Bull is the general-purpose tier-2 tank: 950 metal, 4650 health, speed 62, a 270-damage plasma shot every 1.1 seconds at range 460 with a splash. It dominates mid-range fights against tier-1 and light tier-2 and shields the units behind it; against other heavy tanks it needs a Starlight (armmanni) beside it, and the cheaper Tiger (correap) out-lasts it for the metal. Nine hundred and fifty metal is not a unit to send alone.

armca.name: Construction Aircraft
armca.gloss: tier-1 constructor aircraft, 50 build power at speed 136; expands anywhere, builds the advanced aircraft plant; fragile
armca.prose: The Construction Aircraft is the fastest builder: 110 metal, 156 health, speed 136, 50 build power, no weapon. It flies over terrain to claim far extractors and to reclaim, and its list is the tier-1 base plus the advanced aircraft plant (armaap) and the heavy turrets; its build power is low, so use several on one job. Any anti-air or fighter kills it at once.

armch.name: Construction Hovercraft
armch.gloss: tier-1 constructor hovercraft, 110 build power; builds on land and water including naval buildings; unarmed
armch.prose: The Construction Hovercraft is a 200-metal amphibious constructor (1440 health, speed 67, 110 build power) with the largest build list of any tier-1 builder: the whole land base plus the naval buildings. It has more build power than the constructor bot or vehicle and crosses water, so it expands early onto islands and shores. It is unarmed.

armcir.name: Chainsaw
armcir.gloss: 750-metal medium-range anti-air battery, four-missile bursts at 1200, 4450 health; the tower that kills most aircraft
armcir.prose: The Chainsaw is the heavy tier-1 anti-air battery: 750 metal and 7300 energy, 4450 health, four-missile bursts at range 1200 for aircraft only, and built to survive bombs. It has the most health, range and damage of the tier-1 and tier-2 anti-air towers and takes down most aircraft, the Liche (armliche) included; it is dearer than the Nettle (armrl) and Ferret (armferret) and does nothing against ground. It is the anti-air to build once the enemy has shown bombers or gunships rather than scouts; earlier the Nettle (armrl) does.

armck.name: Construction Bot
armck.gloss: tier-1 constructor bot, 80 build power; builds the base, the advanced lab and turrets; unarmed
armck.prose: The Construction Bot is the ordinary tier-1 builder: 110 metal, 80 build power, speed 36, 760 health, no weapon. It builds everything the commander can plus the advanced bot lab (armalab), the heavy turrets and the geothermal plant, and it can assist any factory or repair anything. It dies to any raider that finds it alone, so expansion goes in steps the army already covers, and a constructor walking to a far spot without an escort is usually a dead constructor. Two or three of them on one project add their build power together; a lab costs 500 metal at 950 build time, so one constructor takes twelve seconds a hundred metal.

armckfus.name: Cloakable Fusion Reactor
armckfus.gloss: tier-2 cloakable fusion, 750 energy a second for 3550 metal; hides from the enemy for 50 energy a second
armckfus.prose: The Cloakable Fusion Reactor is a Fusion Reactor (armfus) that can cloak: 750 energy a second for 3550 metal and 22000 energy, 3800 health, and the cloak costs 50 energy a second while on. It is for a fusion in a place bombers and artillery would find; the output is the same as the plain fusion's, less the cloak. Only the tier-2 constructors build it, and it explodes like any fusion when destroyed.

armclaw.name: Dragon's Claw
armclaw.gloss: 340-metal pop-up lightning turret at 430 disguised as a wall; chains through packed units at a choke
armclaw.prose: The Dragon's Claw is a pop-up lightning turret: 340 metal and 1600 energy, 1330 health, a lightning burst doing 159 damage a second at range 430 that jumps between packed units, 10 energy a shot. Popped down it looks like a block of Dragon's Teeth (armdrag) and is nearly impossible to shell, so mixed into a wall at a choke it surprises a massed push; clustered, several stop a tank assault. It needs energy to fire.

armcom.name: Armada Commander
armcom.air: 188 dps against aircraft, its full damage
armcom.gloss: the one unit you cannot lose; builds the base, D-guns anything at 250, laser at 300
armcom.prose: The Armada Commander starts the game as your only unit and the game ends when it dies, so it is both your first builder and your last line. It has 300 build power (a tier-1 constructor has 80), makes 30 energy a second on its own, stores 500 of each resource, and its build list is the whole tier-1 base: extractors, solar and wind, a bot lab, vehicle plant, aircraft plant or shipyard, the light turrets, radar, storage and converters. Its laser does 187 damage a second at range 300 and its D-gun kills any unit outright at range 250 for 500 energy a shot, so a lone raiding party of Pawns (armpw) or Grunts (corak) walking into it dies; it still loses to a real army, to artillery it cannot reach, and to being far from home when the enemy arrives. With 3700 health it is the toughest thing you own for the first ten minutes, which is why a commander standing beside its outposts is the cheapest defence there is. It can cloak (100 energy a second standing, 1000 moving) and walk under water, and when it dies it explodes with enough force to level everything around it.

armconsul.name: Consul
armconsul.gloss: fast tier-2 engineer, 150 build power at speed 78; builds tier-1 basics, mines, walls and naval buildings; unarmed
armconsul.prose: The Consul is a 250-metal combat engineer: 1080 health, speed 78, 150 build power, a tier-1 build list plus mines, walls and the naval buildings, so it can lay a shipyard without a naval builder. It brings build power to a forward lab or a repair job quickly and mines a flank. It has no weapon and dies to anything that catches it.

armcroc.name: Turtle
armcroc.air: 35 dps against aircraft (25% of its ground damage)
armcroc.gloss: tier-2 heavy amphibious tank, 5000 health, cannon at 480 and light anti-air; crosses water, resists EMP
armcroc.prose: The Turtle is a 750-metal amphibious heavy tank: 5000 health, speed 54, a 225-damage cannon every 1.6 seconds at range 480 and a light anti-air missile at 765, with bot-like slope tolerance and 279 sonar. It has more health and range than a Bull (armbull) and crosses water to reach an expansion from behind, beating tier-1 units, rocket bots and plasma units; against heavy resistance it falters. It takes only a fifth of EMP damage.

armcrus.name: Paladin
armcrus.air: 24 dps against aircraft (7% of its ground damage)
armcrus.gloss: tier-2 cruiser, gauss and lasers at 500, depth charges; the tier-2 fleet's mainstay, kills any tier-1 ship, no anti-air
armcrus.prose: The Paladin is the tier-2 cruiser: 1000 metal, 5600 health, speed 60, a gauss cannon and two lasers doing 357 damage a second at range 500, with depth charges for submarines and 375 sonar. It beats any tier-1 ship and hovercraft in particular and it is fast for tier 2, so it rushes the early tier-2 sea. It is defenceless against aircraft and a Shuriken (corbw) stun leaves it dead in the water; keep a Dragonslayer (armaas) beside it.

armcs.name: Construction Ship
armcs.gloss: tier-1 constructor ship, 125 build power; builds naval and underwater buildings and the advanced shipyard; unarmed
armcs.prose: The Construction Ship is the sea builder: 200 metal, 1040 health, speed 65, 125 build power, no weapon. It claims underwater metal spots, builds the naval defences and economy, and the Advanced Shipyard (armasy) is on its list; one assisting a shipyard nearly doubles its output. Anything that shoots at ships kills it.

armcsa.name: Construction Seaplane
armcsa.gloss: tier-1 constructor seaplane, 75 build power at speed 124; builds land and naval buildings, repairs ships; unarmed
armcsa.prose: The Construction Seaplane is a 150-metal flying constructor (405 health, speed 124, 75 build power) that lands on water and can submerge. It builds the land base and the naval buildings and its speed makes it the repairer for ships at the front. Fighters kill it easily.

armcv.name: Construction Vehicle
armcv.gloss: tier-1 constructor vehicle, 90 build power; builds the base and the advanced vehicle plant; slow uphill, unarmed
armcv.prose: The Construction Vehicle is the vehicle plant's builder: 135 metal, 1380 health, speed 54, 90 build power, no weapon. It has more health and build power than the constructor bot but climbs poorly, so it expands on flat ground. Its list is the tier-1 base plus the advanced vehicle plant (armavp) and the heavy turrets; several on one job add their build power. It dies to any raider that finds it alone.

armdecade.name: Dolphin
armdecade.air: 30 dps against aircraft (22% of its ground damage)
armdecade.gloss: tier-1 fast corvette, speed 105, 135 dps at 280; kills constructors and swarms heavier ships from the sides
armdecade.prose: The Dolphin is the fast assault corvette: 175 metal, 970 health, speed 105, plasma guns doing 135 damage a second at range 280. It kills constructors and light craft early and in numbers overruns a destroyer; its guns cannot fire over each other, so it fights broadside on. It hits harder but less accurately than the Supporter (coresupp), and torpedo launchers and destroyers kill it at range.

armdecom.name: Commander
armdecom.air: 188 dps against aircraft, its full damage
armdecom.gloss: a look-alike commander with a weak D-gun and 300 build power; bait and front-line builder
armdecom.prose: The Decoy Commander looks like the real Armada Commander to the enemy, with the same 3700 health and speed, but costs 770 metal, and its D-gun does only 40 damage a shot for 150 energy. Its use is to draw fire and D-gun shots meant for the real commander and to bring 300 build power to the front, where it can build the tier-1 basics, walls and mines. It cannot win a fight against an army and dies to anything the real commander would; it is built from the advanced bot lab (armalab) once the enemy has shown it will hunt commanders. Like the real one it can cloak and walk under water.

armdf.name: Decoy Fusion Reactor
armdf.gloss: a fake fusion for 270 metal that makes nothing; draws bombers away from the real one
armdf.prose: The Decoy Fusion Reactor looks like a Fusion Reactor (armfus) to the enemy but makes no energy: 270 metal and 100 energy, 3800 health. Its use is to draw bombers and artillery onto itself while fighters kill them; it is worth building only once the enemy has shown it bombs fusions. It is cheap enough that two or three among the real fusions make every bombing run a gamble.

armdfly.name: Abductor
armdfly.gloss: stealthy armed heavy transport; EMP beam stuns a heavy unit, then it loads and steals it; dies to fighters
armdfly.prose: The Abductor is a heavy transport with an EMP beam: 320 metal, 1170 health, speed 210, invisible to radar (and so is its cargo), carrying tier-2 units and tier-1 turrets. Its beam at range 520 paralyses a unit for six seconds, long enough to load it and fly away with it, which is how a Mammoth (corsumo) changes sides; it also inserts a force covertly. It survives light anti-air only, and fighters kill it quickly.

armdl.name: Anemone
armdl.gloss: 240-metal coastal torpedo launcher on land, 150 dps at 600 with sonar; guards shore buildings from ships and subs
armdl.prose: The Anemone is the coastal torpedo launcher, built on the shore: 240 metal and 2200 energy, 2200 health, a 225-damage torpedo every 1.5 seconds at range 600 and 600 sonar. It defends shoreline buildings against ships and submarines and cannot hit land, air or hovercraft. The commander can build it.

armdrag.name: Dragon's Teeth
armdrag.gloss: 8-metal wall block with 2800 health; funnels tier-1 units and stops low shots; tier-2 tanks roll over it
armdrag.prose: The Dragon's Teeth is an 8-metal wall block with 2800 health. A line of them blocks most tier-1 units and low projectiles, funnels a push into a Pounder's (corlevlr) or a tower's fire, and keeps spy bots out of a base; heavy tier-2 tanks crush it. Enemies do not target it automatically, so it is reclaimed or shot by hand. It costs nothing worth counting.

armemp.name: Paralyzer
armemp.gloss: 1600-metal EMP missile launcher, stockpiled rockets stun everything in a blast at 3650 for 35 s; no damage
armemp.prose: The Paralyzer is a stockpiling EMP launcher: 1600 metal and 29000 energy, 3350 health, rockets with range 3650 that paralyse everything in the blast for 35 seconds without damaging it, each round 500 metal and 15644 energy and 65 seconds to build, up to ten stored. It freezes a defensive line before an assault or a pushing army while a reaction force is built; it stuns friends in the blast too. It fires by hand.

armepoch.name: Epoch
armepoch.air: 353 dps against aircraft (28% of its ground damage)
armepoch.gloss: 20000-metal flagship, five plasma turrets to 2450, anti-air; ends a sea game, needs escort against subs and torpedo bombers
armepoch.prose: The Epoch is the flagship: 20000 metal, 50000 health, speed 54, five plasma turrets with range 2450, anti-air missiles and flak. Its reach outranges everything on the sea and bombards a coast from beyond reply; once one is afloat the naval game is usually decided. Torpedo bombers and battle submarines are what kill it, so it never sails without submarine killers and anti-air. Face targets head on so every cannon fires.

armestor.name: Energy Storage
armestor.gloss: 6000 energy storage for 170 metal; smooths wind and lets laser turrets fire through a lull; explodes when killed
armestor.prose: The Energy Storage adds 6000 energy storage for 170 metal and 1700 energy, 1890 health. Storage is what lets a wind economy ride out a lull and what keeps laser turrets and beam weapons firing: a tower line fires at the rate energy arrives once the store is empty. It explodes with a large blast when destroyed and a larger one on self-destruct, so it stands away from the base, or on an approach as a deliberate bomb.

armeyes.name: Beholder
armeyes.gloss: 32-metal cloaked camera with 560 sight, buildable on cliffs; a picket line that catches cloaked movement
armeyes.prose: The Beholder is a tiny cloaked observation post: 32 metal and 850 energy, 280 health, 560 sight, invisible to radar, cloaked for 13 energy a second, buildable almost anywhere including steep cliffs. Staggered lines of them across a gap watch what jammers hide and catch a cloaked unit walking through, since sight sees what radar cannot; it cannot itself see cloaked units, and a Juno (armjuno) pulse kills it outright. It draws 3 energy a second uncloaked and 13 cloaked, so a picket line is a small standing cost.

armfark.name: Butler
armfark.gloss: fast 140-build-power assist and repair bot; builds a few tier-1 basics; unarmed and fragile
armfark.prose: The Butler is a fast tier-2 builder for assisting and repairing: 210 metal, 335 health, speed 75, 140 build power, and a short build list of solar, wind, extractor, converter, camera, radar bot and jammer bot. It gets build power to a lab or a forward repair job quickly and is otherwise a constructor that cannot build most things. It is unarmed and dies to anything, so it is worth building only when build power, not metal, is what holds the factories back.

armfast.name: Sprinter
armfast.air: 40 dps against aircraft (33% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
armfast.gloss: tier-2 fast raider bot (speed 111); 120 dps at 230; kills what is unguarded, loses stand-up fights
armfast.prose: The Sprinter is the tier-2 raider: 160 metal, 690 health, speed 111, rapid plasma doing 120 damage a second at range 230. Its speed lets it get behind a line to extractors, constructors and artillery and get out again; in a straight fight it loses to any line unit and it is three Pawns' (armpw) metal, so it is for raiding, not for the front. In the simulated tier-2 study it never beat the tier-1 line at equal metal, which is the point: it earns its cost only against what cannot shoot back.

armfatf.name: Naval Pinpointer
armfatf.gloss: the targeting facility built on water, 800 metal, 150 energy a second
armfatf.prose: The Naval Pinpointer is the Pinpointer (armtarg) built on water: 800 metal and 7300 energy, 1610 health, halving radar-dot wobble for the whole team for 150 energy a second, stacking with diminishing returns. The Advanced Construction Sub (armacsub) builds it. It is a late buy for a fleet with long-range guns to guide.

armfav.name: Rover
armfav.air: 2 dps against aircraft (6% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
armfav.gloss: 31-metal scout car, speed 168, sight 635; finds the enemy and kills bare extractors; dies to anything
armfav.prose: The Rover is the vehicle plant's scout: 31 metal, 105 health, speed 168, sight 635, a 35-damage laser at range 180. It finds the enemy's expansion and kills extractors and constructors nobody guards, and a group of them draws fire from artillery and snipers that cannot track it. Any armed unit or turret kills it, and it cannot hit aircraft. Build one or two early for the map; more only when the enemy leaves its economy bare.

armfboy.name: Fatboy
armfboy.gloss: 1400-metal plasma bot, 800-damage shell with 300 area at 700; kills packed armies, slow and alone it dies
armfboy.prose: The Fatboy is a heavy tier-2 plasma bot: 1400 metal, 7800 health, speed 30, an 800-damage shell every 7 seconds at range 700 with a 300-wide splash. It exists to hit grouped units and lines of turrets at a range only plasma batteries beat; against spread raiders its shell wastes itself, and at speed 30 it needs a line in front. The simulated tier-2 study shows its area shell as Armada's only answer to a tower line, but the simulator over-rates area damage in packed formations, so treat the number as an upper bound.

armfdrag.name: Shark's Teeth
armfdrag.gloss: 15-metal naval wall block with 4450 health; funnels tier-1 ships and blocks low shots
armfdrag.prose: The Shark's Teeth is a 15-metal wall block on water with 4450 health. A line blocks most tier-1 ships and low projectiles, funnels a fleet into a torpedo launcher's fire and shields floating towers; heavier ships and aircraft ignore it. It costs nothing worth counting and takes a beating before it breaks.

armferret.name: Ferret
armferret.gloss: 330-metal pop-up anti-air missile battery at 950; kills bombers and gunships, hides when idle; nothing against ground
armferret.prose: The Ferret is the pop-up anti-air missile battery: 330 metal and 5700 energy, 1600 health, fast missiles at range 950 for aircraft only, retracting out of sight when idle and invisible to radar. It is the mid-cost anti-air that kills bombers and gunships rather than just scouts, and it hides from air scouts until they are in range. Against ground it does nothing.

armfflak.name: Naval Arbalest
armfflak.gloss: the tier-2 flak gun on water, 820 metal, wide bursts at 850 against aircraft
armfflak.prose: The Naval Arbalest is the Arbalest (armflak) built on water: 820 metal and 13000 energy, 1750 health, flak at range 850 that shatters groups of aircraft over a naval base. It does nothing against ships or ground. It is the naval base's answer to massed bombers once they have been seen.

armfhlt.name: Manta
armfhlt.air: 58 dps against aircraft (25% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
armfhlt.gloss: 470-metal floating heavy laser tower, 233 dps at 630, 40 energy a shot; kills light ships, useless against subs
armfhlt.prose: The Manta is the heavy laser tower built on water: 470 metal and 6200 energy, 4250 health, a 210-damage beam every 0.9 seconds (233 a second) at range 630, 40 energy a shot, halving at full range. It kills corvettes, frigates and hovertanks and is sturdier than the land Overwatch (armhlt); it cannot hit submarines and alone it is a target, so it stands with torpedo launchers. It stops in an energy stall.

armfhp.name: Naval Hovercraft Platform
armfhp.gloss: tier-1 hovercraft platform on water, 670 metal; the same hovercraft as the land platform
armfhp.prose: The Naval Hovercraft Platform is the water-built version of the Hovercraft Platform (armhp): 670 metal and 2000 energy, 3350 health, 150 build power, the same five hovercraft. It is offered only where the builder finds water deep enough; build it when the land platform's site is not safe or not there. It makes the same units at the same rate and costs the same; only the site differs.

armfido.name: Hound
armfido.air: 11 dps against aircraft (14% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
armfido.gloss: tier-2 skirmish bot; 650-range mortar outranges every tower but plasma batteries; fast for its range
armfido.prose: The Hound is a fast skirmisher with a 255-damage mortar every 3.3 seconds at range 650: 285 metal, 1200 health, speed 69. Its range beats the heavy laser towers (620) and every tier-1 unit, and its speed lets it keep that distance, so it kills lines that cannot reach it; its shell has a 72 area, so it is best against packed groups and worst against spread raiders. It fires further than it sees (400), so it needs radar or a spotter to use its range. The simulated tier-2 study puts a Welder (armzeus) and Hound mix, a third of the army each, at +0.3 to +0.5 against the opponent's minute-20 army where the tier-1 line alone scores +0.1; the Hound's number rests on area damage the simulator over-rates in tight formations.

armfig.name: Falcon
armfig.gloss: tier-1 fighter, speed 289, missiles at 680 against aircraft only; the answer to enemy air, useless against ground
armfig.prose: The Falcon is the tier-1 fighter: 73 metal, 167 health, speed 289, a homing missile at range 680 that hurts only aircraft. It is the most effective tier-1 air defence because it reaches any part of the map, and a patrol of them in front of the base stops scouts, Banshees (armkam) and bombers; sent ahead of a bombing run they break the enemy's fighter wall. It cannot hit ground at all. Build them once enemy aircraft have been seen.

armflak.name: Arbalest
armflak.gloss: 820-metal tier-2 flak gun at 850; wide bursts shatter groups of aircraft; nothing against ground
armflak.prose: The Arbalest is the tier-2 flak gun: 820 metal and 13000 energy, 1750 health, rapid flak at range 850 whose wide bursts shatter most aircraft in a formation. It is the answer to massed bombers and gunships around a base or on a front; missile anti-air reaches further and flak kills groups. Only the tier-2 constructors and the Consul (armconsul) build it, and it does nothing against ground.

armflash.name: Blitz
armflash.air: 20 dps against aircraft (22% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
armflash.gloss: fast tier-1 raider tank (speed 101), 90 dps at 180; kills economy and rocket bots, dies to Pounders
armflash.prose: The Blitz is the tier-1 raider of the vehicle plant: 110 metal, 730 health, speed 101, rapid plasma doing 90 damage a second at range 180. It is the fastest thing the plant makes and it kills extractors, constructors, radar and the enemy's rocket bots, which it beat in equal-metal duels; a pack running round a slow line to the artillery behind it is its best use on a flat map. It loses head on to the Pounder (corlevlr) worst of all, to the Thug (corthud) and Mace (armham), and to any turret. Its plasma does almost nothing to aircraft.

armflea.name: Tick
armflea.air: 3 dps against aircraft (8% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
armflea.gloss: 21-metal scout; sees 600, dies to anything; finds the enemy and kills unguarded extractors
armflea.prose: The Tick is the cheapest and fastest thing in the game: 21 metal, speed 132, sight 600, 60 health. It is for finding the enemy base and its expansion in the first minutes and for killing extractors that nobody guards; its laser does 40 damage a second at range 140, so three of them kill a tier-1 extractor (270 health) in a couple of seconds. It loses to any armed unit, to a single Sentry (armllt) and to the commander's laser, and it cannot hit aircraft. Build one or two early for the map and the raid timing; a handful more only when the enemy leaves extractors bare.

armfmine3.name: Heavy Mine
armfmine3.gloss: 32-metal cloaked naval mine; blows up an unsuspecting ship and everything near it
armfmine3.prose: The naval Heavy Mine is a 32-metal cloaked mine on water (4 energy a second) that explodes on contact with a ship and damages everything nearby. A field of them laid by a Voyager (armmls) holds hovercraft and light ships off an area; keep your own ships off it. It is cloaked, so an enemy without sonar or a minesweeper finds it by hitting it.

armfmkr.name: Naval Energy Converter
armfmkr.gloss: the energy converter on water, 70 energy a second into 1 metal; for maps with little land
armfmkr.prose: The Naval Energy Converter is the Energy Converter (armmakr) built on water: 70 energy a second into 1 metal a second for 1 metal and 1150 energy, 167 health. It is for a surplus of energy on a sea base; it chains explosions when clustered. Extractors and tidal generators beat it while spots and tide remain, as on land.

armfort.name: Fortification Wall
armfort.gloss: 40-metal tier-2 wall with 8900 health; stops tier-1 and tier-2 units and low shots; tier-3 plows through
armfort.prose: The Fortification Wall is the tier-2 wall: 40 metal and 500 energy, 8900 health, nearly four times a Dragon's Teeth's (armdrag). It blocks tier-1 and tier-2 units and low-flying projectiles and shields the towers behind it, which fire over it; tier-3 units plow through it, and it stops a Pit Bull (armpb) from firing. Only the tier-2 constructors and the Consul (armconsul) build it.

armfrad.name: Naval Radar / Sonar Tower
armfrad.gloss: 130-metal radar and sonar tower on water, 2100 radar and 900 sonar
armfrad.prose: The Naval Radar / Sonar Tower is the Radar Tower (armrad) for water: 130 metal and 1000 energy, 110 health, 2100 radar and 900 sonar. It is the early warning of a naval base for aircraft, ships and submarines alike. It is the first sensor a sea base builds, and at 110 health the first thing a raid kills.

armfrt.name: Naval Nettle
armfrt.gloss: the light anti-air tower on water, 80 metal, missiles at 765; early cover for a naval base
armfrt.prose: The Naval Nettle is the Nettle (armrl) built on water: 80 metal and 900 energy, 330 health, missiles at range 765 for aircraft only. A few protect a naval base from early raids; a swarm gets past one alone. Build it once enemy aircraft have been seen over the water, not before.

armfus.name: Fusion Reactor
armfus.gloss: tier-2 fusion, 750 energy a second for 3350 metal; dense steady energy, follows the extractor upgrades; explodes
armfus.prose: The Fusion Reactor makes 750 energy a second for 3350 metal and 18000 energy, with 3800 health and 2500 energy storage; only the tier-2 constructors build it, at 54000 build time (four minutes for one advanced constructor, so it needs helpers). At 4.5 metal per energy a second it is no cheaper than advanced solar or wind on a windy map; its value is density, steadiness and builder time, which is why it follows the extractor upgrades rather than preceding them. It is a favourite bomber target and it explodes when destroyed, so it stands apart from the base under anti-air.

armgate.name: Keeper
armgate.gloss: 3000-metal plasma shield, radius 550, 6175 shield health; stops plasma artillery, not bombs, lasers or missiles
armgate.prose: The Keeper is a shield generator: 3000 metal and 54000 energy, 3550 health, a plasma shield of radius 550 with 6175 shield health that regenerates at 130 a second for 562 energy a second. It deflects plasma artillery and long-range cannon shells and takes a great deal before it drops; bombs, lasers and missiles pass straight through it. A few around a base answer an artillery barrage; each costs more than half a fusion to keep charged.

armgeo.name: Geothermal Powerplant
armgeo.gloss: 300 energy a second for 560 metal, only on a steam vent; explodes when killed
armgeo.prose: The Geothermal Powerplant makes 300 energy a second for 560 metal and 13000 energy, 1940 health, and can stand only on one of the map's steam vents. Where a vent is safe it is a tier-1 economy's biggest single generator; a tier-1 constructor builds it. It explodes when destroyed, and it is a target worth a raid.

armgmm.name: Prude
armgmm.gloss: tier-2 safe geothermal, 750 energy a second on a vent, 13900 health; a small blast when killed
armgmm.prose: The Prude is the tier-2 geothermal plant for a vent near the fight: 750 energy a second for 1150 metal and 25000 energy, with 13900 health and a small death explosion instead of the base-levelling one. It gives fusion's output for a third of the metal on a vent you can hold; the Advanced Geothermal Powerplant (armageo) gives more on a safe vent. Its 13900 health makes it the one energy building that survives a raid, which is what the extra metal buys.

armgremlin.name: Gremlin
armgremlin.air: 8 dps against aircraft (9% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
armgremlin.gloss: cloaked stealth tank, 262 damage every 3 s at 220; spots, sabotages, kills commanders in fours
armgremlin.prose: The Gremlin is a 230-metal cloaked, radar-invisible tank (1060 health, speed 70) with a 262-damage gauss shot every 3 seconds at range 220; cloak costs 5 energy a second standing and 20 moving, and it uncloaks near enemies. It is a scout and saboteur: it spots for Mausers (armmart) and Starlights (armmanni), kills key buildings, and a pack of four to six kills an unaware commander. In an open fight against tier-2 units it dies. It takes a fifth of EMP damage.

armguard.name: Gauntlet
armguard.gloss: 1250-metal plasma battery, 300-damage shells at 1220; kills extractors, radar and turrets behind the line; needs a spotter
armguard.prose: The Gauntlet is the tier-1 plasma artillery battery: 1250 metal and 12500 energy, 3050 health, a 300-damage shell every 2.85 seconds at range 1220 with a modest splash, switching between a flat and a high arc to hit behind obstacles. It out-ranges every unit and turret short of the long-range cannons and it is what shells the enemy's forward extractors, radar, jammers and construction turrets once the front is set; it needs scouts or radar to see that far. It is a lot of tier-1 metal that does not move; reclaim it when its targets are gone. The opponent's medium setting builds one or two of these only around minute 30.

armham.name: Mace
armham.air: 12 dps against aircraft (20% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
armham.gloss: the tier-1 line bot; plasma at 380, wins most equal-metal fights, loses to Pounders and kiting
armham.prose: The Mace is the unit tier-1 Armada fights with: 130 metal, 1000 health, speed 46, a 104-damage plasma shot every 1.7 seconds at range 380. In equal-metal duels head on it won most tier-1 matchups, beating the Grunt (corak), Aggravator (corstorm), Thug (corthud), Incisor (corgator), Brute (corraid), Stout (armstump) and both light turrets; it loses to the Pounder (corlevlr) heavily and to artillery it cannot reach. It is slow, so raiders go round it and it cannot catch them; it is the anchor of a line, not the chaser. Its plasma gains range from high ground. Build it as the default line unit, with Pawns (armpw) only for raiding and Rocketeers (armrock) only for turrets.

armhawk.name: Highwind
armhawk.gloss: tier-2 stealth fighter, speed 358, missiles at 740; invisible to radar; kills heavy and massed aircraft
armhawk.prose: The Highwind is the tier-2 fighter: 150 metal, 370 health, speed 358, homing missiles at range 740 for aircraft only, and invisible to radar so the enemy cannot count them. It kills heavy aircraft and groups of them, and sent ahead of bombers it opens a gap in the enemy fighter wall. It cannot hit ground.

armhlt.name: Overwatch
armhlt.air: 19 dps against aircraft (9% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
armhlt.gloss: 440-metal heavy laser tower, 215 dps at 620, 2600 health; out-ranges every tier-1 unit but artillery
armhlt.prose: The Overwatch is the tier-1 heavy laser tower: 440 metal and 4700 energy, 2600 health, a 387-damage beam every 1.8 seconds (215 a second) at range 620, 75 energy a shot. It out-ranges every tier-1 land unit except the artillery vehicles (710) and the tier-2 skirmishers, so it kills rocket bots, missile trucks and the support bots behind a line, and it out-ranges enemy laser towers; the Warden (corhlt) hits lighter and faster. A single one alone is a target for Shellshockers (armart); it needs cheaper towers and units beside it, and it stops in an energy stall. Counting a turret as about three times its metal in a fight is the rule the record supports.

armhp.name: Hovercraft Platform
armhp.gloss: tier-1 hovercraft platform on land, 670 metal; makes the construction hovercraft, Seeker, Crocodile, Possum, Sweeper
armhp.prose: The Hovercraft Platform is the land-built hovercraft factory: 670 metal and 2000 energy, 3350 health, 150 build power, making the Construction Hovercraft (armch), Seeker, Crocodile, Possum and Sweeper. Hovercraft cross land and water alike, so the platform is the answer on a map where the enemy is across water and a shipyard is not wanted; its units are dearer than bots for what they fight. It is offered on any ground the builder can reach, unlike the shipyard, and its units are the only tier-1 way to reach an island economy without ships.

armhvytrans.name: Osprey
armhvytrans.gloss: tier-1 heavy air transport; carries the commander, heavy units and light turrets; slow and lightly armoured
armhvytrans.prose: The Osprey is the heavy transport: 190 metal, 630 health, speed 110, carries one unit including the commander, heavy tier-2 units and light turrets (Sentry, Beamer, Nettle, radar tower), so it can put a turret down without a constructor. It is slow for an aircraft and lightly armoured, and it dies with its cargo to fighters or flak. It is the cheapest way to move something slow across the map.

armjam.name: Umbra
armjam.gloss: tier-2 radar jammer vehicle, hides units within 450 from enemy radar for 80 energy a second; unarmed
armjam.prose: The Umbra is a 105-metal jammer vehicle: everything within 450 of it is hidden from enemy radar, for 80 energy a second. It goes with an army so the enemy sees nothing coming until the fight, and hides artillery from counter-fire; a Tracer (armsd) or Nemesis (corsd) sees through it. It has 510 health and no weapon.

armjamt.name: Sneaky Pete
armjamt.gloss: 240-metal jammer tower, hides units within 500 from enemy radar for 40 energy a second; unarmed
armjamt.prose: The Sneaky Pete is the tier-1 jammer tower: 240 metal and 8500 energy, 790 health, hiding everything within 500 from enemy radar for 40 energy a second. It keeps a forward position off the enemy's radar so artillery and long-range towers cannot target it; line of sight still sees through it. Its Cortex counterpart the Castro (corjamt) is cheaper with a shorter reach.

armjanus.name: Janus
armjanus.gloss: tier-1 twin rocket tank, 660 damage a volley with wide splash at 380; kills packed groups, poor vs swarms
armjanus.prose: The Janus fires two 330-damage rockets with a wide splash every 7.5 seconds at range 380: 240 metal, 1030 health, speed 54. Its volley kills packed groups and hurts medium tanks and commanders, and in tight-formation duels it was one of the better tier-1 units; spread the enemy out and it falls to the middle, since eight of its matchups change sign between packed and loose formations. It is the closest tier-1 matchup to the Pounder (corlevlr) but still loses to it, its rockets cannot track aircraft, and a long reload means fast cheap swarms get under it. Pair it with Stouts (armstump) in front and radar behind, since it cannot see as far as it shoots.

armjeth.name: Crossbow
armjeth.gloss: tier-1 anti-air bot; missiles at 760 only hurt aircraft, useless against ground; walks under water
armjeth.prose: The Crossbow is the tier-1 mobile anti-air: 125 metal, 630 health, speed 56, missiles at range 760 that do full damage to aircraft and 1 point to anything else, so it is nothing against ground units and a Pawn (armpw) kills it. It is worth building only after enemy aircraft or an aircraft plant have been seen; two or three walking with the army stop Banshees (armkam) and bombers from picking off the line. It can walk under water but cannot fire from there.

armjuno.name: Juno
armjuno.gloss: 640-metal Juno launcher; stockpiled pulses blow up radar, jammers, mines and scout swarms in a huge area; manual fire
armjuno.prose: The Juno stockpiles anti-electronics missiles: 640 metal and 17000 energy, 2350 health, each missile 12000 energy, fired by hand at range 32000 into a huge area where for about 25 seconds radar units, jammers, mines, cameras and scout spam like Ticks (armflea) explode. It is the answer to a minefield or a scout-spam opening and it clears the enemy's radar before a strike; friendly electronics in the blast die too, and spy bots are immune. It cloaks.

armkam.name: Banshee
armkam.gloss: tier-1 light gunship, 39 dps at 350; raids bare extractors and scouts; dies to any anti-air
armkam.prose: The Banshee is a light gunship: 135 metal, 560 health, speed 185, rapid plasma doing 39 damage a second at range 350. It raids extractors, radar and scouts that nothing guards, and it is better at that than a bomber; it cannot threaten a commander, a Thug (corthud) or a Brute (corraid), and any anti-air heavier than a Nettle (armrl), or a fighter, kills it. Confirm targets with a scout first and stop building them when the easy targets are gone.

armkraken.name: Gorgon
armkraken.gloss: 1000-metal floating rapid-fire plasma tower, 540 dps at 800; guards a coast against ships and hovercraft
armkraken.prose: The Gorgon is the tier-2 floating plasma tower: 1000 metal and 13000 energy, 4450 health, rapid 180-damage shells at range 800 (540 a second). It kills close-range ships and hovercraft and out-ranges most units below destroyer class, guarding submarines and submerged buildings from surface vessels; submarines and long-range ships beat it from below or beyond. The Advanced Construction Sub (armacsub) builds it.

armlab.name: Bot Lab
armlab.gloss: tier-1 bot factory, 500 metal, 150 build power; makes the constructor, Pawn, Mace, Rocketeer, Centurion, Tick, Lazarus, Crossbow
armlab.prose: The Bot Lab is the usual first factory: 500 metal and 950 energy, 2900 health, 150 build power, and it makes the eight tier-1 bots: Construction Bot (armck), Tick, Pawn, Rocketeer, Mace, Centurion, Crossbow and Lazarus. It draws about 80 energy a second while building, so a lab started before any generator empties the store and then builds at a crawl; a solar first, then the lab, is the shape that works. Its 150 build power turns into about 10 metal a second of bots, so an income above that needs a second lab or construction turrets. It is the opponent's favourite raid target after extractors.

armlance.name: Cormorant
armlance.gloss: tier-2 torpedo bomber, three 375-damage homing torpedoes; kills ships and submarines, nothing against land
armlance.prose: The Cormorant is the torpedo bomber: 400 metal, 1920 health, speed 285, three 375-damage torpedoes every 6 seconds, with its own sonar and long sight. It does massive damage to ships, submarines and amphibious units and nothing at all to land targets. The torpedoes need a long open stretch of water to drop into; a run over the shoreline sticks them in the sand. Naval anti-air and fighters kill it.

armlatnk.name: Jaguar
armlatnk.air: 43 dps against aircraft (29% of its ground damage)
armlatnk.gloss: fast tier-2 lightning tank (speed 90) with light anti-air; chains damage between close units; loses to heavy tanks
armlatnk.prose: The Jaguar is a fast tier-2 tank: 330 metal, 1060 health, speed 90, a lightning gun at range 300 doing 147 damage a second that jumps to nearby units, plus a light anti-air missile at 600. It clears swarms of raiders and guards long-range units against them, and it raids; it has no armour for a sustained fight and heavy tanks like the Tiger (correap) kill it. Its gun costs energy to fire.

armliche.name: Liche
armliche.gloss: 2200-metal atomic bomber, one 5625-damage huge-area bomb every 9 s; kills commanders, fusions and armies; dies to long-range AA
armliche.prose: The Liche is a heavy bomber with a tactical nuke: 2200 metal, 2300 health, speed 295, one 5625-damage bomb with a huge blast every 9 seconds. One pass kills a commander, a packed army or a fusion cluster (two Liches kill an advanced fusion). Long-range anti-air (Chainsaw armcir, Eradicator corerad, Mercury armmercury, Screamer corscreamer) kills it; fly it by hand at a located commander and around those.

armllt.name: Sentry
armllt.air: 11 dps against aircraft (7% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
armllt.gloss: 85-metal light laser tower, 161 dps at 430, 20 energy a shot; stops raiders, out-ranged by rockets
armllt.prose: The Sentry is the light laser tower: 85 metal and 680 energy, 620 health, a 75-damage beam every half second (161 a second) at range 430, 20 energy a shot. One beside an extractor is the cheapest way to stop a lone raider, and the opponent builds one beside nearly all of its own; where the fight's place is known a tower out-trades units, and where the enemy can walk round it it is wasted. It pays energy for every shot, so in a stall it stops firing, and a line of them fires only as fast as energy arrives. Rocketeers (armrock) and Aggravators (corstorm) out-range it by 45 and kill it from safety, a Lasher (cormist) does so untouched, Maces (armham) and Thugs (corthud) overpower it at equal metal, and Pawns (armpw) lose to it.

armlship.name: Maelstrom
armlship.air: 69 dps against aircraft (28% of its ground damage)
armlship.gloss: tier-2 fast raider ship, speed 99, lightning at 400 and light anti-air; hunts infrastructure, loses to cruisers
armlship.prose: The Maelstrom is a fast raider: 570 metal, 2200 health, speed 99, a lightning cannon at range 400 doing 250 damage a second plus a light anti-air missile. It strikes naval infrastructure and picks off high-value ships, and its anti-air handles drones and seaplanes; it loses to cruisers, to advanced torpedo launchers, and to submarines it can only outrun. Its gun needs energy.

armlun.name: Lunkhead
armlun.gloss: 1150-metal heavy hovertank; cannon at 575, depth charges; attacks from the sea, slow
armlun.prose: The Lunkhead is a 1150-metal hovercraft from the gantry: 5300 health, speed 50, a 370-damage cannon every 1.8 seconds at range 575 plus a rocket and depth charges. It hovers over water, so it attacks a shore from the sea and hits submarines without being hit back. It is not fast and is weaker than the other gantry units for its size; it is the choice on a map where the fight is along a coast.

armmakr.name: Energy Converter
armmakr.gloss: converts 70 energy a second into 1 metal for 1 metal to build; for surplus energy only, chains explosions
armmakr.prose: The Energy Converter turns 70 energy a second into 1 metal a second, for 1 metal and 1150 energy, 167 health. It is for energy that would otherwise sit at a full store: extractors beat converters while free spots remain, and metal in the bank is better spent on a second lab or a construction turret than on converters. A cluster of them explodes in a chain when one dies, so spread them, and aim at the enemy's clusters for the same reason.

armmanni.name: Starlight
armmanni.gloss: tier-2 tachyon tank, 2500-damage beam at 950 for 1000 energy; kills tanks and towers from outside their reach
armmanni.prose: The Starlight fires a 2500-damage tachyon beam every 4.7 seconds at range 950 that pierces through several units, for 1000 energy a shot: 1200 metal, 2800 health, speed 42. It outranges every turret short of the plasma batteries and kills heavy tanks and tier-3 units, and it is what a Bull (armbull) group brings against enemy heavies. Its damage halves at maximum range, it fires only over its front, it is lightly armoured for the cost, and it explodes for 980 damage when it dies, so keep it behind the line and spread out. It needs the energy.

armmar.name: Marauder
armmar.air: 43 dps against aircraft (13% of its ground damage)
armmar.gloss: 970-metal fast amphibious mech; gauss guns at 350 and light anti-air; raids from the water
armmar.prose: The Marauder is the cheapest gantry unit: 970 metal, 4900 health, speed 95 and faster in water, twin gauss guns at range 350 doing 336 damage a second, plus light anti-air missiles. It is a raider at tier-3 scale: it crosses the sea floor and hits an economy from the water side, kills light units and defences by speed and health, and gets out. Heavy gunships, mines in its lanes and a real line stop it.

armmark.name: Compass
armmark.gloss: mobile radar bot, 2200 radar and 900 sight; lets skirmishers and artillery use their range; unarmed
armmark.prose: The Compass is a 100-metal radar bot with 2200 radar range and 900 sight, 355 health, no weapon. Its job is to show the enemy to units that fire further than they see: Hounds (armfido), Sharpshooters (armsnipe), artillery and plasma batteries. One behind an army turns range into hits; it dies to any raider that reaches it.

armmart.name: Mauser
armmart.gloss: tier-2 mobile artillery, 820 range; kills towers from outside their reach; slow and helpless if reached
armmart.prose: The Mauser is tier-2 artillery: 320 metal, 1070 health, speed 60, a 260-damage shell every 3 seconds at range 820. It outranges every turret but the plasma batteries and kills defences and slow units from where they cannot answer; it fires only over its front, it is helpless if anything reaches it, and the Quaker (cormart) hits harder with a wider splash. It needs radar or a spotter and a line in front.

armmav.name: Gunslinger
armmav.air: 65 dps against aircraft (25% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
armmav.gloss: tier-2 skirmish bot, 265 dps at 365, repairs itself, range grows with kills; loses to swarms and heavies
armmav.prose: The Gunslinger is a 650-metal skirmish bot with 1800 health, speed 50 and a 265-damage shot every second at range 365 whose impulse shoves light units back; it repairs itself and its range grows with experience. It kills tier-1 units and light tier-2 and can hunt a commander with its range and speed, but it needs micro: swarms get inside its range and heavy tier-2 (Sheldon, Tiger, Quaker) out-trade it. In the simulated tier-2 study it never beat the tier-1 line at equal metal, so build it for the picking-off role, not as the army.

armmercury.name: Mercury
armmercury.gloss: 1600-metal long-range anti-air, stockpiled 750-damage missiles at 2400 with a 425 blast; kills bombers before they arrive
armmercury.prose: The Mercury is the long-range anti-air tower: 1600 metal and 33000 energy, 1670 health, stockpiled missiles at range 2400 doing 750 damage in a 425-wide blast, one built every 14 seconds for 1800 energy, five stored. It kills strategic bombers and fighter groups before they reach the base; cheap scouts bait its shots, so set it to return fire or hold fire. It does nothing against ground.

armmerl.name: Ambassador
armmerl.gloss: stealthy siege rocket truck, 1900 damage at 1300 every 18 s over walls and hills; useless against movers
armmerl.prose: The Ambassador lobs a 1900-damage rocket on a high arc to range 1300 every 18 seconds: 920 metal, 1220 health, speed 33, invisible to radar. It kills turrets, batteries and buildings behind walls or cliffs from beyond their range and is the siege answer to a fortified line; against anything that moves it is helpless, and its reload leaves it defenceless for long stretches. Escort it and spot for it.

armmex.name: Metal Extractor
armmex.gloss: tier-1 metal extractor on a metal spot, 50 metal; the economy, and the first thing raiders kill
armmex.prose: The Metal Extractor sits on a metal spot and yields what the spot gives, about 2 metal a second on the maps played here, for 50 metal and 500 energy, with 270 health and 3 energy a second upkeep. Extractors are the whole tier-1 income and they beat converters while free spots remain, so expansion is claiming spots as fast as the army can cover them; they are also the first thing every raid goes for, and the opponent puts a turret beside nearly every one of its own. It self-destructs in one second and the blast kills light units beside it. Upgrading it in place to an Advanced Metal Extractor (armmoho) quadruples the spot.

armmh.name: Possum
armmh.gloss: tier-1 hover rocket launcher, 300 damage at 710 over walls; softens defences before a landing; weak up close
armmh.prose: The Possum is a light hovercraft with a vertical rocket launcher: 175 metal, 530 health, speed 64, a 300-damage rocket every 6 seconds at range 710 that comes down over walls and terrain. Among the longest ranges at tier 1, it kills turrets and softens an expansion before a hover assault, and its single big hit often leaves no wreck. Close-combat units kill it; keep it behind Crocodiles (armanac).

armmine1.name: Light Mine
armmine1.gloss: 7-metal cloaked mine; kills a light unit that walks on it, 1 energy a second to stay hidden
armmine1.prose: The Light Mine is a 7-metal cloaked mine (1 energy a second to stay cloaked, invisible to radar) that explodes when a unit passes over it and damages the units nearby. It kills raiders and light bots outright and is laid across the lanes they use, by a Groundhog (armmlv); keep your own units off it. Only the minelayer and the decoy commander build it.

armmine2.name: Medium Mine
armmine2.gloss: 25-metal cloaked mine with a wider blast; kills heavier bots and medium tanks; chains with its neighbours
armmine2.prose: The Medium Mine is a 25-metal cloaked mine (2 energy a second) with a wider blast than the light mine's, meant for heavier bots and medium tanks on a tier-1 or early tier-2 push. Laid too close together they chain-explode, and they hurt your own units badly; a Groundhog (armmlv), a Consul (armconsul) or the decoy commander lays them. It is the mine for a lane the enemy's Stouts (armstump) or Thugs (corthud) use, where a light mine would not kill.

armmine3.name: Heavy Mine
armmine3.gloss: 50-metal cloaked heavy mine, three times a medium mine, massive blast; blunts a packed push at a choke
armmine3.prose: The Heavy Mine is a 50-metal cloaked mine (6 energy a second) with about three times a medium mine's power and a massive blast radius, for a massed push through a choke; with Dragon's Teeth (armdrag) narrowing the gap it wipes a packed group of plasma bots or medium tanks in one blast. It is poor against a single fast raider, it chains other mines, and it hits friends. A Groundhog (armmlv) or the decoy commander lays it.

armmls.name: Voyager
armmls.gloss: tier-2 naval engineer, 200 build power; builds tier-1 ships in the field, naval turrets and mines; unarmed
armmls.prose: The Voyager is a naval engineer: 190 metal, 1460 health, speed 66, 200 build power, no weapon. It builds tier-1 ships (Corsair, Dolphin, Platypus) where the fleet is, floating construction turrets and naval mines, and assists tier-2 constructors. A minefield laid right after taking the sea holds hovercraft off an area until the tier-2 fleet arrives.

armmlv.name: Groundhog
armmlv.gloss: stealthy minelayer; lays light, medium and heavy mines, walls and cameras; hides from radar; no real gun
armmlv.prose: The Groundhog is a 57-metal minelayer with 335 health, speed 75, radar stealth and a 5-damage bolt that clears mines. It lays the three mine sizes (armmine1, armmine2, armmine3), Dragon's Teeth walls and Beholder cameras, all of which are cloaked and draw energy. A minefield on a lane the enemy raids through kills light units outright and hurts anything heavier; keep your own units off it. It cannot assist construction, only repair, and it cannot fight.

armmmkr.name: Advanced Energy Converter
armmmkr.gloss: tier-2 converter, 600 energy a second into 10.3 metal for 380 metal; barely better than tier 1
armmmkr.prose: The Advanced Energy Converter turns 600 energy a second into 10.3 metal a second (58 energy a metal) for 380 metal and 21000 energy, 445 health. It is only about 17 percent more energy-efficient than the tier-1 converter (70 energy a metal); its gain is capacity in one building, so it is for a fusion-sized surplus late in a game, not a reason to go tier 2. Only the tier-2 constructors build it, and clusters chain-explode.

armmoho.name: Advanced Metal Extractor
armmoho.gloss: tier-2 extractor upgrade, 620 metal, four times the spot's yield for 20 energy a second; the first tier-2 buy
armmoho.prose: The Advanced Metal Extractor replaces a tier-1 extractor on its spot: 620 metal and 7700 energy, 2800 health, four times the yield (0.004 against 0.001 a spot unit), 20 energy a second upkeep, 600 metal storage. One upgrade adds about three extractors' worth of income and repays its metal in around 100 seconds, so upgrading the safest spots first is what the advanced constructor (armack) is for; five upgrades roughly double a tier-1 income. Only the tier-2 constructors build it. With nothing banked and other builders drawing, an upgrade takes minutes instead of its nominal 70 seconds, so give the constructor helpers or a bank.

armmship.name: Longbow
armmship.air: 69 dps against aircraft (64% of its ground damage)
armmship.gloss: tier-2 missile cruiser, 650-damage rockets at 1550 over terrain; levels a shore base from beyond every turret's reach
armmship.prose: The Longbow is the shore bombardment ship: 2000 metal, 3350 health, speed 63, heavy rockets doing 650 damage every 6 seconds at range 1550 on a high arc that clears hills, plus medium anti-air. It outranges every land defence including the Pulsar (armanni) and levels a base in a few volleys; a Bermuda (armsjam) jammer beside it keeps it off radar until it fires. Aircraft and tactical nukes are the answers to it.

armmstor.name: Metal Storage
armmstor.gloss: 3000 metal storage for 330 metal; banks metal for a tier-2 lab or an upgrade burst; explodes when killed
armmstor.prose: The Metal Storage adds 3000 metal storage for 330 metal and 570 energy, 2100 health. A store holds the bank that starts an advanced lab or a run of extractor upgrades without stalling everything else; at tier 1 a full store is usually a sign to build a second lab instead. It explodes when destroyed and clusters chain.

armnanotc.name: Construction Turret
armnanotc.gloss: 200-build-power construction turret, 230 metal; assists, repairs and reclaims within its reach; unarmed
armnanotc.prose: The Construction Turret is 200 build power that does not move: 230 metal and 3200 energy, 560 health, assisting, repairing and reclaiming anything within its radius, and by default it reclaims enemy units that come into reach. Two or three beside a lab more than double its output, which is the right use of banked metal before a second lab; a Stork (armatlas) can carry one to wherever build power is needed. One dying damages the turrets beside it, so do not pack them.

armnanotcplat.name: Naval Construction Turret
armnanotcplat.gloss: the construction turret built on water, 200 build power for 230 metal
armnanotcplat.prose: The Naval Construction Turret is the Construction Turret (armnanotc) built on water: 200 build power for 230 metal and 3200 energy, 560 health, assisting, repairing and reclaiming within its radius. Two beside a shipyard double its output. Like the land turret it is 200 build power for 230 metal, and its death damages the turrets beside it.

armpb.name: Pit Bull
armpb.gloss: 680-metal pop-up gauss turret, 422 dps at 730, hunkers to double its health; loses to skirmishers that out-range it
armpb.prose: The Pit Bull is the tier-2 pop-up gauss cannon: 680 metal and 14000 energy, 2800 health, a 675-damage shot every 1.6 seconds (422 a second) at range 730.
