legadvaabot.prose: The Aquilon is Legion's tier-2 mobile anti-air: 750 metal, 2400 health, speed 34.5, a rotary micro-flak cannon firing three 40-damage rounds every 0.4 seconds at range 700 (300 a second) and an anti-air railgun doing 225 every 3 seconds at 1151 that passes through what it kills, about 375 a second against aircraft and nothing against anything else. It takes the Archangel's (armaak: 520 metal, 258 a second at 1200) place with more metal, more damage and less speed. It is worth its cost only when the enemy has air; it walks under water, and the Amphibious Complex (legamphlab) makes it too.

legadveconv.name: Advanced Energy Converter
legadveconv.gloss: tier-2 converter, 600 energy a second into 10.3 metal for 370 metal; capacity, barely a better rate
legadveconv.prose: The Advanced Energy Converter turns 600 energy a second into 10.3 metal a second (58 energy a metal against the tier-1 converter's 70) for 370 metal and 21000 energy, with 560 health; Armada's (armmmkr) costs 380 metal and has 445. Its gain is capacity in one building, so it is for a fusion-sized surplus late in a game, not a reason to go tier 2. Only the tier-2 constructors build it, and clusters chain-explode.

legadvestore.name: Hardened Energy Storage
legadvestore.gloss: tier-2 hardened storage, 40000 energy for 840 metal, 12700 health; the bank for stockpile weapons and gantries
legadvestore.prose: The Hardened Energy Storage adds 40000 energy storage for 840 metal and 11000 energy, with 12700 health (Armada's armuwadves: 830 metal, 11700 health). It is the bank that a nuclear silo (legsilo), a Juno (legjuno) at 12000 energy a pulse or the energy-fed tier-2 guns draw on, and it lets a big economy ride a stall; the tier-2 constructors build it on land or water. Its health makes it the storage that survives a raid, so the bank is still there when the enemy leaves.

legadvshipyard.name: Advanced Shipyard
legadvshipyard.gloss: tier-2 shipyard on water, 2800 metal, 600 build power; makes cruisers, submarines, battleships and the Neptune
legadvshipyard.prose: The Advanced Shipyard is the tier-2 naval factory, built only on water: 2800 metal and 10000 energy, 5900 health, 600 build power (Armada's armasy: 2900 metal), making the Advanced Construction Submarine (leganavyconsub), Artifex, Thalassa, Leocampus, Ultor, Notus, Dolus, Hecate, Sphyrna, Architeuthis, Scylla, Corinth and Neptune. It is offered only where the builder reaches deep water. Its 600 build power keeps up with a tier-2 sea economy; a Construction Ship (legnavyconship) assisting adds to it.

legadvsol.name: Advanced Solar Collector
legadvsol.gloss: 100 energy a second for 465 metal, no weather; Armada's is 80 for 350; a tier-1 constructor builds it
legadvsol.prose: The Advanced Solar Collector makes a steady 100 energy a second for 465 metal and 4080 energy, 1100 health, 150 energy storage; Armada's (armadvsol) makes 80 for 350 metal. At 4.65 metal per energy a second it costs about what a Fusion Reactor (legfus, 4.2) does per unit of energy and needs no tier-2 builder, so it is the tier-1 way to a big, steady income where wind is poor. It is much dearer up front than solar or wind, and its 4080 energy is the cost that bites at tier 1.

legafcv.name: Aceso
legafcv.gloss: fast light constructor buggy, 120 build power at speed 110; builds only extractors, solar, wind, radar, Pharos and walls
legafcv.prose: The Aceso is a fast light builder from the Advanced Vehicle Plant: 200 metal, 450 health, speed 110, 120 build power, 10 energy a second, no weapon. Its list is six things, the extractor, solar, wind, radar, Pharos (leglht) and Dragon's Teeth (legdrag), so it is for claiming and re-claiming far metal spots quickly with a tower beside each, and for assisting, not for building a base. No Armada or Cortex builder is quite like it; at 450 health it dies to any raider it meets.

legafigdef.name: Ajax
legafigdef.gloss: 180-metal tier-2 fighter, heavy gatling at 600 doing 800 a second to aircraft, 480 health; air only, not stealthy
legafigdef.prose: The Ajax is Legion's tier-2 air-superiority fighter: 180 metal, 480 health, speed 270, gatlings firing ten 80-damage rounds every second at range 600 against aircraft only (800 a second). It takes the Highwind's (armhawk: 150 metal, 370 health, 536 a second at 740, speed 358, invisible to radar) and Nighthawk's (corvamp) place with more damage and health but less reach and speed and no radar stealth, so it is the fighter that holds the sky over its own army rather than the one that hunts. It cannot hit ground at all. Build it once the enemy flies tier-2 aircraft.

legafus.name: Advanced Fusion Reactor
legafus.gloss: 3300 energy a second for 10500 metal; the late-game energy for long-range guns and gantries; huge explosion
legafus.prose: The Advanced Fusion Reactor makes 3300 energy a second for 10500 metal and 69000 energy, with 9800 health and 9000 energy storage; Armada's and Cortex's (armafus, corafus) make 3000 for 9700 metal. At 3.2 metal per energy a second it is the cheapest steady energy away from a vent, and it is what powers the long-range cannons (leglrpc, legstarfall), the energy-fed heat-ray units or a gantry army late in a game. It is the bomber's favourite target and its explosion levels everything near it, so it stands alone under anti-air. Only the tier-2 constructors build it, at 340000 build time.

legageo.name: Advanced Geothermal Powerplant
legageo.gloss: tier-2 geothermal, 1250 energy a second on a vent for 1600 metal; devastating when it explodes
legageo.prose: The Advanced Geothermal Powerplant makes 1250 energy a second for 1600 metal and 27000 energy on a steam vent, with 4150 health and 12000 energy storage (Armada's armageo is the same price with 3600 health; Cortex's corageo 1500 metal). It is the most metal-efficient energy in the game, and its explosion can take most of a base with it, so it goes on a vent the enemy cannot reach and away from everything else. Only the tier-2 constructors build it; the other Legion building for a vent is the Rampart (legrampart), which trades half the output for an anti-nuke, radar and drones.

legah.name: Alpheus
legah.gloss: 210-metal anti-air hovercraft, gatling at 700 doing 120 a second to aircraft; covers a hover force or a fleet
legah.prose: The Alpheus is Legion's anti-air hovercraft: 210 metal, 1120 health, speed 88.5, 350 sonar, a gatling firing six 8-damage rounds every 0.4 seconds at range 700 against aircraft only (120 a second). It takes the Sweeper's (armah: 230 metal, 85 a second at 700) and Birdeater's (corah) place with more damage for less metal. It covers a hover force or a fleet against gunships and bombers and does nothing against ground; build it once enemy air has been seen.

legaheattank.name: Prometheus
legaheattank.gloss: 1250-metal heat-ray assault tank, 7700 health; a beam at 450 burning 1.8 s of every 3, about 600 a second; needs energy
legaheattank.prose: The Prometheus is Legion's tier-2 heavy tank: 1250 metal and 19000 energy, 7700 health, speed 52, a heat ray at range 450 with a 64 splash that burns for 1.8 seconds of every 3 at 33 damage a frame, about 1780 a burst and 600 a second on average (the 990 in its numbers is the beam while it is on), for 10 energy a frame, 300 a second while it burns. It takes the Bull's (armbull: 950 metal, 4650 health, 245 a second at 460) and Tiger's (correap) place with more health and far more damage up close for more metal, so it wins the mid-range brawl and melts tier-1 groups and towers that let it reach them. Units and towers that out-range 450 shoot it on the way in, and in an energy stall it stops firing. At 1250 metal it is not a unit to send alone.

legajam.name: Erebus
legajam.gloss: tier-2 jammer tower, hides everything within 760 from radar for 125 energy a second; 125 metal
legajam.prose: The Erebus is the tier-2 jammer tower and Armada's Veil (armveil) to the number: 125 metal and 19000 energy, 830 health, hiding everything within 760 from enemy radar for 125 energy a second. It hides a whole base or a massed army from long-range weapons that target by radar; line of sight still sees through it. The tier-2 constructors and the Proteus (legaceb) build it, and a Juno pulse destroys it.

legajamk.name: Tiresias
legajamk.gloss: radar jammer bot, hides units within 450 from enemy radar for 80 energy a second; unarmed
legajamk.prose: The Tiresias is a 75-metal jammer bot (350 health, speed 35) that hides everything within 450 from enemy radar for 80 energy a second, Armada's Smuggler (armaser) to within a few metal. It walks with an army to keep it off the radar that artillery and long-range guns target by; line of sight still sees through it, and it switches off while stunned. A Juno pulse destroys it.

legalab.name: Legion Advanced Bot Lab
legalab.gloss: tier-2 bot factory, 2600 metal, 600 build power; the gate to tier 2 through bots; makes the 16 Legion tier-2 bots
legalab.prose: The Legion Advanced Bot Lab is the tier-2 bot factory at Cortex's price (coralab): 2600 metal and 16000 energy, 4500 health, 600 build power, four times the tier-1 lab's, making the Advanced Construction Bot (legack), Proteus, Hoplite, Telchine, Phalanx, Incinerator, Arquebus, Belcher, Infestor, Thanatos, Aquilon, Snapper, Euclid, Eidolon, Tiresias and the decoy commander. A tier-1 constructor builds it, not the commander; with the first advanced constructor the entry costs about 3000 metal before any return, and at 25200 build time one constructor bot takes over five minutes. The rule of thumb carried over from the other factions is to start it at +30 metal and +500 energy a second, or +20 with 1000 to 1500 banked; earlier it idles the tier-1 army and loses to a tier-1 push. The carded OS-27 Legion player started his at 8:08 in the long game.

legamcluster.name: Cleaver
legamcluster.gloss: 460-metal cluster artillery tank at 930; a 300 shell plus five 105 bomblets every 7.2 s; helpless if reached
legamcluster.prose: The Cleaver is Legion's tier-2 mobile artillery: 460 metal, 1250 health, speed 44, a plasma shell every 7.2 seconds at range 930 that does 300 with a 130 blast and breaks into five 105-damage bomblets, up to 825 a shell over an area. It takes the Mauser's (armmart: 320 metal, 820) and Quaker's (cormart: 400 metal, 800) place with more reach and a wider, slower shot, so it kills towers from outside their reach and punishes packed groups more than single movers. It sees only 330, so it needs radar or a spotter, and anything that reaches it kills it.

legamph.name: Telchine
legamph.gloss: 600-metal amphibious assault bot, heat ray at 450 burning 1 s in 3, depth charges at 600; armoured; no twin
legamph.prose: The Telchine is an amphibious assault bot: 600 metal, 2750 health, speed 48 (faster in water), 700 sonar, with a heat ray at range 450 that burns for a second (33 damage a frame, about 990 a burst, for 10 energy a frame) and then cools for two, roughly 330 a second on average, and a 350-damage depth charge every 3 seconds at 600 against what is in the water. On land it fights with the heat ray; in the water it uses only the depth charges. Its reactive armour halves the damage it takes until 750 is absorbed and comes back about 17 seconds after it was last hit, and it takes a fifth of EMP. Nearest it are Armada's Platypus (armamph) and Cortex's Duck (coramph), both cheaper and lighter; it is a shore assault and a coast guard rather than a raider.

legamphlab.name: Amphibious Complex
legamphlab.gloss: tier-1 amphibious factory under water, 1200 metal, 150 build power; makes the Otter, Cetus, Triton, Telchine, Toxotai, Aquilon
legamphlab.prose: The Amphibious Complex is a factory built on the sea floor: 1200 metal and 5600 energy, 2800 health, 150 build power (half Armada's armamsub), making the Otter (legotter), Cetus, Triton, Telchine, Toxotai, Aquilon and the decoy commander, units that walk or float in from the sea. Three of them, the Triton, Telchine and Aquilon, are tier-2 units the land factories make only in the advanced plants, so on a water map it is a cheaper road to them. It is offered only where the builder reaches deep water and is expensive for a tier-1 factory; its units are the ones that come out of the water behind an enemy's shore defences.

legamphtank.name: Cetus
legamphtank.air: 17 dps against aircraft (22% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
legamphtank.gloss: 200-metal amphibious tank, gauss 116 per 1.5 s at 305, 1340 health; the Pincer's numbers, takes an eighth of EMP
legamphtank.prose: The Cetus is Legion's amphibious tank and the Pincer's (armpincer) numbers to the unit: 200 metal, 1340 health, speed 63, a 116-damage gauss shot every 1.5 seconds (77 a second) at range 305 and 180 sonar. It drives along the sea floor, so it reaches an expansion from the water or over ground tanks cannot cross; like the Pincer it should lose a straight fight to true tanks and to towers. It takes only an eighth of EMP damage. The vehicle plant and the Amphibious Complex (legamphlab) both make it; build it on maps with water between you and the enemy.

legamstor.name: Hardened Metal Storage
legamstor.gloss: tier-2 hardened storage, 10000 metal for 760 metal, 11200 health; land or water
legamstor.prose: The Hardened Metal Storage adds 10000 metal storage for 760 metal and 11000 energy, with 11200 health (Armada's armuwadvms: 750 metal, 10300 health). It is for a tier-2 economy that banks for gantry units (the Experimental Gantry, leggant, costs 8400) and long-range guns; the tier-2 constructors build it on land or water. It is a late buy: at tier 1 a full metal store means a second lab, not a bigger store.

leganavalaaturret.name: Fulmen
leganavalaaturret.gloss: the Pluto flak on water, 820 metal, micro-flak at 875; shreds air formations over a fleet
leganavalaaturret.prose: The Fulmen is the Pluto (legflak) built on water: 820 metal and 13000 energy, 1750 health, twin rotary micro-flak cannons firing three 58-damage rounds with a 44 blast every sixth of a second at range 875, aircraft only, about 1000 a second on paper. It takes the Naval Arbalest's (armfflak) and Naval Birdshot's (corenaa) place and answers bombers, torpedo aircraft and drones over a sea base. The Advanced Construction Submarine (leganavyconsub) and the Artifex (leganavyengineer) build it.

leganavaladvgeo.name: Advanced Underwater Geothermal Powerplant
leganavaladvgeo.gloss: tier-2 geothermal on an underwater vent, 1250 energy a second for 1500 metal; devastating when it explodes
leganavaladvgeo.prose: The Advanced Underwater Geothermal Powerplant makes 1250 energy a second for 1500 metal and 27000 energy on a sea vent, with 4150 health and 12000 energy storage. It is the most metal-efficient energy in the game and its explosion can take most of a base with it, so it goes on a vent the enemy cannot reach. The Advanced Construction Submarine (leganavyconsub) and the Advanced Construction Aircraft (legaca) build it.

leganavaldefturret.name: Ionia
leganavaldefturret.gloss: 1250-metal floating gun tower: heavy machine guns at 700 and a 15-pellet shotgun at 501, 735 a second; anti-ship
leganavaldefturret.prose: The Ionia is Legion's tier-2 floating defence: 1250 metal and 16500 energy, 6300 health, twin heavy machine guns doing 360 a second at range 700 and a 15-pellet shotgun doing 375 a second at 501, against surface targets only and with no energy cost. It takes the Gorgon's (armkraken: 1000 metal, 540 a second at 800) and Devastator's (corfdoom) place with less reach and more damage up close, killing ships and hovercraft that come near. Submarines and long-range ships beat it from below or from beyond 700. The Advanced Construction Submarine (leganavyconsub) and the Artifex (leganavyengineer) build it.

leganavaleconv.name: Naval Advanced Energy Converter
leganavaleconv.gloss: tier-2 converter on water, 600 energy a second into 10.3 metal for 370 metal; capacity, barely a better rate
leganavaleconv.prose: The Naval Advanced Energy Converter is the Advanced Energy Converter (legadveconv) built on water: 600 energy a second into 10.3 metal for 370 metal and 21000 energy, 560 health. It is only about 17 per cent more energy-efficient than the tier-1 converter, so it is for a fusion-sized surplus in a sea base. Only the Advanced Construction Submarine (leganavyconsub) builds it, and clusters chain-explode.

leganavalfusion.name: Naval Fusion Reactor
leganavalfusion.gloss: tier-2 fusion on water, 1220 energy a second for 5400 metal; keeps energy out of a land raid's reach
leganavalfusion.prose: The Naval Fusion Reactor is the water-built fusion and Cortex's (coruwfus) to the number: 1220 energy a second for 5400 metal and 34000 energy, 5900 health, 2500 energy storage. At 4.4 metal per energy a second it is a little dearer than the land Fusion Reactor (legfus, 4.2) and is the energy of a sea base, out of a land raid's reach; it explodes when destroyed. Only the Advanced Construction Submarine (leganavyconsub) builds it.

leganavalmex.name: Advanced Underwater Metal Extractor
leganavalmex.gloss: tier-2 extractor upgrade for an underwater spot, 640 metal, four times the yield
leganavalmex.prose: The Advanced Underwater Metal Extractor is the Advanced Metal Extractor (legmoho) for a spot under water: 640 metal and 8100 energy, 3900 health, four times the spot's yield, 20 energy a second upkeep, 600 metal storage. The Advanced Construction Submarine (leganavyconsub) builds it on a claimed underwater spot. Like the land upgrade it repays its metal in about 100 seconds, so the safest spots go first.

leganavalpinpointer.name: Naval Pinpointer
leganavalpinpointer.gloss: the targeting facility built on water, 800 metal, 150 energy a second
leganavalpinpointer.prose: The Naval Pinpointer is the Pinpointer (legtarg) built on water: 800 metal and 7500 energy, 1530 health, halving radar-dot wobble for the whole team for 150 energy a second, stacking with diminishing returns. The Advanced Construction Submarine (leganavyconsub) builds it. It is a late buy for a fleet with long-range guns to guide.

leganavalsonarstation.name: Auscultor
leganavalsonarstation.gloss: 160-metal tier-2 sonar station under water, 1600 sonar; finds submarines and submerged commanders
leganavalsonarstation.prose: The Auscultor is built on the sea floor: 160 metal and 2400 energy, 2400 health, 1600 sonar, Cortex's Advanced Sonar Station (corason) to the number. It finds submarines, amphibious units and a commander walking under water, which no radar sees; the Advanced Construction Submarine (leganavyconsub) builds it. It is cheap, and without it a fleet is blind to what swims beneath it.

leganavaltorpturret.name: Delphinus
leganavaltorpturret.gloss: 1050-metal advanced torpedo launcher, a 1100-damage homing torpedo every 3 s at 890; kills big ships and subs
leganavaltorpturret.prose: The Delphinus is Legion's tier-2 torpedo launcher and Cortex's Lamprey (coratl) to the number: 1050 metal and 8500 energy, 2800 health, a 1100-damage homing torpedo about every 3 seconds (363 a second) at range 890 with 400 sonar. It kills battleships and submarines that a tier-1 launcher only scratches, from beyond a destroyer's reach; it cannot hit land units, aircraft or hovercraft. The Advanced Construction Submarine (leganavyconsub) builds it.

leganavyaaship.name: Notus
leganavyaaship.gloss: 1000-metal anti-air ship, micro-flak at 800 and missiles at 860, about 840 a second to aircraft; nothing against ships
leganavyaaship.prose: The Notus is Legion's tier-2 anti-air ship: 1000 metal, 3900 health, speed 57, twin rotary micro-flak cannons firing three 40-damage rounds every sixth of a second at range 800 and two missile launchers at 860, about 840 a second against aircraft on paper and nothing against anything else. It takes the Dragonslayer's (armaas: 1000 metal, 3900 health, 840) and Arrow Storm's (corarch) place. One sailing inside a fleet clears waves of bombers, gunships and torpedo aircraft.

leganavyantinukecarrier.name: Hecate
leganavyantinukecarrier.gloss: 1600-metal support ship: mobile anti-nuke (cover 1600), six drones, 300 energy a second, 1500 radar; no gun
leganavyantinukecarrier.prose: The Hecate is Legion's fleet support ship: 1600 metal and 13000 energy, 5000 health, speed 63, an anti-nuke covering 1600 around it (interceptors 150 metal, 7500 energy and 90 seconds each, up to 20), 300 energy a second, 1500 radar and 760 sonar, and up to six light drones (15 metal and 500 energy each, one every 7 seconds, three free on completion) that fight anything within 1350. It takes the Haven's (armantiship: 1400 metal, 2950 radar) and Oasis's (corantiship) place, trading radar reach for the drones. It is the only nuke cover a fleet can carry besides another of its kind; it has no gun of its own.

leganavyantiswarm.name: Leocampus
leganavyantiswarm.air: 60 dps against aircraft (31% of its ground damage)
leganavyantiswarm.gloss: 500-metal fast anti-swarm ship, speed 105, riot cannon 210 with a 144 blast every 1.1 s at 350, light anti-air
leganavyantiswarm.prose: The Leocampus is Legion's tier-2 anti-swarm ship: 500 metal, 2300 health, speed 105, 750 radar, a riot cannon doing 210 with a wide 144 blast every 1.1 seconds at range 350 (191 a second, more against a crowd) and a light anti-air salvo at 760. It takes the Brimstone's (corfship: 630 metal, flamethrower at 450) and Maelstrom's (armlship) place, cheaper and faster with a shorter gun. It tears through light boats, hovercraft swarms and shore infrastructure; cruisers and submarines beat it.

leganavyartyship.name: Corinth
leganavyartyship.gloss: 13000-metal bombardment ship: four-shell cluster salvos at 2100 and three cluster guns at 1600; 22000 health
leganavyartyship.prose: The Corinth is a floating artillery fortress: 13000 metal and 125000 energy, 22000 health, speed 48, 1530 radar, a main cannon firing four 350-damage cluster shells every 8.4 seconds at range 2100 (2500 energy a salvo, each shell breaking into five 105-damage bomblets) and three secondary cluster cannons doing 250 plus four bomblets every 2.8 seconds at 1600. Armada and Cortex have nothing like it; it out-ranges every ship but the flagships and levels a shore base, preferring buildings. Submarines, torpedo bombers and the flagships beat it, it explodes like a flagship when it dies, and at 13000 metal it needs an escort.

leganavybattleship.name: Scylla
leganavybattleship.gloss: 2900-metal battleship that crawls onto land: three-shell plasma at 750 at sea, 700 on land; 10350 health
leganavybattleship.prose: The Scylla is a battleship that can leave the water: 2900 metal and 21000 energy, 10350 health, speed 25 on land and 2.6 times that afloat. At sea it fires a three-shell plasma cannon doing 270 a shell with a 200 blast every 2.7 seconds at range 750 and two ten-pellet shotguns at 500, about 500 a second; on land it switches to a three-shell cannon doing 300 a shell every 2.4 seconds at 700, about 375 a second. It takes the Dreadnought's (armbats: 3300 metal, 880) and Despot's (corbats: 950) place with less reach, traded for walking ashore to follow its targets. It cannot hit submarines, and battle submarines and torpedo bombers kill it; the underwater gantry makes it too.

leganavybattlesub.name: Architeuthis
leganavybattlesub.gloss: 1100-metal fast assault submarine, three 150-damage torpedoes every 2.5 s at 600; hunts ships and subs
leganavybattlesub.prose: The Architeuthis is Legion's fast tier-2 submarine: 1100 metal, 2350 health, speed 72, 500 sonar, a pack of three unguided 150-damage torpedoes every 2.5 seconds at range 600 (180 a second). It takes the Barracuda's (armsubk: 950 metal, homing torpedoes at 400) and Predator's (corshark) place with more reach but unguided torpedoes. It hunts battle submarines and ships; seen only by sonar, it dies to depth charges, torpedo bombers and submarine hunters it cannot outrun.

leganavyconsub.name: Advanced Construction Submarine
leganavyconsub.gloss: tier-2 constructor submarine, 345 build power; upgrades underwater extractors, builds naval fusion and the underwater gantry
leganavyconsub.prose: The Advanced Construction Submarine is the submerged tier-2 builder: 700 metal, 1110 health, speed 65, 345 build power and 30 energy a second, no weapon (Armada's armacsub: 350 build power). It upgrades underwater extractors (leganavalmex) and builds the naval fusion, advanced converter and geothermal, the tier-2 naval towers (Ionia, Fulmen, Delphinus), sonar, the naval targeting facility and the underwater Experimental Gantry (leggantuw). Guard it with the fleet and assist it with tier-1 constructors.

leganavycruiser.name: Thalassa
leganavycruiser.gloss: 900-metal gatling cruiser, 360 a second at 500 against surface targets plus depth charges at 450; no anti-air
leganavycruiser.prose: The Thalassa is Legion's tier-2 cruiser: 900 metal, 5600 health, speed 57, 375 sonar, twin machine guns firing six 24-damage rounds every 0.4 seconds at range 500 (360 a second) against surface targets and a 225-damage depth charge every 1.8 seconds at 450 against what is under water. It takes the Paladin's (armcrus: 1000 metal, 5600 health, 500) and Buccaneer's (corcrus) place as the tier-2 fleet's mainstay; it kills any tier-1 ship and hunts submarines. It has no anti-air, so it sails with a Notus (leganavyaaship).

leganavyengineer.name: Artifex
leganavyengineer.gloss: tier-2 naval engineer ship, 200 build power at reach 250; builds sea buildings and light ships on the spot; sees mines
leganavyengineer.prose: The Artifex is the Advanced Shipyard's naval engineer: 200 metal, 1600 health, speed 58, 200 build power at a reach of 250, no weapon. It builds the tier-1 naval economy and defences, the Naval Hive (legfhive), the Eviscerator (legacluster) and Ionia (leganavaldefturret) towers and a heavy naval mine (corfmine3), and it builds Hippocampus, Iapetus and Syracusia ships and construction ships on the spot. It also reveals enemy mines within 600. It is the builder that brings build power to the front of a fleet; anything that shoots at ships kills it.

leganavyflagship.name: Neptune
leganavyflagship.air: 1067 dps against aircraft (35% of its ground damage)
leganavyflagship.gloss: 16000-metal flagship: two continuous heat rays at 700 and four rails at 1000; 48000 health; short reach for its class
leganavyflagship.prose: The Neptune is Legion's flagship: 16000 metal and 240000 energy, 48000 health, speed 63, 1000 radar, 500 energy a second of its own, two heat rays at range 700 doing 33 damage a frame each (about 2000 a second together) and four railguns doing 800 every 3 seconds at 1000 that pass through what they kill, roughly 3000 damage a second at full fire for about 1800 energy a second. It takes the Epoch's (armepoch: 20000 metal, plasma to 2450) and Black Hydra's (corblackhy) place at less metal and far less reach, so it wins a close sea fight and loses an artillery duel; it takes no EMP. It cannot hit submarines, and its energy draw needs a fusion economy behind it. It ends a sea game if it is not answered.

leganavyheavysub.name: Sphyrna
leganavyheavysub.gloss: 1900-metal stealthy battle submarine, a 1650-damage torpedo every 8 s at 850; the naval sniper
leganavyheavysub.prose: The Sphyrna is Legion's battle submarine and Cortex's Kraken (corssub) to the number: 1900 metal, 3900 health, speed 39, invisible to radar, 400 sonar, a homing 1650-damage torpedo with a 160 blast every 8 seconds at range 850 (1110 against submarines, 750 against commanders). It kills battleships, flagships and tier-3 amphibians from beyond most ships' reach. Fast submarine hunters (leganavybattlesub and its twins) and torpedo bombers beat it.

leganavymissileship.name: Ultor
leganavymissileship.air: 30 dps against aircraft (10% of its ground damage)
leganavymissileship.gloss: 2000-metal missile cruiser, six 450-damage rockets every 9 s at 1550 over terrain; levels a shore base
leganavymissileship.prose: The Ultor is Legion's missile cruiser: 2000 metal, 3350 health, speed 61, 1000 radar but only 318 sight, a vertical salvo of six 450-damage rockets with an 80 blast every 9 seconds at range 1550 (2700 a salvo, preferring buildings) and a light anti-air salvo at 760. It takes the Longbow's (armmship: 650-damage rockets) and Messenger's (cormship: 1100) place with more, smaller rockets. It levels a shore base from beyond every tower's reach; it needs radar or spotters to use its range, and fast ships and submarines that reach it kill it.

leganavyradjamship.name: Dolus
leganavyradjamship.gloss: 450-metal radar and jammer ship, 1850 radar and a 650 jammer for 120 energy a second; unarmed
leganavyradjamship.prose: The Dolus is Legion's electronic ship: 450 metal, 1700 health, speed 42, 1850 radar and a 650 radar jammer for 120 energy a second, switching off while stunned. It takes the Bermuda's (armsjam: 980 jammer) and Phantasm's (corsjam: 900) place with a smaller jammer and a radar they lack, so one ship hides the fleet and finds targets for it. It is unarmed, and unlike the Bermuda and Phantasm it is not on the Juno's kill list.

legap.name: Legion Drone Plant
legap.gloss: tier-1 drone plant, 430 metal; makes the air constructor, Noctua, Martyr, Blindfold, Mosquito and two transports; 510 radar
legap.prose: The Legion Drone Plant is Legion's tier-1 air factory: 430 metal and 1100 energy, 1780 health, 150 build power and its own 510 radar, 220 metal cheaper than Armada's Aircraft Plant (armap). It makes the Legion Construction Aircraft (legca), the Noctua fighter and scout, the Martyr suicide drone, the Blindfold Juno drone, the Mosquito gunship and the Aeolus and Hippotes transports; it has no bomber, and the Hives' drones do not come from it. It is the way to a scout that sees the whole map and to fighters when the enemy flies; its combat aircraft are fragile and die to the first anti-air, so it is a second factory, not a first. The commander can build it.

legapopupdef.name: Chimera
legapopupdef.gloss: 750-metal pop-up turret, riot cannon 280 at 730 plus two miniguns at 600 (465 a second); closed it takes half damage
legapopupdef.prose: The Chimera is Legion's tier-2 pop-up defence: 750 metal and 15000 energy, 2800 health, a 280-damage riot cannon with a 140 blast every 1.7 seconds at range 730 and two rotary machine guns at 600, about 465 damage a second together, none of it costing energy. It takes the Pit Bull's (armpb: 680 metal, 422 a second at 730) and Scorpion's (corvipe) place, with the splash and the machine guns suiting it to groups of light units; closed it takes half damage. Skirmishers and artillery that out-range 730 beat it in the end, so it wants radar and its own artillery behind it.

legarad.name: Advanced Radar Tower
legarad.gloss: 400-metal advanced radar tower, 3500 radar; feeds every long-range weapon; fragile
legarad.prose: The Advanced Radar Tower shows everything within 3500 as radar dots, for 400 metal and 14000 energy, 500 health, the same as Armada's (armarad). One covers most of a small map's approaches and feeds every long-range weapon; hills block it, jammers hide units from it and cloaked units do not show. The tier-2 constructors and the Proteus (legaceb) build it, and a Juno pulse destroys it.

legaradk.name: Euclid
legaradk.gloss: mobile radar bot, 2200 radar and 925 sight; lets skirmishers and artillery use their range; unarmed
legaradk.prose: The Euclid is a 99-metal radar bot (390 health, speed 45) with 2200 radar and 925 sight, Armada's Compass (armmark) to within a point. It walks with the army so the Thanatos (leghrk), Arquebus (legsrail) and artillery can use their range beyond their own sight. It is unarmed, and a Juno pulse destroys it.

legaskirmtank.name: Gladiator
legaskirmtank.gloss: 450-metal skirmisher tank, three 70-damage plasma rounds every 2 s at 600, 2500 health, speed 65
legaskirmtank.prose: The Gladiator is a burst-fire skirmisher tank: 450 metal, 2500 health, speed 65, a rotary plasma cannon firing three 70-damage rounds with a 64 splash every 2 seconds at range 600 (105 a second). Its 600 out-ranges the tier-1 towers and every tier-1 unit but artillery and missile trucks, and it is fast enough to keep that distance, so it picks apart lines and towers that cannot reach it; heavy tanks that close and artillery beat it. It has no exact twin; the Jaguar (armlatnk) is the other plants' fast tier-2 tank at 600. Its damage is modest for its metal; its value is the reach and the hull.

legaspy.name: Eidolon
legaspy.gloss: cloaked spy invisible to radar and sonar; sees for artillery and self-destructs into an EMP burst; no weapon
legaspy.prose: The Eidolon is Legion's spy bot and the Ghost's (armspy) place: 125 metal and 8500 energy, 300 health, speed 62.5, cloaked (15 energy a second standing, 40 moving), invisible to radar and sonar, with 50 build power. It walks into the enemy base to see for artillery and long-range guns, and its self-destruct is an EMP burst 360 wide that stuns mobile units for up to 10 seconds and an anti-nuke for up to 20, which is how a nuke gets past one. An intrusion detector (armsd, corsd, legsd) or a unit bumping into it finds it, and at 300 health it then dies at once.

legatorpbomber.name: Aesacus
legatorpbomber.gloss: 480-metal tier-2 torpedo bomber, two 750-damage homing torpedoes every 7 s; kills ships and subs, a fifth on land
legatorpbomber.prose: The Aesacus is Legion's tier-2 torpedo bomber: 480 metal, 1900 health, speed 290, 800 radar and 800 sonar, two homing torpedo launchers each doing 750 every 7 seconds at range 400 (214 a second), and a fifth of that against units on land. It takes the Cormorant's (armlance: 400 metal, three 375-damage torpedoes) and Angler's (cortitan: 410 metal, one 1200-damage torpedo) place. It kills ships and submarines, which few other aircraft can touch, and does little to anything on land; flak and fighters kill it.

legatrans.name: Hippotes
legatrans.gloss: tier-1 heavy air transport, 190 metal, 800 health; carries the commander and heavy units; slow
legatrans.prose: The Hippotes is the heavy transport: 190 metal, 800 health, speed 100, carrying one unit including the commander and heavy tier-2 units, the Osprey's (armhvytrans) place with 170 more health and a little less speed. It is the cheapest way to move something slow across the map. It is slow for an aircraft and dies with its cargo to fighters or flak, and it takes no EMP.

legavantinuke.name: Hera
legavantinuke.gloss: 1100-metal mobile anti-nuke, interceptors cover 1575; protects an army from nuclear missiles; unarmed
legavantinuke.prose: The Hera is Legion's mobile anti-nuke: 1100 metal and 36000 energy, 720 health, speed 58, stockpiling interceptors (150 metal, 6500 energy and 90 seconds each, up to 20) that shoot down nuclear missiles aimed within 1575 of it. It takes the Saviour's (cormabm: 1250 metal, 870 health) place. Late in a game one with the army means the army cannot be nuked by a single missile; lower its stockpile limit so it does not eat resources once a few are stored. It has no other weapon.

legavjam.name: Cicero
legavjam.gloss: tier-2 radar jammer vehicle, hides units within 450 from enemy radar for 80 energy a second; unarmed
legavjam.prose: The Cicero is Armada's Umbra (armjam) to the number: 105 metal, 510 health, speed 41, hiding everything within 450 from enemy radar for 80 energy a second. It drives with an army to keep it off the radar that artillery and long-range guns target by; line of sight still sees through it, and it switches off while stunned. A Juno pulse destroys it.

legavp.name: Advanced Vehicle Plant
legavp.gloss: tier-2 vehicle plant, 2500 metal, 600 build power; makes Quickshot, Gladiator, Prometheus, Medusa and eleven more
legavp.prose: The Advanced Vehicle Plant is Legion's tier-2 vehicle factory: 2500 metal and 16000 energy, 5100 health, 600 build power, making the Advanced Construction Vehicle (legacv), Aceso, Quickshot, Gladiator, Triton, Prometheus, Medusa, Cleaver, Mantis, Boreas, Inferno, Charon, Hera, Cicero and Pheme. A tier-1 constructor vehicle, hovercraft or Otter builds it; the entry cost and timing are the advanced bot lab's (about 3000 metal, +30 metal and +500 energy a second), and it is the choice on flat open ground where heavy tanks and artillery pay. Its 600 build power and heavy units need that economy to keep it busy.

legavrad.name: Pheme
legavrad.gloss: tier-2 radar vehicle, 2300 radar and 900 sight; lets artillery and skirmishers use their range; unarmed
legavrad.prose: The Pheme is Armada's Prophet (armseer) to the number: 125 metal, 980 health, speed 57, 2300 radar and 900 sight. It drives with the army so the Cleaver (legamcluster), Medusa (legmed), Inferno (leginf) and Boreas (legavroc) can use their range beyond their own sight. It is unarmed, and a Juno pulse destroys it.

legavroc.name: Boreas
legavroc.gloss: stealthy siege rocket truck, 1900 damage at 1300 every 18 s over walls and hills; useless against movers
legavroc.prose: The Boreas is the Ambassador's (armmerl) twin to the number: 920 metal, 1220 health, speed 33, invisible to radar, lobbing a 1900-damage rocket (625 to commanders) with a 150 blast on a high arc to range 1300 every 18 seconds, preferring buildings. It kills towers, batteries and buildings behind walls or cliffs from beyond their range and is the siege answer to a fortified line; against anything that moves it is helpless, and its reload leaves it defenceless for long stretches. Escort it and spot for it.

legbal.name: Ballista
legbal.air: 46 dps against aircraft, its full damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range
legbal.gloss: 160-metal rocket bot, 250 damage per 5.5 s at 460 with a 70 splash; outranges light towers by 30, slow, needs a screen
legbal.prose: The Ballista is Legion's rocket bot: 160 metal, 900 health, speed 43.5, one 250-damage rocket every 5.5 seconds (45 a second) at range 460 with a 70 splash. It takes the Rocketeer's (armrock) and Aggravator's (corstorm) place, 40 to 50 metal dearer with more health and a heavier, slower shot; its 460 is 30 more than a Pharos (leglht) or Sentry (armllt) and 15 less than the rocket bots' 475, so a group held at range kills light towers and the extractors behind them. If it is like those rocket bots it is poor against anything that moves and closes, so it wants Satyrs (leglob) in front, which is how the carded OS-27 Legion player ran one to three behind his Satyrs. It may fire at aircraft at full damage when nothing on the ground is in range, though a slow rocket rarely catches one.

legbar.name: Barrage
legbar.gloss: 250-metal napalm artillery at 535; each shell leaves a 7-second fire doing 60 a second within 60; riot artillery, slow
legbar.prose: The Barrage is Legion's tier-1 artillery: 250 metal, 1500 health, speed 40.5, a napalm shell every 5 seconds at range 535 that does 60 on impact and sets the ground burning for 7 seconds, 60 damage a second to anything within 60 of it (fires that overlap are soft-capped at 120 a second; aircraft and submarines do not burn). It has no twin: its 535 is short of the Shellshocker's (armart) and Wolverine's (corwolv) 710, though beyond the light towers' 430, and its damage is in the fire, so it punishes packed groups and anything that stands still, while a moving raider walks out of it. A building cannot step out, so a shell that lands beside one is worth up to 480 against it. It needs a screen and a spotter like any artillery.

legbart.name: Belcher
legbart.gloss: 550-metal napalm skirmisher, two fire shells every 4 s at 625, each burning 75 wide for 7 s; no twin
legbart.prose: The Belcher is a napalm skirmisher: 550 metal, 1780 health, speed 60, a launcher throwing two 60-damage napalm shells every 4 seconds at range 625, each setting the ground within 75 burning for 7 seconds at 60 a second (overlapping fires are soft-capped at 120 a second; aircraft and submarines do not burn). Its 625 out-ranges the tier-1 towers and every tier-1 unit but artillery, and its fire punishes packed groups and anything that stands to fight, while fast units walk out of it; a building cannot, so a pair of shells beside one is worth up to 960 against it. It has no twin; in role it sits with the Hound (armfido) and Sheldon (cormort) as the tier-2 bot that out-ranges the line, and it needs a screen in front.

legbastion.name: Bastion
legbastion.gloss: 4200-metal heat-ray fortress, a sweeping beam at 1100 (up to 3875 a burst every 3 s), 12000 health; 500 energy a shot
legbastion.prose: The Bastion is Legion's heaviest tower: 4200 metal and 58000 energy, 12000 health, 1200 radar, and a heat ray at range 1100 that sweeps across its targets for 2.5 seconds of every 3, 155 a beam with a 120 blast and up to 3875 damage a burst by the game's own page (the 52 a second in its numbers counts one beam a reload), for 500 energy a shot. It takes the Pulsar's (armanni) and Bulwark's (cordoom) place, a wide sweep that suits groups rather than a single tier-3 hull. Switched off it closes into a shell that takes a quarter of the damage. It needs a fusion's energy behind it, and in a stall it is a wall.

legca.name: Legion Construction Aircraft
legca.gloss: tier-1 constructor aircraft, 45 build power at speed 139; expands anywhere, builds the advanced aircraft plant; fragile
legca.prose: The Legion Construction Aircraft is the fastest tier-1 builder: 100 metal, 151 health, speed 139, 45 build power, no weapon, made by the Drone Plant (legap). It flies over terrain to claim far extractors and to reclaim, and its list is the tier-1 base plus the Legion Advanced Aircraft Plant (legaap), the heavier tier-1 towers and the Juno (legjuno); its build power is low (Armada's armca has 50), so use several on one job. Any anti-air or fighter kills it at once.

legcar.name: Cardea
legcar.air: 91 dps against aircraft (32% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
legcar.gloss: 550-metal heavy shotgun hovertank, 14 pellets of 40 every 2 s at 321 (280 a second), 3600 health
legcar.prose: The Cardea is Legion's assault hovercraft: 550 metal and 11000 energy, 3600 health, speed 51, a shotgun of fourteen 40-damage pellets every 2 seconds at range 321 (280 a second), costing no energy. It takes the Halberd's (corhal: 640 metal, 4350 health, 344 a second at 300, 45 energy a shot) place, a little lighter and free to fire; Armada's hover platform has nothing like it. It is the hover force's brawler for a landing or a shore fight, and units and towers that out-range 321 shoot it on the way in.

legcen.name: Phobos
legcen.air: 36 dps against aircraft (33% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
legcen.gloss: 140-metal fast assault bot, speed 90, 840 health, gauss 107 a second at 180; a Blitz on legs that raids and runs
legcen.prose: The Phobos is a fast assault bot: 140 metal, 840 health, speed 90, two 75-damage gauss shots every 1.4 seconds (107 a second) at range 180. No bot of the other factions matches it; its numbers are nearly the Blitz's (armflash: 110 metal, 730 health, 90 a second at 180, speed 101), so it is the raider that survives what kills a Pawn (armpw): a Pharos (leglht) needs about five seconds for it against two for a Pawn. Per metal it has less health and under half a Pawn's damage, so cheap line units out-trade it head on; it is for running to an extractor line or a constructor and away again. Whether it trades like the Blitz is unmeasured.

legch.name: Construction Hovercraft
legch.gloss: tier-1 constructor hovercraft, 105 build power; builds on land and water including naval buildings; unarmed
legch.prose: The Construction Hovercraft is a 185-metal constructor that crosses land and water (1390 health, speed 73, 105 build power; Armada's armch: 200 metal, 110) with the largest tier-1 build list Legion has, 45 items: the whole land base, the naval buildings, the Advanced Vehicle Plant (legavp) and the Advanced Shipyard (legadvshipyard). It has more build power than the constructor bot or vehicle and crosses water, so it expands early onto islands and shores. It is unarmed.

legcib.name: Blindfold
legcib.air: 0 dps against aircraft, its full damage
legcib.gloss: 100-metal Juno drone: a 500-wide pulse every 10 s that destroys radar, jammers, mines and scouts; no damage otherwise
legcib.prose: The Blindfold carries a small Juno: 100 metal and 3500 energy, 600 health, speed 300, sight 835, dropping a pulse every 10 seconds at range 450 that destroys radar and sonar towers, jammers, mines and scout cars within a 500-wide area and does nothing to anything else; for 7 seconds a ring 250 out from the impact kills scouts that cross it. It has no twin; it is the mobile, cheap version of the Juno (legjuno), for clearing a minefield in front of a push or blinding a forward radar before a raid. It starts on hold fire and any anti-air or fighter kills it.

legck.name: Legion Construction Bot
legck.gloss: tier-1 constructor bot, 75 build power, 100 metal; builds the base, the advanced lab and the heavier towers; unarmed
legck.prose: The Legion Construction Bot is the ordinary tier-1 builder: 100 metal, 700 health, speed 39, 75 build power, no weapon; Armada's (armck) is 110 metal for 80. It builds the commander's land buildings plus the Advanced Bot Lab (legalab), the Geothermal Powerplant (leggeo), the Advanced Solar Collector (legadvsol), the heavier tier-1 towers (Dragon's Jaw legdtr, Cacophony legmg, Rhapsis legrhapsis, Lupara leglupara, Amputator legcluster), the Hive (leghive) and the Juno (legjuno), and it can assist any factory or repair anything. It dies to any raider that finds it alone, so expansion goes in steps the army already covers. Two or three on one project add their build power.

legcluster.name: Amputator
legcluster.gloss: 850-metal cluster artillery at 1000; a 300 shell plus five 105 bomblets every 6 s; shells packs and clusters behind the line
legcluster.prose: The Amputator is Legion's tier-1 artillery battery: 850 metal and 11000 energy, 2900 health, a plasma shell every 6 seconds at range 1000 that does 300 with a 120 blast and breaks into five 105-damage bomblets, up to 825 a shell spread over an area, switching between a flat and a high arc. It takes the Gauntlet's (armguard: 1250 metal, 300 every 2.85 seconds at 1220) and Agitator's (corpun) place at two-thirds of the metal with less reach and a slower, wider shot, so it is better against packed groups and building clusters than against one turret. It out-ranges every tier-1 unit and tower but needs radar or scouts to see that far, and it is a lot of tier-1 metal that does not move.

legcom.name: Legion Commander
legcom.air: 125 dps against aircraft (57% of its ground damage)
legcom.gloss: the one unit you cannot lose; builds the base, D-guns anything at 250, heat ray at 300; the only commander that shoots aircraft
legcom.prose: The Legion Commander starts the game as your only unit and the game ends when it dies, so it is both your first builder and your last line. It is the Armada and Cortex commanders' hull to the number, 3700 health, speed 37.5, 300 build power (a Legion Construction Bot has 75), 30 energy a second, and its build list is the whole tier-1 base: extractors, solar and wind, a bot lab, vehicle plant, drone plant, shipyard or hovercraft platform, the Pharos (leglht), Bramble (legrl), radar and storage. Its heat ray does 175 every 0.8 seconds (219 a second) at range 300 and its D-gun kills any unit but a commander at 250 for 500 energy a shot, so a small party of Goblins (leggob), Pawns (armpw) or Grunts (corak) that reaches it dies; it still loses to a real army, to artillery it cannot reach, and to being far from home when the enemy comes. Unlike the other two it carries an anti-air missile (150 a hit every 1.2 seconds at 300, 125 a second) as well as a torpedo for targets in the water, so a lone gunship or scout that comes to it gets shot. It can cloak (100 energy a second standing, 1000 moving) and walk under water, and its death explosion levels everything around it.

legctl.name: Euryale
legctl.gloss: 240-metal coastal torpedo launcher on land, 225 per 1.5 s at 600 with 600 sonar; guards a shore from ships and subs
legctl.prose: The Euryale is Legion's coastal torpedo launcher, built on the shore, and the Anemone's (armdl) numbers: 240 metal and 2200 energy, 2200 health, a 225-damage homing torpedo every 1.5 seconds (150 a second) at range 600 and 600 sonar. It defends shoreline buildings against ships and submarines; its torpedoes reach only what is in the water, so it does nothing to land units, hovercraft or aircraft. The commander can build it.

legcv.name: Legion Construction Vehicle
legcv.gloss: tier-1 constructor vehicle, 85 build power at speed 57; builds the base and the advanced vehicle plant; unarmed
legcv.prose: The Legion Construction Vehicle is the vehicle plant's builder: 125 metal, 1330 health, speed 57, 85 build power, no weapon (Armada's armcv: 135 metal, 90 build power, speed 54). It has more health, speed and build power than the constructor bot but climbs poorly, so it expands on flat ground. Its list is the constructor bot's with the Advanced Vehicle Plant (legavp) in place of the advanced bot lab. It dies to any raider that finds it alone.

legdecom.name: Legion Commander
legdecom.air: 125 dps against aircraft (57% of its ground damage)
legdecom.gloss: a look-alike Legion commander with a weak D-gun and 300 build power; bait and a front-line builder of basics and mines
legdecom.prose: The Decoy Commander looks like the real Legion Commander (legcom) to the enemy, with the same 3700 health, speed and heat ray, but it costs 750 metal, makes 15 energy a second, does not heal itself, and its D-gun does only 40 damage a shot for 150 energy. Its use is to draw fire and D-gun shots meant for the real commander and to bring 300 build power to the front, where it builds the tier-1 economy, the Pharos (leglht), Bramble (legrl), radar and the three mines. It keeps the anti-air missile (here at 450) and the torpedo, and takes almost no EMP. The Advanced Bot Lab (legalab) or the Amphibious Complex (legamphlab) makes it once the enemy has shown it will hunt commanders; like the real one it can cloak and walk under water.

legdeflector.name: Soteria
legdeflector.gloss: 3200-metal plasma shield, radius 550, 6175 shield health; stops plasma artillery, not bombs, lasers or missiles
legdeflector.prose: The Soteria is Legion's shield generator and the Overseer's (corgate) numbers: 3200 metal and 55000 energy, 3550 health, a plasma shield of radius 550 with 6175 shield health that regenerates at 130 a second for 562 energy a second. It deflects plasma artillery and long-range cannon shells and takes a great deal before it drops; bombs, lasers, heat rays and missiles pass straight through it. A few around a base answer an artillery barrage; each costs more than half a fusion to keep charged.

legdrag.name: Dragon's Teeth
legdrag.gloss: 8-metal wall block with 2800 health; funnels tier-1 units and stops low shots; heavy tanks roll over it
legdrag.prose: The Dragon's Teeth is an 8-metal wall block with 2800 health, the same as the other factions'. A line of them blocks most tier-1 units and low projectiles and funnels a push into a Dragon's Jaw's (legdtr) or a tower's fire; heavy tier-2 tanks crush it. Enemies do not target it automatically, so it is reclaimed or shot by hand. It costs nothing worth counting, and the Sapper (legmlv) and Aceso (legafcv) lay it too.

legdtr.name: Dragon's Jaw
legdtr.gloss: 290-metal pop-up riot cannon at 400, 240 with a 140 blast every 2 s; closed it is ignored and takes a third of damage
legdtr.prose: The Dragon's Jaw is a pop-up riot cannon: 290 metal and 1550 energy, 1610 health, a 240-damage shell with a wide 140 blast every 2 seconds (375 against commanders) at range 400, with no energy cost. Closed it is radar-stealthy, takes a third of the damage and counts as neutral, so enemy units do not target it on their own, which makes it the surprise at a choke; mixed into Dragon's Teeth (legdrag) it stops a packed push. It takes the Dragon's Maw's (cormaw, a flamethrower at 410) and Dragon's Claw's (armclaw) place, with splash instead of flame or lightning. Anything that out-ranges 400 shells it while it is up.

legeallterrainmech.name: Myrmidon
legeallterrainmech.air: 56 dps against aircraft (18% of its ground damage)
legeallterrainmech.gloss: 3950-metal all-terrain drone-carrier mech, cluster plasma at 1100, two heavy drones, anti-air; no twin
legeallterrainmech.prose: The Myrmidon is an all-terrain siege mech that carries drones: 3950 metal and 78000 energy, 9200 health, speed 33, a cluster plasma cannon doing 345 plus seven 105-damage bomblets every 2.3 seconds at range 1100 on a flat or a high arc, a light anti-air salvo at 760, and up to two heavy drones (90 metal and 1000 energy each, 1650 health, a heat ray of about 125 a second at 430) that fight anything within 1600. It has no twin; it climbs where other experimentals cannot and shells towers and packed groups from beyond their reach while its drones screen it. It is slow and light for its class, so raiders that reach it and bombers kill it.

legeconv.name: Energy Converter
legeconv.gloss: converts 70 energy a second into 1 metal for 1 metal to build; for surplus energy only, chains explosions
legeconv.prose: The Energy Converter turns 70 energy a second into 1 metal a second, for 1 metal and 1150 energy, 167 health, exactly Armada's (armmakr). It is for energy that would otherwise sit at a full store: extractors beat converters while free spots remain, and banked metal is better spent on a second lab or a construction turret than on converters. A cluster of them explodes in a chain when one dies, so spread them, and aim at the enemy's clusters for the same reason.

legeheatraymech.name: Sol Invictus
legeheatraymech.air: 211 dps against aircraft (8% of its ground damage)
legeheatraymech.gloss: 23500-metal experimental mech: two continuous heat rays at 800 and two riot cannons at 550; 110000 health
legeheatraymech.prose: The Sol Invictus is Legion's largest walker: 23500 metal and 615000 energy, 110000 health, speed 40, 500 energy a second of its own, two heat rays at range 800 doing 33 damage a frame each (about 2000 a second together, 17 energy a frame each), two riot autocannons doing 420 with a 160 blast every 1.2 seconds at 550 and a flak gun against aircraft at 700. It takes the Juggernaut's (corkorg: 29000 metal, 149000 health) and Titan's (armbanth: 13500 metal) place, melting armies and towers that come inside 800, and it takes no EMP. Its heat rays draw about 1000 energy a second while firing, twice what it makes, so it needs a fusion economy behind it. Massed long-range fire, bombers and a commander's D-gun are what kill experimentals, and it explodes like a Titan when it dies and like a Juggernaut when self-destructed.

legehovertank.name: Charybdis
legehovertank.gloss: 1350-metal heavy hovertank, a sweeping heat ray at 425, two rocket launchers at 500, depth charges; 4900 health
legehovertank.prose: The Charybdis is a heavy assault hovertank: 1350 metal and 25000 energy, 4900 health, speed 63, 550 sonar, a heat ray at range 425 that sweeps for 1.8 seconds of every 3 at 25 a frame (about 1350 a sweep, 300 energy a firing; the 108 a second in its numbers counts one beam a reload), two launchers firing three 100-damage rockets every 6 seconds at 500, and depth charges at 400 against what is under water. It takes the Lunkhead's (armlun: 1150 metal, 5300 health, 575) and Cataphract's (corsok) place as the gantry's hovertank, crossing land and sea alike and hitting submarines from above. Units that out-range 425 shoot it on the way in, and it is light for a gantry unit.

legelrpcmech.name: Astraeus
legelrpcmech.gloss: 11000-metal walking long-range cannon, four 600-damage cluster shells every 14.4 s at 3100; speed 25
legelrpcmech.prose: The Astraeus is a long-range cannon on legs: 11000 metal and 150000 energy, 17000 health, speed 25, a salvo of four 600-damage plasma shells every 14.4 seconds at range 3100, each breaking into six 100-damage bomblets, for 6000 energy a salvo; a shield takes only 300 a shell. It has no twin; it out-ranges everything but the fixed long-range cannons and walks its reach forward, so it shells bases, tower lines and gantries from where nothing short of them answers. At speed 25 it cannot escape bombers, raiders or a counter-battery cannon, so it needs an escort and radar.

legerailtank.name: Daedalus
legerailtank.air: 800 dps against aircraft, its full damage
legerailtank.gloss: 6500-metal rail tank, three 800-damage rails every 3 s at 1000 through what they kill; also hits aircraft
legerailtank.prose: The Daedalus is an experimental rail tank: 6500 metal and 165000 energy, 16500 health, speed 61, three rail accelerators each doing 800 (300 to commanders) every 3 seconds at range 1000, 600 energy a shot, the rails going on through what they kill, about 800 a second together and the same against aircraft. It has no twin; it is a sniper at experimental scale, killing heavy units, towers and tier-3 hulls from beyond most of their reach, and it takes half the EMP others do. Its 1800 energy a volley needs a fusion economy behind it, and raiders and swarms that close on it waste its slow, heavy shots.

legeshotgunmech.name: Praetorian
legeshotgunmech.air: 386 dps against aircraft (31% of its ground damage)
legeshotgunmech.gloss: 7000-metal fast shotgun mech, 14-pellet shotgun at 420 (930 a second), 12-rocket salvos at 700, flak; 22000 health
legeshotgunmech.prose: The Praetorian is a fast assault mech: 7000 metal and 120000 energy, 22000 health, speed 72, a 14-pellet shotgun doing 60 a pellet every 0.9 seconds at range 420 (about 930 a second), a 12-rocket salvo of 150 each every 6 seconds at 700, and a micro-flak cannon at 800 against aircraft. It takes the Razorback's (armraz: 3800 metal, 13300 health, 475) and Demon's (cordemon: 6000 metal, 18000 health) place, fast enough to catch what it hunts and shred swarms and heavies up close. Units and towers that out-range 420 hurt it on the way in, and like every experimental it is a single point of failure to bombers, EMP and a D-gun.

legestor.name: Energy Storage
legestor.gloss: 6000 energy storage for 175 metal; smooths wind and banks D-gun and drone energy; explodes when killed
legestor.prose: The Energy Storage adds 6000 energy storage for 175 metal and 1800 energy, 2000 health (Armada's armestor: 170 metal, 1890 health). Storage lets a wind economy ride out a lull and holds the 500 a shot the commander's D-gun needs. Legion's light tower and tier-1 heat rays cost no energy a shot, so it is less a tower battery here than for Armada and Cortex, but every drone a Hive (leghive) makes costs 500 energy. It explodes with a large blast when destroyed, so it stands away from the base.

legeyes.name: Argus
legeyes.gloss: 32-metal cloaked camera, 540 sight, invisible to radar; watches gaps jammers hide; survives a Juno pulse
legeyes.prose: The Argus is a tiny cloaked observation post: 32 metal and 850 energy, 280 health, 540 sight, invisible to radar, drawing 5 energy a second and 15 while cloaked. Staggered lines of them across a gap watch what jammers hide and catch a cloaked unit walking through, since sight sees what radar cannot. Unlike Armada's and Cortex's Beholder (armeyes, coreyes), it is not on the Juno's kill list. The commander, the constructors and the Sapper (legmlv) build it.

legfdrag.name: Shark's Teeth
legfdrag.gloss: 15-metal naval wall block with 4450 health; funnels tier-1 ships and blocks low shots
legfdrag.prose: The Shark's Teeth is a 15-metal wall block on water with 4450 health, the same as the other factions'. A line blocks most tier-1 ships and low projectiles, funnels a fleet into a torpedo launcher's fire and shields floating towers; heavier ships and aircraft ignore it. It costs nothing worth counting.

legfeconv.name: Naval Energy Converter
legfeconv.gloss: the energy converter on water, 70 energy a second into 1 metal for 1 metal; chains explosions
legfeconv.prose: The Naval Energy Converter is the Energy Converter (legeconv) built on water: 70 energy a second into 1 metal a second, for 1 metal and 1250 energy, 167 health. It is for a sea base's surplus energy; extractors beat it while free spots remain. Clusters chain-explode when one dies, so spread them.

legfhive.name: Naval Hive
legfhive.gloss: 350-metal floating drone hive: up to six combat drones fighting within 1100, each 15 metal and 500 energy; no twin
legfhive.prose: The Naval Hive is the Hive (leghive) built on water: 350 metal and 9000 energy, 1200 health, keeping up to six light drones (15 metal and 500 energy each, one every 8 seconds, three free on completion) that fly out against anything within 1100 and dock to heal. A drone has 325 health, speed 280 and a machine gun of about 27 damage a second at 300, so a full hive puts some 160 a second on ships or a landing anywhere in its circle; the drones cannot hit submarines. Neither Armada nor Cortex has one, and its drones are units of ours that no factory made.

legfhp.name: Offshore Hovercraft Platform
legfhp.gloss: tier-1 hovercraft platform on water, 670 metal; the same six hovercraft as the land platform
legfhp.prose: The Offshore Hovercraft Platform is the water-built version of the Hovercraft Platform (leghp): 670 metal and 2000 energy, 3750 health, 150 build power, the same six hovercraft. It is offered only where the builder finds water; build it when the land platform's site is not safe or not there. It makes the same units at the same rate and costs the same; only the site differs.

legfig.name: Noctua
legfig.gloss: 40-metal fighter and scout drone, speed 270, machine gun at 600 against aircraft only, sight 700; Legion's air scout too
legfig.prose: The Noctua is Legion's tier-1 fighter and its only tier-1 air scout: 40 metal, 220 health, speed 270, sight 700 and 400 radar, a machine gun firing two 36-damage rounds every 0.6 seconds at range 600 against aircraft only (120 a second). It takes the Falcon's (armfig: 73 metal, 167 health, 139 a second at 680) place at a little over half the metal, with 80 less reach, and the Blink's (armpeep) as the plane that flies over the enemy base to see it. A patrol in front of the base stops scouts, gunships and bombers, and it does nothing to anything on the ground. Build a couple early for the picture and more once enemy aircraft have been seen.

legflak.name: Pluto
legflak.gloss: 820-metal tier-2 flak minigun at 875, about 1000 a second against aircraft on paper; nothing against ground
legflak.prose: The Pluto is Legion's tier-2 flak: 820 metal and 13000 energy, 1750 health, twin rotary micro-flak cannons firing three 58-damage rounds with a 44 blast every sixth of a second at range 875, about 1000 damage a second against aircraft on paper. It takes the Arbalest's (armflak) and Birdshot's (corflak) place at the same cost with 25 more reach and twice their listed rate; it is the answer to massed bombers, gunships and drones around a base or on a front. It does nothing against ground. The Proteus (legaceb) builds it as well as the tier-2 constructors.

legfloat.name: Triton
legfloat.air: 105 dps against aircraft (51% of its ground damage)
legfloat.gloss: 650-metal convertible tank and boat, 3500 health, gauss 250 per 2.5 s at 550 plus an anti-air gatling at 400
legfloat.prose: The Triton is a heavy tank that becomes a boat: 650 metal and 12000 energy, 3500 health, speed 55 and faster on water, a 250-damage gauss shot every 2.5 seconds at range 550 (100 a second) and a gatling at 400 that prefers aircraft (105 a second against them). It takes the Turtle's (armcroc: 750 metal, 5000 health, 480) and Poison Arrow's (corparrow) place as the tier-2 tank that crosses water, trading health for reach and its own anti-air. It reaches an expansion across water from behind and holds against light aircraft; against heavy tanks in a straight fight it should lose. The Advanced Vehicle Plant, the Amphibious Complex (legamphlab) and the underwater gantry make it.

legfmg.name: Gelasma
legfmg.air: 270 dps against aircraft, its full damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range
legfmg.gloss: 450-metal floating gatling tower, 270 a second at 575 against ships, hovers and aircraft; 3900 health, no energy a shot
legfmg.prose: The Gelasma is the Cacophony (legmg) on water: 450 metal and 5500 energy, 3900 health, a gatling firing six 18-damage rounds every 0.4 seconds (270 a second) at range 575 against surface targets and, when nothing else is in range, aircraft. It takes the place of Armada's Manta (armfhlt) and Cortex's Coral (corfhlt), the floating heavy lasers (470 to 480 metal, about 230 a second at 630), with less reach but no energy cost a shot. It cannot hit submarines, so it stands with torpedo launchers.

legfort.name: Tyrannus
legfort.air: 95 dps against aircraft (17% of its ground damage)
legfort.gloss: 5600-metal flying fortress, 16700 health: twin plasma cannons at 915, three machine guns, anti-air missiles; no stealth
legfort.prose: The Tyrannus is Legion's heavy gunship: 5600 metal and 79000 energy, 16700 health, speed 93, 1000 radar, two plasma cannons doing 166 with a 160 blast every 1.7 seconds at range 915, three machine guns at 650 and an anti-air missile launcher at 840, about 560 damage a second against ground and 95 against aircraft. It takes the Dragon's (corcrwh: 5100 metal, 16700 health, 840) place and Armada has no equivalent; its long plasma reach lets it shell lines and towers from beyond most anti-air. It is one huge target: stealth fighters, flak and long-range anti-air (leglraa and its twins) bring it down, and losing it loses a tier-2 economy's minutes of output.

legforti.name: Fortification Wall
legforti.gloss: 40-metal tier-2 wall with 8900 health; stops tier-1 and tier-2 units and low shots; tier-3 plows through
legforti.prose: The Fortification Wall is the tier-2 wall: 40 metal and 500 energy, 8900 health, about three times a Dragon's Teeth's (legdrag), the same as Armada's (armfort). It blocks tier-1 and tier-2 units and low-flying projectiles and shields the towers behind it; tier-3 units plow through it. The tier-2 constructors and the Proteus (legaceb) build it.

legfrad.name: Naval Radar / Sonar Tower
legfrad.gloss: 130-metal radar and sonar tower on water, 2100 radar and 900 sonar
legfrad.prose: The Naval Radar / Sonar Tower is the Radar Tower (legrad) for water, Armada's (armfrad) to the number: 130 metal and 1000 energy, 110 health, 2100 radar and 900 sonar. It is the early warning of a naval base for aircraft, ships and submarines alike. At 110 health it is the first thing a raid kills, and a Juno pulse destroys it.

legfrl.name: Polybolos
legfrl.gloss: the light anti-air tower on water, 80 metal, missiles at 765; early cover for a naval base
legfrl.prose: The Polybolos is the Bramble (legrl) built on water: 80 metal and 850 energy, 335 health, a 115-damage missile every 1.7 seconds at range 765, aircraft only. A few protect a naval base from early raids and drones; a swarm gets past one alone. Build it once enemy aircraft have been seen over the water.

legfus.name: Fusion Reactor
legfus.gloss: tier-2 fusion, 950 energy a second for 4000 metal; dense steady energy, follows the extractor upgrades; explodes
legfus.prose: The Fusion Reactor makes 950 energy a second for 4000 metal and 25000 energy, with 4600 health and 2500 energy storage; only the tier-2 constructors build it, at 66000 build time (about five and a half minutes for one Advanced Construction Bot, legack, so it needs helpers). At 4.2 metal per energy a second it is Cortex's rate (corfus: 850 for 3600) and a little cheaper per energy than Armada's (armfus: 750 for 3350); its value is density, steadiness and builder time, which is why it follows the extractor upgrades rather than preceding them. It is a favourite bomber target and it explodes when destroyed, so it stands apart from the base under anti-air.

leggant.name: Experimental Gantry
leggant.gloss: tier-3 gantry, 8400 metal, 1800 build power; makes the eight Legion experimentals; a late-game decision
leggant.prose: The Experimental Gantry is Legion's tier-3 factory at Cortex's price (corgant): 8400 metal and 62000 energy, 17800 health, 1800 build power, making the Sol Invictus (legeheatraymech), Praetorian, Daedalus, Astraeus, Myrmidon, Keres, Javelin and Charybdis. An advanced constructor builds it. It is a late-game decision: the gantry and its first unit are a tier-2 economy's whole output for minutes, and each unit it makes is a single point of failure to EMP, bombers or a D-gun.

leggantuw.name: Experimental Gantry
leggantuw.gloss: tier-3 gantry under water, 8400 metal; makes the Sol Invictus, Javelin, Charybdis, Triton, Telchine and Scylla
leggantuw.prose: The underwater Experimental Gantry is the sea version of the gantry (leggant): 8400 metal and 62000 energy, 17800 health, 1800 build power, built on the sea floor by the Advanced Construction Submarine (leganavyconsub), making the Sol Invictus, Javelin and Charybdis and, at gantry speed, the Triton, Telchine and Scylla battleship. It is offered only where the builder reaches deep water. Its units arrive from the sea floor, which is the reason to build it rather than the land gantry.

leggat.name: Decurion
leggat.air: 45 dps against aircraft (25% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
leggat.gloss: 300-metal assault tank, 2550 health, gatling 180 a second at 361; the Stout's place with more of everything but speed
leggat.prose: The Decurion is Legion's tier-1 line tank: 300 metal, 2550 health, speed 45, a gatling firing six 12-damage rounds every 0.4 seconds (180 a second) at range 361. It takes the Stout's (armstump) and Brute's (corraid) place at 300 metal against 225 and 235: more health per metal, more than twice their 81 a second and 11 more range, but at speed 45 against their 72 to 75, so it is an anchor rather than a raiding pack. It sits inside a Pharos's (leglht) 430 and wins towers by health, not reach. If it trades like the Stout, the Pounder (corlevlr) and artillery are what beat it, and at 45 it cannot run from either.

leggeo.name: Geothermal Powerplant
leggeo.gloss: 300 energy a second for 560 metal, only on a steam vent; explodes when killed
leggeo.prose: The Geothermal Powerplant makes 300 energy a second for 560 metal and 13000 energy, 2050 health, and can stand only on one of the map's steam vents; it costs what Armada's (armgeo) does. Where a vent is safe it is a tier-1 economy's biggest single generator, under 2 metal per energy a second; a tier-1 constructor builds it. It explodes when destroyed, and it is a target worth a raid.

leggob.name: Goblin
leggob.air: 9 dps against aircraft (33% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
leggob.gloss: 30-metal light skirmish bot, twin guns at 261 (27 a second), speed 75; swarm and raider, half a Grunt's damage per metal
leggob.prose: The Goblin is Legion's cheapest combat unit: 30 metal, 200 health, speed 75, sight 500, and a gun firing two 12-damage shots every 0.9 seconds (27 a second) at range 261. The game calls it a light skirmish bot; the Legion lab has no Pawn (armpw) or Grunt (corak), and the Goblin stands in their place with the same health per metal, about half their damage per metal and 46 to 81 more range than either. A handful kills a constructor or an unguarded extractor (275 health) in a few seconds, while a Pharos (leglht) or Sentry (armllt) at 430 out-ranges it and on paper a raider that closes out-damages it two to one, so it wants to keep its range. The one carded Legion player of the replay pool (OS 27) massed two to four of them in his first two minutes.

leghades.name: Alaris
leghades.air: 14 dps against aircraft (40% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
leghades.gloss: 65-metal fast raider tank, speed 99, a five-pellet shotgun at 211 (36 a second); cheap and light, dies to towers
leghades.prose: The Alaris is Legion's vehicle raider: 65 metal, 425 health, speed 99, a five-pellet shotgun doing 75 a blast every 2.1 seconds (36 a second) at range 211. It takes the Blitz's (armflash) place at 60 per cent of its metal and health, with 31 more range and about two-thirds of its damage per metal; its unit file also defines a gauss cannon, but the unit does not mount it. It is for constructors, extractors and radar (alone it needs about eight seconds for an extractor, five together under two), and any Pharos (leglht) or Sentry (armllt), the Pounder (corlevlr) or a line tank kills it.

leghelios.name: Helios
leghelios.air: 19 dps against aircraft (16% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
leghelios.gloss: 160-metal heat-ray tank, 160 per 1.3 s at 320 (123 a second), speed 75; hits hard for its cost on a light hull
leghelios.prose: The Helios is a fast heat-ray tank: 160 metal, 800 health, speed 75, a 160-damage heat ray every 1.3 seconds (123 a second) at range 320, costing no energy. It is nearest the Incisor (corgator: 120 metal, 820 health, 94 a second at 230, speed 85), with 90 more reach and more damage for 40 more metal, so it catches raiders and light tanks that come inside 320 and picks off constructors from beyond a raider's reach. Its hull is light for its cost, and a Pharos (leglht) or Sentry (armllt) at 430, the Ballista (legbal) and every artillery piece outrange it. The game calls it a skirmisher tank; how it trades has not been measured.

leghive.name: Hive
leghive.gloss: 350-metal drone hive: up to six combat drones fighting within 1100, each 15 metal and 500 energy; no twin
leghive.prose: The Hive is a building that makes and houses drones: 350 metal and 9000 energy, 1200 health, keeping up to six light drones (15 metal and 500 energy each, one every 10 seconds; three come free when it is finished) that fly out against anything within 1100 and dock to heal. A drone has 325 health, speed 280 and a machine gun of about 27 damage a second at 300, so a full Hive puts some 160 a second on a raid or a push anywhere in its circle and rebuilds its losses for energy. Neither Armada nor Cortex has one; when the Hive dies its drones fly on alone, losing 20 health a second. The carded OS-27 Legion player built his late army on them (6 to 12 drones from minute 10); they are units of ours that no factory made.

leghp.name: Hovercraft Platform
leghp.gloss: tier-1 hovercraft platform on land, 670 metal; makes the construction hovercraft, Glaucus, Nereus, Alpheus, Salacia, Cardea
leghp.prose: The Hovercraft Platform is the land-built hovercraft factory: 670 metal and 2000 energy, 3750 health, 150 build power (Armada's armhp: the same price, 3350 health), making the Construction Hovercraft (legch), Glaucus, Nereus, Alpheus, Salacia and Cardea. Hovercraft cross land and water alike, so the platform is the answer on a map where the enemy is across water and a shipyard is not wanted; its units are dearer than bots for what they fight. It is offered on any ground the builder can reach, and the commander can build it.

leghrk.name: Thanatos
leghrk.gloss: 750-metal salvo rocket bot, six 150-damage rockets every 8 s at 1200; prefers buildings; 1200 health
leghrk.prose: The Thanatos is Legion's tier-2 rocket artillery bot: 750 metal, 1200 health, speed 45, a salvo of six 150-damage rockets with a 96 blast every 8 seconds at range 1200 (900 a salvo, 112 a second), preferring buildings to units. It takes the Arbiter's (corhrk: 600 metal, 610 health, 1210) place with twice its health and a spread salvo instead of one heavy rocket; it out-ranges every tower short of the plasma batteries and kills towers, extractors and the support behind a line. It fires further than it sees (380), so it needs radar or a Pinpointer (legtarg), and anything that reaches it kills it.

leginc.name: Incinerator
leginc.gloss: 2300-metal heavy heat-ray bot, 990 a second at 725 for 300 energy a second while firing, 9000 health; speed 24
leginc.prose: The Incinerator is a walking heat-ray tower: 2300 metal and 46000 energy, 9000 health, speed 24, a continuous heat ray at range 725 doing 33 damage a frame (990 a second, half that to commanders) with a 72 splash, for 10 energy a frame, 300 a second while it fires. Its 725 out-ranges every tier-1 tower and most tier-2 units, and anything that walks into the beam melts, so it anchors a push or a defensive line; at speed 24 it cannot chase anything or escape artillery, bombers or a long-range cannon. It needs an energy economy behind it and stops firing in a stall. It has no twin; the game calls it (barely) mobile.

leginf.name: Inferno
leginf.gloss: 1700-metal napalm artillery at 1200: six shells every 7 s, each burning 75 wide for 7 s; carpets an area
leginf.prose: The Inferno is Legion's heavy artillery: 1700 metal and 30000 energy, 3650 health, speed 37.5, a burst of six napalm shells every 7 seconds at range 1200, spread over a 25-degree arc, each doing 60 on impact and setting the ground within 75 burning for 7 seconds at 60 a second (overlapping fires are soft-capped at 120 a second; aircraft and submarines do not burn). It takes the Tremor's (cortrem: 1850 metal, 1470) place, carpeting an area rather than one point, so it denies a choke, burns a base's buildings, which cannot step out, and breaks a packed army that stands still, while fast units drive through. It sees only 351, needs radar and a screen, and anything that reaches it kills it.

leginfestor.name: Infestor
leginfestor.gloss: 250-metal stealthy all-terrain spider that builds copies of itself; heat ray 120 a second at 300; no twin
leginfestor.prose: The Infestor is an all-terrain assault spider that multiplies: 250 metal and 5200 energy, 1200 health, speed 54, radar-stealthy, a heat ray doing 120 every second with a 42 splash at range 300, and 100 build power whose one option is another Infestor, which then helps the one that made it. A handful left with metal and energy coming in turns into a swarm without a factory, and the swarm climbs cliffs other units cannot. It has no twin in Armada or Cortex, and it takes a fifth of EMP. One on its own is light for its metal and dies to any tier-2 line unit; its value is in the numbers it builds.

legjam.name: Nyx
legjam.gloss: 140-metal jammer tower, hides units within 390 from enemy radar for 30 energy a second; unarmed
legjam.prose: The Nyx is Legion's tier-1 jammer tower: 140 metal and 7200 energy, 1070 health, hiding everything within 390 from enemy radar for 30 energy a second, between Cortex's Castro (corjamt: 100 metal, 360) and Armada's Sneaky Pete (armjamt: 240 metal, 500). It keeps a forward position off the enemy's radar so artillery and long-range towers cannot target it; line of sight still sees through it. A Juno pulse destroys it.

legjav.name: Javelin
legjav.gloss: 1200-metal amphibious raider mech, speed 68, twin machine guns 360 a second at 450, 7200 health; light anti-air
legjav.prose: The Javelin is a tier-3 amphibious raider: 1200 metal and 21000 energy, 7200 health, speed 68, twin machine guns firing twelve 12-damage rounds every 0.4 seconds at range 450 (360 a second) and a light anti-air gun at 700. It takes the Marauder's (armmar: 970 metal, 4900 health, speed 94.5) place, slower with more health and reach. It walks out of the sea behind the enemy's shore defences to raid expansions and kill lighter units; heavy tanks and towers out-trade it in a straight fight. The land and underwater gantries both make it.

legjuno.name: Juno
