legjuno.gloss: 660-metal Juno launcher; stockpiled pulses destroy radar, jammers, mines and scout cars in a 1400 blast; fired by hand
legjuno.prose: The Juno stockpiles anti-electronics missiles at Cortex's price (corjuno): 660 metal and 16000 energy, 2500 health, each missile 200 metal, 12000 energy and 75 seconds, up to 20, fired by hand anywhere on the map into a 1400-wide blast. Radar and sonar towers, jammers (towers, bots and vehicles), mines and scouts such as the Wheelie (legscout), Rover (armfav) and Tick (armflea) inside it are destroyed outright, and for 30 seconds a ring 450 out from the impact kills any scout that crosses it; Legion's Argus camera (legeyes) is not on that list, though Armada's and Cortex's cameras are. It is the answer to a minefield or a scout-spam opening and it blinds the enemy's radar before a strike; our own electronics in the blast die as well. It is radar-stealthy.

legkam.name: Martyr
legkam.air: 2000 dps against aircraft, its full damage
legkam.gloss: 65-metal suicide drone: flies into its target and explodes for 440 in a 200 blast; one use, no twin
legkam.prose: The Martyr is a suicide drone: 65 metal, 160 health, speed 220, that dives onto a ground target and explodes for 440 damage (220 to commanders) over a 200-wide blast, leaving a spotter that sees the place for 10 seconds. It has no twin in Armada or Cortex; one Martyr kills an extractor, a radar, a solar or a light bot outright and two kill a Pharos (leglht) or a constructor, so a handful break an extractor line or a packed group of light bots. It is spent when it hits, and any anti-air kills it on the way in at 160 health, so it works where the enemy has no anti-air yet. It starts on hold fire, so it waits for an order.

legkark.name: Karkinos
legkark.air: 44 dps against aircraft (23% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
legkark.gloss: 310-metal armoured assault bot, heat ray at 360 plus shotgun at 251 (189 a second), 1725 health; the Centurion's place
legkark.prose: The Karkinos is Legion's heavy tier-1 bot: 310 metal, 1725 health, speed 42, a heat ray doing 160 every 1.8 seconds at range 360 and a shotgun of two five-pellet blasts every 2 seconds at 251, together 189 damage a second when both reach. It takes the Centurion's (armwar) place (270 metal, 1590 health, 183 a second at 325) with 35 more reach on its main gun, and neither weapon costs energy. It wears reactive armour: it takes half damage until the plates have absorbed 300, and they come back about 15 seconds after it was last hit, so short exchanges favour it. If it plays like the Centurion it kills swarms of Goblins (leggob), Pawns (armpw) and Grunts (corak) and loses to the Pounder (corlevlr) and to anything that stays out past its 360.

legkeres.name: Keres
legkeres.gloss: 2600-metal anti-swarm tank, riot cannon 400 with a 200 blast at 450 plus two rotary cannons; 21000 health
legkeres.prose: The Keres is a heavy assault and anti-swarm tank: 2600 metal and 57000 energy, 21000 health, speed 48, a heavy riot cannon doing 400 with a 200 blast every 1.7 seconds at range 450 and two rotary cannons at 481, about 535 damage a second and much more against a crowd, none of it costing energy; it takes half the EMP others do. It has no twin; at about the Karganeth's (corkarg) price it carries 70 per cent more health, so it walks into massed tier-1 and tier-2 armies and breaks them. Units that out-range 450 and bombers are what beat it.

leglab.name: Legion Bot Lab
leglab.gloss: tier-1 bot lab, 470 metal, 150 build power; makes the constructor, Goblin, Satyr, Phobos, Ballista, Karkinos, Toxotai, Zagreus
leglab.prose: The Legion Bot Lab is the usual first factory, at Cortex's price (corlab): 470 metal and 1050 energy, 2900 health, 150 build power, making eight bots: the Legion Construction Bot (legck), Zagreus, Goblin, Satyr, Phobos, Ballista, Karkinos and Toxotai. It has no scout bot; the Wheelie (legscout) comes from the vehicle plant. Like the other labs it draws energy hard while building, so generators first and then the lab is the shape that works, as in the carded OS-27 Legion opening (extractor, extractor, wind, wind, solar, lab at 0:42). Its 150 build power turns into about 5 metal a second of Goblins, 7.5 of Satyrs or Phobos and 10 of Ballistas or Karkinos, so an income above that needs a second lab or construction turrets.

leglht.name: Pharos
leglht.air: 23 dps against aircraft (12% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
leglht.gloss: 70-metal light heat-ray tower, 200 per 1.1 s at 430 (182 a second), no energy a shot; stops raiders, out-ranged by rockets
leglht.prose: The Pharos is Legion's light tower: 70 metal and 550 energy, 550 health, a 200-damage heat ray every 1.1 seconds (182 a second; 270 a shot against commanders) at range 430, with no energy cost per shot. It takes the Sentry's (armllt) place, 15 metal cheaper, 70 health lighter and a little harder-hitting, and because it costs nothing to fire it keeps shooting through an energy stall in which a Sentry or Guard (corllt) falls silent. One beside an extractor is the cheapest way to stop a lone raider; the carded OS-27 Legion player put one at each new cluster. Rocket bots (armrock and corstorm at 475, the Ballista legbal at 460), the Lasher (cormist) and artillery out-range it, and line units overpower it at equal metal.

leglob.name: Satyr
leglob.air: 8 dps against aircraft (28% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
leglob.gloss: 60-metal light plasma bot, 75 per 2.5 s at 400, 550 health; two of them are a Mace for 120 metal and 20 more range
leglob.prose: The Satyr is Legion's tier-1 line bot: 60 metal, 550 health, speed 51, a 75-damage plasma shot every 2.5 seconds (30 a second) at range 400 with a small splash. Two Satyrs are a Mace (armham) or a Thug (corthud) almost exactly, 1100 health and 60 damage a second for 120 metal against 130 and 140, with 20 more range, split into two bodies that each die at 550. It sits inside a Pharos's (leglht) or Sentry's (armllt) 430, so like the Mace it beats towers by numbers rather than reach, and if it trades like the Mace the Pounder (corlevlr) and artillery are what it loses to. It was the body of the carded OS-27 Legion player's army from minute 4 to 10, with Ballistas (legbal) behind; its plasma gains range from high ground.

leglraa.name: Xyston
leglraa.gloss: 1600-metal long-range anti-air railgun, two 700-damage rails every 5 s at 2000, 1800 energy a shot; nothing against ground
leglraa.prose: The Xyston is Legion's long-range anti-air: 1600 metal and 36000 energy, 1670 health, a railgun firing two 700-damage rails with a 100 blast every 5 seconds at range 2000, for 1800 energy a shot. It takes the Mercury's (armmercury) and Screamer's (corscreamer) place with less reach (2000 against 2400) and a smaller blast, but it reloads instead of stockpiling, firing every 5 seconds where the Mercury builds a missile every 14, as long as energy arrives. It kills bombers and gunships well before they reach the base; cheap scouts bait its shots, and in an energy stall it stops. It does nothing against ground.

leglrpc.name: Olympus
leglrpc.gloss: 5200-metal long-range cannon, three 600-damage cluster shells every 18 s at 4800; 6000 energy a salvo
leglrpc.prose: The Olympus is Legion's long-range cannon: 5200 metal and 76000 energy, 4450 health, a salvo of three 600-damage plasma shells every 18 seconds at range 4800, each breaking into six 100-damage bomblets, for 6000 energy a salvo. It takes the Basilica's (armbrtha) and Basilisk's (corint) place at a little more metal and about their reach (4650, 4950), with a spread of smaller hits instead of one 1625- or 2000-damage shell, so it suits packed bases and formations more than single hard targets; a shield takes only 300 from each shell. It reaches across most maps and, once built, it is the enemy's first target.

leglts.name: Aeolus
leglts.gloss: tier-1 light air transport; carries one tier-1 or light tier-2 land unit, not the commander; dies to anti-air
leglts.prose: The Aeolus is the light transport and the Stork's (armatlas) numbers to the unit: 68 metal, 265 health, speed 207, carrying one land unit of tier 1 or light tier 2, not the commander and not the heavies. It drops units past a defensive line, moves a constructor to a far spot and lifts a Construction Turret (legnanotc) to wherever build power is needed. Scout for anti-air before a drop; anything that shoots aircraft kills it and its cargo.

leglupara.name: Lupara
leglupara.gloss: 900-metal flak battery, two 255-damage bursts every 1.8 s at 1125, 4000 health; breaks air groups, nothing against ground
leglupara.prose: The Lupara is Legion's heavy tier-1 anti-air: 900 metal and 8200 energy, 4000 health, a flak gun firing two 255-damage bursts with a 150 blast every 1.8 seconds at range 1125, 283 a second against one aircraft and more against a formation, since each burst hits everything in its blast. It takes the Chainsaw's (armcir) and Eradicator's (corerad) place, 100 to 150 metal dearer with less reach (1125 against 1200) and less single-target damage (283 against 625), traded for the area; the game calls it bomb-resistant. It does nothing against ground and is the anti-air to build once bombers or gunships come in groups.

legmed.name: Medusa
legmed.gloss: 1500-metal homing rocket tank, six 500-damage rockets every 12 s at 1000; kills heavies and towers from range
legmed.prose: The Medusa is a heavy salvo rocket tank: 1500 metal and 22500 energy, 3000 health, speed 39, sight 600, firing six homing siege rockets of 500 damage each (200 to commanders) every 12 seconds at range 1000, 3000 a salvo. It takes the Banisher's (corban: 1000 metal, one 1000-damage homing missile every 7.5 seconds at 800) place with more reach and a bigger, slower salvo; homing rockets suit tanks, towers and other big targets that a shell would miss on the move. Raiders that close and aircraft beat it, so it stands behind the line.

legmex.name: Metal Extractor
legmex.gloss: tier-1 metal extractor on a metal spot, 50 metal, the other factions' price; the economy, and the first thing raiders kill
legmex.prose: The Metal Extractor is Legion's tier-1 extractor at the price Armada's (armmex) and Cortex's (cormex) cost: 50 metal and 500 energy, 275 health, 3 energy a second upkeep, and whatever the spot yields, about 2 metal a second on the maps played here. Extractors are the whole tier-1 income and beat converters while free spots remain, so expansion is claiming spots as fast as the army can cover them; they are also the first thing every raid goes for, which is why a Pharos (leglht) beside one is the usual guard. It self-destructs in one second and the blast hurts light units beside it. A tier-2 constructor upgrades it in place to an Advanced Metal Extractor (legmoho) or an Advanced Metal Fortifier (legmohocon), four times the spot.

legmg.name: Cacophony
legmg.air: 255 dps against aircraft, its full damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range
legmg.gloss: 380-metal heavy gatling tower, 255 a second at 575 against ground and air, 2200 health; no energy a shot
legmg.prose: The Cacophony is Legion's heavy tier-1 tower: 380 metal and 5500 energy, 2200 health, a gatling firing six 17-damage rounds every 0.4 seconds (255 a second) at range 575 against ground and, when nothing on the ground is in range, against aircraft at the same damage. It is nearest the Overwatch (armhlt: 440 metal, 215 a second at 620) and Warden (corhlt), 45 short of their reach but cheaper, harder-hitting and free to fire, so it keeps shooting in an energy stall. Its 575 out-ranges the rocket bots (475) and the Ballista (legbal), so it kills the skirmishers that kill light towers, while artillery (710) out-ranges it and the Lasher (cormist) matches it. It doubles as base anti-air against gunships.

legmh.name: Salacia
legmh.gloss: 190-metal hover rocket launcher, 400 damage at 700 every 7.5 s over walls; softens defences before a landing
legmh.prose: The Salacia is a light hovercraft with a vertical rocket launcher: 190 metal, 520 health, speed 70, a 400-damage rocket with an 80 blast every 7.5 seconds at range 700 that comes down over walls and terrain and prefers buildings. It takes the Possum's (armmh: 175 metal, 300 at 710) and Mangonel's (cormh: 200 metal, 550 at 700) place between them. It kills turrets and softens an expansion before a hover assault; close-combat units kill it, so keep it behind Nereus (legner).

legmine1.name: Light Mine
legmine1.gloss: 7-metal cloaked light mine, 445 damage in a 200 blast; kills raiders and scouts outright; laid by the Sapper
legmine1.prose: The Light Mine is a 7-metal cloaked mine (270 energy, 1 energy a second to stay cloaked, invisible to radar) that explodes when an enemy comes within 64, doing 445 damage over a 200-wide blast. It kills Goblins (leggob), Pawns (armpw), Grunts (corak) and scouts outright and is laid across the lanes they use by a Sapper (legmlv) or the decoy commander (legdecom); keep your own units off it. A Juno pulse and the enemy's minesweepers clear it.

legmine2.name: Medium Mine
legmine2.gloss: 25-metal cloaked medium mine, 1110 damage in a 250 blast; for line units and medium tanks
legmine2.prose: The Medium Mine is a 25-metal cloaked mine (1050 energy, 2 energy a second) that explodes for 1110 damage over a 250-wide blast when an enemy comes within 64. It is the mine for a lane the enemy's line units and medium tanks use, where a light mine would not kill; mines laid too close chain-explode, and they hurt your own units badly. A Sapper (legmlv) or the decoy commander (legdecom) lays it.

legmine3.name: Heavy Mine
legmine3.gloss: 50-metal cloaked heavy mine, 3000 damage in a 330 blast; wipes a packed push at a choke; hits friends
legmine3.prose: The Heavy Mine is a 50-metal cloaked mine (2800 energy, 6 energy a second) that explodes for 3000 damage over a 330-wide blast when an enemy comes within 64, enough for a packed group of line bots or medium tanks; with Dragon's Teeth (legdrag) narrowing a gap it wipes a push in one blast. It is wasted on a single fast raider, it sets off other mines and it hits friends. A Sapper (legmlv) or the decoy commander (legdecom) lays it.

legmineb.name: Harbinger
legmineb.gloss: 300-metal minelayer bomber; lays a line of six light mines on land each run, 30 metal and 1620 energy a run
legmineb.prose: The Harbinger is a minelayer bomber: 300 metal and 21000 energy, 1110 health, speed 210, dropping six cloaked Light Mines (legmine1, 445 damage each in a 200 blast) in a line on land on each run, stockpiling one run at a time for 30 metal and 1620 energy over 10 seconds. It has no twin; it mines a raiding lane, an expansion the enemy is about to take or the ground in front of a push faster than any Sapper (legmlv) can. The mines hurt our own units as well, flak and fighters kill it, and a Juno pulse clears what it lays.

legmlv.name: Sapper
legmlv.gloss: stealthy minelayer; lays light, medium and heavy mines, walls and cameras; sees enemy mines within 450; no real gun
legmlv.prose: The Sapper is a 52-metal minelayer with 210 health, speed 69, radar stealth, 40 build power and a 15-damage seismic charge at 220 that fires only at mines. It lays the three mine sizes (legmine1, legmine2, legmine3), Dragon's Teeth (legdrag) and Argus cameras (legeyes), and it reveals enemy mines within 450 so the charge can clear them. A minefield on a lane the enemy raids through kills light units outright and hurts anything heavier; keep your own units off it. It cannot reclaim and cannot fight; Armada's Groundhog (armmlv) is the same tool at 57 metal and 335 health.

legmoho.name: Advanced Metal Extractor
legmoho.gloss: tier-2 extractor upgrade, 640 metal, four times the spot's yield for 20 energy a second; the first tier-2 buy
legmoho.prose: The Advanced Metal Extractor replaces a tier-1 extractor on its spot and is Cortex's (cormoho) exactly: 640 metal and 8100 energy, 3900 health, four times the yield (0.004 against 0.001 a spot unit), 20 energy a second upkeep, 600 metal storage. One upgrade adds about three extractors' worth of income and repays its metal in around 100 seconds, so upgrading the safest spots first is what the Advanced Construction Bot (legack) is for. The Advanced Metal Fortifier (legmohocon) is the same extractor with a 400-build-power turret on it for 420 more metal. With nothing banked and other builders drawing, an upgrade takes minutes instead of its nominal time, so give the constructor helpers or a bank.

legmohocon.name: Advanced Metal Fortifier
legmohocon.gloss: tier-2 extractor upgrade carrying a 400-build-power construction turret, 1060 metal; no twin, no weapon
legmohocon.prose: The Advanced Metal Fortifier is an Advanced Metal Extractor (legmoho) with a construction turret mounted on it: 1060 metal and 14500 energy, 3900 health, four times the spot's yield for 20 energy a second, and 400 build power reaching 400. The turret cannot be selected on its own; it carries out the repair and reclaim orders given to the extractor and otherwise repairs what is near. For the 420 metal over the plain upgrade that is twice a Construction Turret's (legnanotc, 230 metal) build power, so on a spot inside the base or beside a factory it is cheap build power, and on an exposed spot it is 1060 metal for a raid to kill. Neither Armada nor Cortex has one; despite the name it has no weapon.

legmos.name: Mosquito
legmos.gloss: 110-metal light gunship, four stockpiled 44-damage rockets at 380, one rebuilt every 1.8 s; raids bare targets
legmos.prose: The Mosquito is Legion's light gunship: 110 metal, 415 health, speed 165, holding up to four 44-damage rockets with a 72 splash that it fires at range 380 and rebuilds one every 1.8 seconds (about 24 a second sustained, 176 in its first volley). It takes the Banshee's (armkam: 135 metal, 560 health, 39 a second at 350) place, with a harder opening volley and less staying damage. It raids extractors, radar, constructors and scouts that nothing guards; anti-air heavier than a Bramble (legrl), or a fighter, kills it, and it cannot hit aircraft. Confirm targets with a scout first.

legmrv.name: Quickshot
legmrv.gloss: 250-metal fast raider tank, speed 135, two 120-damage plasma rounds every 2 s at 240; kills what is unguarded
legmrv.prose: The Quickshot is Legion's tier-2 vehicle raider: 250 metal, 970 health, speed 135, a cannon firing two 120-damage plasma rounds with a 32 splash every 2 seconds at range 240 (120 a second). It is faster than any raider of tier 1 (the Blitz armflash 101) or tier 2 (the Sprinter armfast 111), so it reaches far extractors, constructors and radar first and leaves before help arrives; towers, line tanks and riot units kill it in a straight fight. No vehicle of the other factions matches it.

legmstor.name: Metal Storage
legmstor.gloss: 3000 metal storage for 340 metal; banks metal for a tier-2 lab or an upgrade burst; explodes when killed
legmstor.prose: The Metal Storage adds 3000 metal storage for 340 metal and 590 energy, 2100 health (Armada's armmstor costs 330). A store holds the bank that starts an Advanced Bot Lab (legalab, 2600 metal) or a run of extractor upgrades without stalling everything else; at tier 1 a full store is usually a sign to build a second lab instead. It explodes when destroyed and clusters chain.

legnanotc.name: Construction Turret
legnanotc.gloss: 200-build-power construction turret, 230 metal; assists, repairs and reclaims within 400; unarmed
legnanotc.prose: The Construction Turret is 200 build power that does not move, the same as Armada's (armnanotc): 230 metal and 3200 energy, 560 health, assisting, repairing and reclaiming anything within 400. Two or three beside a lab more than double its output, which is the right use of banked metal before a second lab. One dying damages the turrets beside it, so do not pack them; the Advanced Metal Fortifier (legmohocon) carries a 400-build-power one on an extractor.

legnanotcplat.name: Naval Construction Turret
legnanotcplat.gloss: the construction turret on water, 200 build power for 230 metal; assists a shipyard
legnanotcplat.prose: The Naval Construction Turret is the Construction Turret (legnanotc) built on water: 200 build power for 230 metal and 3200 energy, 560 health, assisting, repairing and reclaiming within 400. Two beside a shipyard double its output. Its death damages the turrets beside it, so do not pack them.

legnavyaaship.name: Iapetus
legnavyaaship.gloss: 250-metal anti-air ship, three-missile salvo at 760 doing 120 a second, 1200 radar; covers a fleet; nothing else
legnavyaaship.prose: The Iapetus is Legion's tier-1 anti-air and radar ship: 250 metal, 1200 health, speed 60, 750 sight and 1200 radar, a salvo of three 24-damage missiles every 0.6 seconds at range 760 against aircraft only (120 a second). Armada and Cortex have no dedicated tier-1 anti-air ship; their patrol boats (armpt, corpt) carry light anti-air instead. It sails with the fleet against gunships, bombers and torpedo planes and does nothing against ships or subs.

legnavyartyship.name: Octeres
legnavyartyship.gloss: 1450-metal cluster artillery ship, two 300-damage cluster shells every 10 s at 960; bombards shores
legnavyartyship.prose: The Octeres is Legion's tier-1 artillery ship: 1450 metal, 4500 health, speed 45, two cluster cannons each firing a 300-damage shell with a 130 blast every 10 seconds at range 960, each shell breaking into five 105-damage bomblets, up to 1650 a pair. Armada and Cortex have nothing like it at tier 1; it shells shore towers, extractors and bases from beyond the coastal defences, and the Longbow (armmship) and Messenger (cormship) are the tier-2 ships that do the same. It is slow and helpless against submarines and fast boats, so it sails behind a screen.

legnavyconship.name: Construction Ship
legnavyconship.gloss: tier-1 constructor ship, 115 build power; builds naval and underwater buildings and the advanced shipyard; unarmed
legnavyconship.prose: The Construction Ship is the sea builder: 180 metal, 1080 health, speed 71, 115 build power, no weapon (Armada's armcs: 200 metal, 125). It claims underwater metal spots, builds the naval defences, economy and factories, and the Advanced Shipyard (legadvshipyard) is on its list; it can also put a bot lab, vehicle plant or drone plant on a shore. Anything that shoots at ships kills it.

legnavydestro.name: Syracusia
legnavydestro.gloss: 875-metal heat-ray destroyer, 410 per 2.4 s at 700 plus two drones; no anti-submarine weapon
legnavydestro.prose: The Syracusia is Legion's tier-1 destroyer: 875 metal, 3800 health, speed 58, a heat ray doing 410 with a 72 splash every 2.4 seconds at range 700 (171 a second; 17 energy a shot), and two light drones (15 metal and 500 energy each, one every 20 seconds) that fight anything within 1000. It takes the Corsair's (armroy: 880 metal, 3700 health, 700) and Oppressor's (corroy) place, out-ranging every tier-1 ship and torpedo launcher, but unlike them it carries no torpedoes, so submarines are someone else's job. It bombards shore targets in its reach and anchors a tier-1 fleet.

legnavyfrigate.name: Argonaut
legnavyfrigate.gloss: 370-metal torpedo frigate, two launchers doing 215 a second at 460 against ships and subs; 2600 health
legnavyfrigate.prose: The Argonaut is Legion's tier-1 frigate: 370 metal, 2600 health, speed 72, 400 sonar, two deck torpedo launchers each firing a 140-damage homing torpedo every 1.3 seconds at range 460 (215 a second), and it takes half the EMP others do. Where the Ellysaw (armpship) and Riptide (corpship) are plasma frigates with no anti-submarine weapon, its torpedoes hit both ships and submarines, so it is the tier-1 hull that hunts subs. Its torpedoes do nothing to land units, hovercraft or aircraft, and a destroyer out-ranges it. The Proteus (legaceb) can build it in the field.

legnavyrezsub.name: Dionysus
legnavyrezsub.gloss: resurrection submarine, 150 build power; repairs, reclaims and resurrects wrecks under water; unarmed
legnavyrezsub.prose: The Dionysus is Legion's resurrection submarine: 240 metal, 420 health, speed 67, 150 build power, repairing, reclaiming and resurrecting under water but not building, the Grim Reaper's (armrecl) place. Resurrecting a sunk ship brings the whole unit back for energy only, so one behind a naval fight turns the enemy's wrecks into your fleet. It has no weapon; keep it behind the line.

legnavyscout.name: Hippocampus
legnavyscout.air: 15 dps against aircraft (25% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
legnavyscout.gloss: 120-metal fast corvette, speed 97, twin machine guns 60 a second at 351; scouts and kills constructors
legnavyscout.prose: The Hippocampus is Legion's light corvette: 120 metal, 700 health, speed 97, sight 600, twin machine guns firing two 12-damage rounds every 0.4 seconds at range 351 (60 a second). It takes the Dolphin's (armdecade: 175 metal, 135 a second at 280) and Supporter's (coresupp) place with more reach and less damage. It scouts the sea, kills construction ships and harasses light boats; any warship, a destroyer or a torpedo launcher out-trades it.

legnavysub.name: Ketea
legnavysub.gloss: 320-metal tier-1 submarine, 140-damage torpedo every 1.5 s at 400; invisible without sonar
legnavysub.prose: The Ketea is Legion's tier-1 submarine: 320 metal, 600 health, speed 57, 400 sonar, an unguided 140-damage torpedo every 1.5 seconds at range 400 (93 a second). It takes the Eel's (armsub: 440 metal, 840 health, 500) and Orca's (corsub: 580 metal) place, cheaper and lighter with less reach. Under the water it is seen only by sonar and hit only by torpedoes and depth charges, so it kills underwater extractors and unguarded fleets; sonar plus a torpedo frigate (legnavyfrigate) or launcher kills it.

legner.name: Nereus
legner.air: 21 dps against aircraft (35% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
legner.gloss: 220-metal hovertank, plasma 55 every 0.9 s at 370, 1100 health; the line unit of a hover force
legner.prose: The Nereus is Legion's tier-1 hovertank: 220 metal, 1100 health, speed 76, a 55-damage plasma shot every 0.9 seconds (61 a second) at range 370. It takes the Crocodile's (armanac: 270 metal, 1530 health, 70 a second at 370) and Cayman's (corsnap) place, cheaper and lighter and a little faster. It moves over land and sea equally, so it fights beside ships or lands with a raid as the line unit of a hovercraft force; bombers and gunships kill it as they kill any tank, so bring anti-air.

legotter.name: Otter
legotter.gloss: amphibious tier-1 constructor, 75 build power; builds on land and the sea floor, including naval buildings; unarmed
legotter.prose: The Otter is Legion's amphibious constructor, from the vehicle plant or the Amphibious Complex: 150 metal, 950 health, speed 43.5, 75 build power, no weapon; Armada's Beaver (armbeaver) is the same price with 80. Its list of 44 is the tier-1 land base plus the naval set (shipyard, Amphibious Complex legamphlab, seaplane platform, hovercraft platforms, tidal generators, torpedo launchers, the Naval Hive legfhive) and the Advanced Vehicle Plant (legavp), so it is the builder for a map with water in it and the one that expands between islands. It is unarmed and slow, and dies to any raider.

legperdition.name: Perdition
legperdition.gloss: 1250-metal tactical napalm launcher: stockpiled 1200-damage shells at 2300 that burn 150 wide for 15 s; fired by hand
legperdition.prose: The Perdition is Legion's tactical launcher: 1250 metal and 15000 energy, 4000 health, stockpiling napalm shells (350 metal, 13000 energy and 40 seconds each, up to ten) fired by hand at range 2300. Each does 1200 damage (700 to commanders) over a 425 blast and leaves the ground within 150 burning for 15 seconds at 120 a second, up to 1800 more to whatever stays; aircraft and submarines do not burn. It takes the Catalyst's (cortron) place, cheaper a shell (350 metal against 550) with less blast (1200 against 4000) traded for the fire, and like it clears a turret cluster or a packed army before an assault. It explodes like a nuclear silo when destroyed, so it stands apart.

legphoenix.name: Phoenix
legphoenix.gloss: 450-metal heat-ray bomber: each pass sweeps a 120-wide beam along its path for about 2 s, 145 a frame; dies to fighters
legphoenix.prose: The Phoenix is Legion's tier-2 bomber, and it bombs with a heat ray: 450 metal and 25000 energy, 2000 health, speed 270, a 145-damage, 120-wide beam at range 950 that on each pass fires every frame for about 2.2 seconds along its line of flight, 17 energy a beam, then waits for the next pass (the 18 a second in its numbers counts one beam a reload). It scorches a strip, so it suits a row of buildings, an extractor line or a column of units more than one hard point. It takes the Blizzard's (armpnix) and Hailstorm's (corhurc) place as the strategic bomber; fighters and flak kill it, so scout the target's anti-air and send fighters ahead.

legrad.name: Radar Tower
legrad.gloss: 60-metal radar tower, 2100 radar and 680 sight; the early warning and the eyes for long guns
legrad.prose: The Radar Tower shows every enemy unit within 2100 as a radar dot, for 60 metal and 630 energy, 180 health, with 680 sight of its own, the same as Armada's (armrad). It is the early warning for raids and air and the eyes for anything that fires further than it sees, such as the Ballista (legbal) or the Amputator (legcluster). Hills block it, a jammer hides units from it, cloaked units do not show, and a Juno pulse destroys it.

legrail.name: Lance
legrail.air: 75 dps against aircraft, its full damage
legrail.gloss: 240-metal railgun tank: 200 per 7.5 s at 650 through what it kills, plus an anti-air rail at 750; long reach, low damage
legrail.prose: The Lance is a long-range skirmisher tank that also shoots down aircraft: 240 metal, 1100 health, speed 46.5, a 200-damage railgun every 7.5 seconds at range 650 (27 a second; 100 a shot against commanders) and a separate anti-air railgun at 750 that does 300 to aircraft every 4 seconds (75 a second). Both rails go on through a unit they kill to the one behind. Its 650 outranges every tier-1 tower (the heavy laser towers reach 620) and every tier-1 unit but artillery, so a group can pick at a tower line or a slow army from beyond reply, though at 27 a second each that is slow; the 750 in its numbers is the anti-air gun's. It has no twin; the Whistler (armsam) and Lasher (cormist) fill the same double role for the other plants at shorter reach. Keep it behind the Decurions (leggat).

legrampart.name: Rampart
legrampart.gloss: tier-2 vent platform: 600 energy a second, anti-nuke, 2100 radar, jammer and three heavy drones; 2600 metal, no twin
legrampart.prose: The Rampart stands on a steam vent and is several buildings in one: 2600 metal and 38000 energy, 8600 health, 600 energy a second (about half an Advanced Geothermal's 1250), an anti-nuke covering 1600 around it whose missiles stockpile at 150 metal and 7500 energy each over 90 seconds, a 2100 radar and a 500 radar jammer. It also keeps up to three heavy drones (90 metal and 1000 energy each, 1650 health, a heat ray of about 125 damage a second at 430) that fight anything within 1600 of it and dock to heal. Neither Armada nor Cortex has one: it suits a vent near the front, where an Advanced Geothermal Powerplant (legageo) would be a bomb waiting for a raid, while on a safe vent the geothermal's double output is worth more. Only the tier-2 constructors build it.

legrezbot.name: Zagreus
legrezbot.gloss: 200-build-power repair and resurrection bot; cannot build or fight, follows the army, hides from radar
legrezbot.prose: The Zagreus is Legion's resurrection bot and the Lazarus's (armrectr) twin to the number: 130 metal, 220 health, speed 78, 200 build power (nearly three times the Legion Construction Bot's 75), able to repair, reclaim and resurrect but not to build or assist a factory. Resurrecting a wreck brings back the whole unit for energy only, so one or two behind a fight turn the enemy's dead into your army; the carded OS-27 Legion player made one after his first Goblins. It has no weapon and is invisible to radar, so it lives only where nothing can see it; keep it behind the line and pull it back when the line breaks.

legrhapsis.name: Rhapsis
legrhapsis.gloss: 280-metal salvo anti-air battery, six missiles every half second at 950 (180 a second), 1900 health; air only
legrhapsis.prose: The Rhapsis is a mid-cost anti-air battery: 280 metal and 6500 energy, 1900 health, a salvo of six 15-damage missiles every half second at range 950 (180 a second against aircraft) for 5 energy a second upkeep, and nothing against ground. It takes the SAM's (cormadsam: 350 metal, 2500 health, 225 a second at 950) and the Ferret's (armferret) place a little cheaper and lighter. It is the step up from Brambles (legrl) once the enemy shows bombers or gunships rather than scouts.

legrl.name: Bramble
legrl.gloss: 80-metal light anti-air tower, missiles at 765; stops scouts and light aircraft, nothing against ground; the Nettle's twin
legrl.prose: The Bramble is Legion's light anti-air tower and the Nettle's (armrl) numbers: 80 metal and 850 energy, 335 health, a 115-damage missile every 1.7 seconds at range 765 (68 a second) that hits aircraft only. A few around a base or an extractor line stop scouts, drones and lone bombers; its rate of fire is low, so a swarm or a heavy gunship gets through unless several stand together, and it fires further than it sees, so radar makes it work. Build it only after enemy aircraft or an aircraft plant have been seen.

legscout.name: Wheelie
legscout.air: 2 dps against aircraft (9% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
legscout.gloss: 23-metal scout car, speed 160, sight 635; finds the enemy and nibbles bare extractors; dies to anything, and to a Juno
legscout.prose: The Wheelie is Legion's only land scout: 23 metal, 75 health, speed 160, sight 635, a three-round burst doing 24 damage a second at range 169. It takes the Rover's (armfav) and Rascal's (corfav) place, cheaper and frailer, for finding the enemy's base and expansion in the first minutes and for killing extractors nobody guards (alone it needs about 12 seconds for one). Any armed unit or turret kills it and it cannot hurt aircraft. A Juno pulse (armjuno, corjuno, legjuno) kills it outright, and for 30 seconds a ring 450 out from the impact kills any Wheelie that crosses it.

legsd.name: Ichnaea
legsd.gloss: 710-metal intrusion detector, pings moving cloaked and stealthy units within 2000 for 125 energy a second
legsd.prose: The Ichnaea is the Tracer's (armsd) twin to the number: 710 metal and 7100 energy, 2650 health, 125 energy a second, detecting moving cloaked and radar-invisible units within 2000 by their vibration. It shows them as pings, not targets, so units must be ordered onto them by hand, and a standing cloaked unit is not seen. It is what protects an Aegis (legabm) from a spy's EMP and a base from cloaked raiders. Only the tier-2 constructors build it.

legsh.name: Glaucus
legsh.air: 60 dps against aircraft, its full damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range
legsh.gloss: 60-metal fast hovercraft raider, heat ray 60 a second at 260; lands behind the line and swarms; dies to light towers
legsh.prose: The Glaucus is Legion's cheap hovercraft raider: 60 metal, 220 health, speed 102, a 60-damage heat ray every second at range 260, costing no energy. It takes the Seeker's (armsh: 85 metal, 290 health, 60 a second at 230) and Goon's (corsh) place, cheaper and lighter with 30 more reach. It crosses water and land alike, so a swarm lands behind the enemy's defensive line and raids the expansion there; a Pharos (leglht) or Sentry (armllt) kills it, and so does any line unit.

legshot.name: Phalanx
legshot.gloss: 470-metal armoured riot bot, a 210-damage blast with a 144 splash every 2 s at 280; takes a third of damage while armoured
legshot.prose: The Phalanx is Legion's tier-2 riot bot: 470 metal, 3350 health, speed 44, a riot cannon doing 210 with a wide 144 blast every 2 seconds at range 280 (105 a second against one target, more against a crowd), costing no energy. Its reactive armour makes it take a third of the damage until the plates have absorbed 400, and they come back about 20 seconds after it was last hit, so against a short burst it lasts far longer than 3350 health suggests. It kills packed light units and raiders that come inside 280 and holds a choke, and it loses to anything that out-ranges it, which at 280 is most of tier 2. No unit of the other factions matches it; the carded OS-27 Legion player added one to his drone army.

legsilo.name: Supernova
legsilo.gloss: 7700-metal nuclear silo, stockpiles 15000-damage missiles at 187500 energy each; erases a base; stopped by anti-nukes
legsilo.prose: The Supernova is Legion's nuclear silo and the Apocalypse's (corsilo) numbers: 7700 metal and 82000 energy, 6200 health, stockpiling nuclear missiles that take 180 seconds, 1500 metal and 187500 energy each, up to ten, each doing 15000 damage (3000 to commanders) over a 1920-wide blast. An anti-nuke covering the target stops it unless several are fired at once; aim at what no anti-nuke covers. It is fired by hand, and it is a decision of a whole tier-2 economy.

legsnapper.name: Snapper
legsnapper.gloss: 60-metal amphibious crawling bomb: 2000 in a 280 blast when it dies, 2700 in 400 when self-destructed
legsnapper.prose: The Snapper is a crawling bomb: 60 metal and 5600 energy, 550 health, speed 81, that walks or swims to a target and explodes for 2000 damage over a 280-wide blast (1000 to commanders), or 2700 over 400 when self-destructed, which it does at once. It is the Bedbug's (corroach) twin, 9 metal cheaper and a little faster with less health. A few that reach a packed group, a tower cluster or an anti-nuke undo far more than their metal; kept together they set each other off, so spread them, and whatever shoots them first wins. It walks the sea floor and can arrive from the water.

legsolar.name: Solar Collector
legsolar.gloss: 20 energy a second for 150 metal and no energy to build; the safe generator from an empty store
legsolar.prose: The Solar Collector makes 20 energy a second for 150 metal and no energy at all to build, with 340 health and 50 energy storage: Cortex's price (corsolar) and five metal under Armada's. Because it draws nothing to build it is the first generator when the store is empty or a lab is about to draw energy, and it cannot stall the builder. At 7.5 metal per energy a second it is dearer than wind on a windy map and cheaper where the wind is weak; the one carded Legion opening in the replay pool (an OS-27 player) built two turbines and one solar before the lab. It closes when hit and loses its output while closed.

legspbomber.name: Pyrphoros
legspbomber.air: 150 dps against aircraft, its full damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range
legspbomber.gloss: 240-metal seaplane bomber, three bursts of eight 50-damage bomblets a run, 1200 spread wide; loses to fighters
legspbomber.prose: The Pyrphoros is Legion's seaplane bomber: 240 metal, 1170 health, speed 267, dropping three bursts of eight 50-damage bomblets with a 100 blast each run, up to 1200 scattered over a wide strip. It takes the Tsunami's (armsb: five 200-damage bombs) and Dam Buster's (corsb) place with a wider and lighter spread, so it suits packed boats, naval buildings and base clusters more than one heavy target. Fighters and flak kill it; scout the target's anti-air first.

legspcarrier.name: Hecatoncheir
legspcarrier.gloss: 250-metal flying drone carrier, two drones fighting within 1100, 1000 radar, 1500 health; no gun of its own
legspcarrier.prose: The Hecatoncheir is an airborne drone carrier: 250 metal and 5000 energy, 1500 health, speed 93, 1000 radar, no gun of its own, keeping up to two light drones (15 metal and 500 energy each, one every 15 seconds) that fly out against anything within 1100 and dock to heal. A drone has 325 health and a machine gun of about 27 damage a second, so the pair adds some 55 a second to a fleet's fight while the carrier spots for it. It has no twin; it is slow for an aircraft and fighters kill it.

legspcon.name: Construction Seaplane
legspcon.gloss: tier-1 constructor seaplane, 75 build power at speed 124; builds land and naval buildings and the advanced air plant
legspcon.prose: The Construction Seaplane is a 150-metal flying constructor (405 health, speed 124, 75 build power, 20 energy a second) from the Offshore Seaplane Platform (legsplab); Armada's armcsa has the same numbers. Its list of 44 is the land base plus the naval buildings and the Legion Advanced Aircraft Plant (legaap), and its speed makes it the repairer for ships at the front. Fighters kill it easily.

legspfighter.name: Astrapios
legspfighter.gloss: tier-1 seaplane fighter, three-missile salvo at 760 doing 139 a second to aircraft; escorts bombers and ships
legspfighter.prose: The Astrapios is Legion's seaplane fighter: 90 metal, 220 health, speed 311, a salvo of three 37-damage missiles every 0.8 seconds at range 760 against aircraft only (139 a second). It takes the Cyclone's (armsfig: 90 metal, 252 a second at 710) and Bat's (corsfig) place with more reach and less damage. It escorts bombers and covers a fleet against enemy aircraft, and it cannot hit anything on the ground or the sea.

legsplab.name: Offshore Seaplane Platform
legsplab.gloss: tier-1 seaplane platform under water, 1400 metal; makes gunships, a bomber, a fighter and radar planes for a sea map
legsplab.prose: The Offshore Seaplane Platform sits on the sea floor: 1400 metal and 5500 energy, 2200 health, 300 build power and 800 sonar (Armada's armplat: 1450 metal), making the Construction Seaplane (legspcon), the Enyo gunship, the Hecatoncheir drone-carrier radar plane, the Pyrphoros bomber, the Ladon torpedo gunship, the Astrapios fighter and the Okeanos radar and sonar plane. It is the air factory for a sea map, offered only where the builder reaches deep water, and unlike the Drone Plant (legap) it makes a bomber. Seaplanes land on and rise from the water, so a base with no land can still fly scouts, bombers and fighters.

legspradarsonarplane.name: Okeanos
legspradarsonarplane.gloss: tier-1 radar and sonar seaplane, 2250 radar and 900 sonar at speed 338; scouts the sea; unarmed
legspradarsonarplane.prose: The Okeanos is Armada's Horizon (armsehak) to the number: 125 metal, 580 health, speed 338, 1100 sight, 2250 radar and 900 sonar. It scouts a sea map, finding fleets and submarines for the bombers and ships behind it. It is unarmed, and fighters kill it.

legspsurfacegunship.name: Enyo
legspsurfacegunship.gloss: 270-metal riot-cannon seaplane gunship, 200 with a 140 blast every 3.5 s at 400; raids ships and shores
legspsurfacegunship.prose: The Enyo is Legion's seaplane gunship: 270 metal, 1200 health, speed 148, a riot cannon doing 200 with a wide 140 blast every 3.5 seconds at range 400 (57 a second, more against a packed target). It takes the Sabre's (armsaber: 210 metal, 67 a second at 425) and Cutlass's (corcut) place with a slower, wider shot. It makes surprise raids on light ships, naval buildings and shore units; anti-air and fighters kill it.

legsptorpgunship.name: Ladon
legsptorpgunship.gloss: 190-metal torpedo gunship seaplane; circles ships dropping two 140-damage torpedoes every 4.5 s; kills subs
legsptorpgunship.prose: The Ladon is Legion's torpedo seaplane: 190 metal, 900 health, speed 273, 535 sonar, hovering over ships and submarines and dropping two 140-damage homing torpedoes every 4.5 seconds at range 460 (62 a second), a fifth of that against units on land. It takes the Puffin's (armseap: 290 metal) and Monsoon's (corseap: 230 metal) place for less metal. It hunts submarines that surface ships cannot see; anti-air kills it.

legsrail.name: Arquebus
legsrail.air: 121 dps against aircraft, its full damage
legsrail.gloss: 750-metal all-terrain railgun bot, 850 damage every 7 s at 850, through what it kills; 400 energy a shot
legsrail.prose: The Arquebus is an all-terrain sniper: 750 metal and 15000 energy, 2200 health, speed 42, sight 700, a railgun doing 850 (425 to commanders) every 7 seconds at range 850 for 400 energy a shot, and the rail goes on through a unit it kills to the one behind. It takes the Sharpshooter's (armsnipe: 680 metal, 580 health, 2500 every 10 seconds at 900, cloaked) place with a third of its damage a shot, nearly four times its health and no cloak, so it stands in a line rather than hiding, and it climbs cliffs other units cannot. It out-ranges every tier-1 tower and kills light and medium units in one or two shots from beyond their reply, and it can fire at aircraft. Raiders that close and artillery beat it, and it stops in an energy stall.

legstarfall.name: Starfall
legstarfall.gloss: 63000-metal end-game cannon: 63 shells of 600 every 14 s at 6100 for 360000 energy a salvo; starts on hold fire
legstarfall.prose: The Starfall is Legion's end-game cannon: 63000 metal and 720000 energy, 26000 health, a salvo of 63 high-arc plasma shells of 600 damage each with a 256 blast every 14 seconds at range 6100, for 360000 energy a salvo. It takes the Ragnarok's (armvulc) and Calamity's (corbuzz) place at a little less metal, dropping its 37800 damage in one rain instead of a stream, and firing at its full rate needs about 26000 energy a second, some eight Advanced Fusion Reactors (legafus). It starts on hold fire. It is a whole late economy in one building and the first target of everything the enemy has.

legstr.name: Hoplite
legstr.air: 90 dps against aircraft (38% of its ground damage)
legstr.gloss: 355-metal fast raider bot, speed 84, twin machine guns 240 a second at 280, 1780 health; the Fiend's place, tougher
legstr.prose: The Hoplite is Legion's tier-2 raider: 355 metal, 1780 health, speed 84, twin machine guns firing twelve 8-damage rounds every 0.4 seconds (240 a second) at range 280, and it shoots at aircraft too, at 3 a round. It takes the Fiend's (corpyro: 200 metal, 1060 health, 240 a second at 230) and Sprinter's (armfast) place, with 50 more reach and far more health for nearly twice the Fiend's metal, so it survives a tower long enough to kill what it came for. It kills constructors, extractors and light units that nothing guards and loses stand-up fights to tier-2 line units and to towers that out-range 280. The Proteus (legaceb) can build it in the field.

legstronghold.name: Stronghold
legstronghold.air: 60 dps against aircraft (40% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
legstronghold.gloss: 550-metal transport gunship: carries one heavy unit and fires an eight-pellet shotgun at 450; 2600 health
legstronghold.prose: The Stronghold is a heavy transport with a gun: 550 metal and 13000 energy, 2600 health, speed 160, carrying one unit up to the heavy tier-2 size and firing an eight-pellet shotgun every 1.6 seconds at range 450 (150 a second), with almost no weakness to EMP. It takes the Skyhook's (corseah: 370 metal, 2200 health) and Abductor's (armdfly) place, dropping a heavy unit on the front and covering the drop itself. Flak and fighters kill it, and its cargo dies with it.

legsy.name: Shipyard
legsy.gloss: tier-1 shipyard on water, 450 metal, 150 build power; makes the construction ship and Legion's seven tier-1 vessels
legsy.prose: The Shipyard is the tier-1 naval factory, built only on water: 450 metal and 950 energy, 4300 health, 150 build power (Armada's armsy: 450 metal, 4100 health), making the Construction Ship (legnavyconship), Dionysus, Hippocampus, Iapetus, Argonaut, Syracusia, Ketea and Octeres. It is offered only where the builder can reach water deep enough. On a land map there is no reason to build it.

legtarg.name: Pinpointer
legtarg.gloss: 810-metal targeting facility, halves radar-dot wobble for the whole team, 100 energy a second; three is plenty
legtarg.prose: The Pinpointer is Armada's (armtarg) to the number: 810 metal and 7200 energy, 2100 health, 100 energy a second, halving the wobble of radar dots for the whole team, with a second and third stacking at diminishing returns. It is what lets the Amputator (legcluster), Eviscerator (legacluster), Olympus (leglrpc) and the long-range units hit what radar shows without sight. Only the tier-2 constructors build it.

legtide.name: Tidal Generator
legtide.gloss: 85-metal tidal generator on water; steady output set by the map's tide
legtide.prose: The Tidal Generator makes a steady amount of energy set by the map's tidal strength, for 85 metal and 250 energy, 395 health, built on water, Cortex's (cortide) to the number. Where the tide is good it is cheap steady energy for a sea base; on a land map it is not offered. Its output is fixed, unlike wind's.

legtl.name: Stheno
legtl.gloss: 170-metal offshore torpedo launcher, 280 per 1.5 s at 500 against ships and subs; nothing against land or air
legtl.prose: The Stheno is Legion's tier-1 torpedo launcher on water and the Harpoon's (armtl) numbers: 170 metal and 1500 energy, 1300 health, a 280-damage unguided torpedo every 1.5 seconds (187 a second) at range 500 with its own 400 sonar. It kills ships and submarines that come near and is the cheap defence of a sea base; it cannot hit land units, aircraft or hovercraft, and destroyers out-range it. It is the first defence a shipyard gets.

leguwestore.name: Naval Energy Storage
leguwestore.gloss: 6000 energy storage on water for 175 metal; explodes when killed
leguwestore.prose: The Naval Energy Storage is the Energy Storage (legestor) built on water: 6000 energy storage for 175 metal and 1800 energy, 2000 health. It lets a tidal or wind economy ride out a lull and banks D-gun and drone energy for a sea base. It explodes with a large blast when destroyed, so it stands away from the shipyard.

leguwgeo.name: Offshore Geothermal Powerplant
leguwgeo.gloss: 300 energy a second on an underwater steam vent for 540 metal; explodes when killed
leguwgeo.prose: The Offshore Geothermal Powerplant is the Geothermal Powerplant (leggeo) for a vent under water: 300 energy a second for 540 metal and 13000 energy, 2050 health. Where a sea vent is safe it is a tier-1 economy's biggest single generator, under 2 metal per energy a second; the tier-1 sea builders and the air constructor build it. It explodes when destroyed, and a raid finds it worth the trip.

leguwmstore.name: Naval Metal Storage
leguwmstore.gloss: 3000 metal storage on water for 340 metal; banks metal for a sea base
leguwmstore.prose: The Naval Metal Storage is the Metal Storage (legmstor) built on water: 3000 metal storage for 340 metal and 590 energy, 2100 health. It holds the bank for an Advanced Shipyard (legadvshipyard) or a run of underwater upgrades; a full store at tier 1 is usually a sign to build another factory instead. It explodes when destroyed.

legvcarry.name: Mantis
legvcarry.gloss: 450-metal drone carrier truck: up to six combat drones fighting within 1050, each 15 metal and 500 energy; no twin
legvcarry.prose: The Mantis is a Hive (leghive) on wheels: 450 metal and 9000 energy, 1400 health, speed 45, no gun of its own, keeping up to six light drones (15 metal and 500 energy each, one every 10 seconds, three free when it is finished) that fly out against anything within 1050 and dock to heal. A drone has 325 health, speed 280 and a machine gun of about 27 damage a second at 300, so a full carrier puts some 160 a second on whatever its army meets and rebuilds its losses for energy. Neither Armada nor Cortex has one; when it dies its drones fly on alone, losing 20 health a second, and they are units of ours that no factory made.

legvenator.name: Venator
legvenator.gloss: 110-metal fast stealth interceptor, flak shot of three 480-damage rounds every 2.5 s at 700; speed 450; air only
legvenator.prose: The Venator is Legion's interceptor: 110 metal, 210 health, speed 450, invisible to radar, a flak cannon firing three 480-damage rounds with a 100 blast every 2.5 seconds at range 700 against aircraft only (576 a second, more against a formation). It takes the Highwind's (armhawk) and Nighthawk's (corvamp) place for less metal and more speed, at the price of a fragile hull, so it reaches a bombing run anywhere on the map before it lands. It cannot hit ground, and fighters that catch it at 210 health kill it quickly.

legvflak.name: Charon
legvflak.gloss: 470-metal flak truck, micro-flak at 800, about 720 a second against aircraft on paper; nothing against ground
legvflak.prose: The Charon is Legion's tier-2 flak vehicle: 470 metal and 10500 energy, 2700 health, speed 70, twin rotary micro-flak cannons firing three 40-damage rounds with a 35 blast every sixth of a second at range 800, about 720 a second against aircraft on paper. It takes the Fury's (corsent: 470 metal, 2700 health, 775) place with 25 more reach. It has no ground weapon and needs the army for cover; build it once enemy air has been seen.

legvp.name: Legion Vehicle Plant
legvp.gloss: tier-1 vehicle plant, 570 metal; makes the constructor, Otter, Wheelie, Alaris, Helios, Decurion, Barrage, Lance, Cetus, Sapper
legvp.prose: The Legion Vehicle Plant is the tier-1 vehicle factory at Cortex's price (corvp): 570 metal and 1650 energy, 3000 health, 150 build power, ten units: the Legion Construction Vehicle (legcv), Otter, Wheelie, Alaris, Helios, Decurion, Barrage, Lance, Cetus and Sapper. Vehicles are faster on flat ground, tougher and dearer than bots and climb worse; the plant is where Legion's only land scout, its tier-1 artillery and its line tank come from. It costs more than the bot lab and draws more energy while building, so it is usually the second factory; the carded OS-27 Legion player built none.

legwhisper.name: Whisper
legwhisper.gloss: tier-2 radar and sonar plane, 2400 radar, 1200 sonar, 1250 sight at speed 321; stealthy; unarmed
legwhisper.prose: The Whisper is Legion's tier-2 radar plane: 210 metal, 990 health, speed 321, 1250 sight, 2400 radar and 1200 sonar, invisible to radar itself. It takes the Condor's (corawac) and Oracle's (armawac) place, finding targets for bombers, artillery and long-range guns across a large part of the map. It is unarmed, and fighters that find it kill it.

legwin.name: Wind Turbine
legwin.gloss: 43-metal wind generator, up to 25 energy a second as the map's wind allows; the cheap bulk energy; costs energy to build
legwin.prose: The Wind Turbine makes whatever the wind gives, up to 25 energy a second, for 43 metal and 175 energy, with 230 health: Cortex's price (corwin) and three metal over Armada's (armwin, 196 health). On a windy map it is the cheapest energy there is (about 3.6 metal per energy a second at an average of 12) and the bulk of a tier-1 economy; where the wind is weak the Solar Collector (legsolar) is the better buy. It costs energy to build, so a first turbine from an empty store stalls, and its output swings minute to minute, which is what storage and a solar or two are for.
